body.translated_text: <s>Laghusiddhāntakaumudī</s>
Now, the chapter on technical designations (<s>saṃjñā</s>).
The final <s>hal</s> (consonant) [is an <s>it</s>]. (VLk 1 = P 1.3.3)

body.text: upadeśe 'ntyaṃ halitsyāt / upadeśa ādyoccāraṇam / sūtreṣvadṛṣṭaṃ padaṃ sūtrāntarādanuvartanīyaṃ sarvatra //
body.translated_text: In an <s>upadeśa</s> (original enunciation), the final consonant (<s>hal</s>) is an <s>it</s> (indicatory letter). <s>Upadeśa</s> means the first utterance. A word not seen in a given <s>sūtra</s> should be carried over (<s>anuvartanīya</s>) from another <s>sūtra</s> everywhere.
Disappearance is <s>lopa</s> (elision). (VLk 2 = P 1.1.60)
The disappearance of that which is applicable is designated <s>lopa</s>.
Its [<s>it</s>'s] elision (<s>lopa</s>) [takes place]. (VLk 3 = P 1.3.9)
The <s>lopa</s> of that <s>it</s> should take place. <s>Ṇ</s> and the like are for the purpose of [designating] <s>aṇ</s> and the like.
The initial, together with the final, [denotes the intermediate sounds]. (VLk 4 = P 1.1.71)

body.text: antyenetā sahati ādirmadhyagānāṃ svasya ca saṃjñā syāt yathāṇiti a i u varṇānāṃ saṃjñā / evamac hal alityādayaḥ //
body.translated_text: The initial, together with the final marker, constitutes the designation of the intermediate sounds and of itself; for example, <s>aṇ</s> is the designation of the sounds <s>a</s>, <s>i</s>, <s>u</s>. Similarly, <s>ac</s>, <s>hal</s>, <s>al</s>, and so forth.
The measure of <s>u</s>, <s>ū</s>, and <s>ū3</s> [determines] short (<s>hrasva</s>), long (<s>dīrgha</s>), and prolated (<s>pluta</s>) for vowels (<s>ac</s>). (VLk 5 = P 1.2.27)

body.text: uśca ūśca ū3śca vaḥ; vāṃ kālo yasya so 'c kramād hrasvadīrghaplutasaṃjñaḥ syāt / sa pratyekamudāttādi bhedena tridhā /
body.translated_text: <s>U</s>, <s>ū</s>, and <s>ū3</s> — their duration; a vowel (<s>ac</s>) whose duration corresponds [to these] is designated, respectively, as short (<s>hrasva</s>), long (<s>dīrgha</s>), and prolated (<s>pluta</s>). Each of these is threefold through the distinction of high-pitched (<s>udātta</s>) and the rest.
High-pitched is <s>udātta</s>. (VLk 6 = P 1.2.29)
Low-pitched is <s>anudātta</s>. (VLk 7 = P 1.2.30)
The combination [of both] is <s>svarita</s>. (VLk 8 = P 1.2.31)
Each of these nine types is further twofold through nasalization (<s>anunāsika</s>) and non-nasalization.
That which is pronounced through both the mouth and nose is <s>anunāsika</s> (nasalized). (VLk 9 = P 1.2.8)

body.text: mukhasahatināsikayoccāryamāṇo varṇo 'nunāsikasaṃjñaḥ syāt / tadittham - a i u ṛ eṣāṃ varṇānāṃ pratyekamaṣṭādaśa bhedāḥ / ḷvarṇasya dvādaśa, tasya dīrghābhāvāt / ecāmapi dvādaśa, teṣāṃ hrasvābhāvāt //
body.translated_text: A sound pronounced through the nose together with the mouth is designated <s>anunāsika</s>. Thus — the sounds <s>a</s>, <s>i</s>, <s>u</s>, <s>ṛ</s> each have eighteen varieties. The <s>ḷ</s>-sound has twelve, because it lacks a long [form]. The <s>ec</s> sounds (<s>e</s>, <s>o</s>, <s>ai</s>, <s>au</s>) also have twelve, because they lack a short [form].
That which has the same place and internal effort of articulation is <s>savarṇa</s> (homogeneous). (VLk 10 = P 1.1.8)

body.text: tālvādisthānamābhyantaraprayatnaścetyetaddvayaṃ yasya yena tulyaṃ tanmithaḥ savarṇasaṃjñaṃ syāt /

children.translated_text: (The mutual <s>savarṇa</s> relationship of <s>ṛ</s> and <s>ḷ</s> sounds is to be stated

children.text: ) / akuhavisarjanīyānāṃ kaṇṭhaḥ / icuyaśānāṃ tālu / ṛṭuraṣāṇāṃ mūrdhā / ḷtulasānāṃ dantāḥ / upūpadhmānīyānāmoṣṭhau / ñamaṅaṇanānāṃ nāsikā ca / edaitoḥ kaṇṭha tālu / odautoḥ kaṇṭhoṣṭam / vakārasya dantoṣṭham / jihvāmūlīyasya jihvāmūlam / nāsikānusvārasya /
children.translated_text: ). The throat is the place [of articulation] for <s>a</s>, <s>ka</s>-series, <s>ha</s>, <s>visarjanīya</s>. The palate for <s>i</s>, <s>ca</s>-series, <s>ya</s>, <s>śa</s>. The roof of the mouth (<s>mūrdhan</s>) for <s>ṛ</s>, <s>ṭa</s>-series, <s>ra</s>, <s>ṣa</s>. The teeth for <s>ḷ</s>, <s>ta</s>-series, <s>la</s>, <s>sa</s>. The lips for <s>u</s>, <s>pa</s>-series, <s>upadhmānīya</s>. The nose additionally for <s>ña</s>, <s>ma</s>, <s>ṅa</s>, <s>ṇa</s>, <s>na</s>. The throat and palate for <s>e</s> and <s>ai</s>. The throat and lips for <s>o</s> and <s>au</s>. The teeth and lips for <s>va</s>. The root of the tongue for <s>jihvāmūlīya</s>. The nose for <s>anusvāra</s>.
Effort (<s>yatna</s>) is twofold — internal (<s>ābhyantara</s>) and external (<s>bāhya</s>).

children.text: - spṛṣṭeṣatspṛṣṭeṣadvivṛtavivṛtasaṃvṛta bhedāt / tatra spṛṣṭaṃ prayatanaṃ sparśānām / īṣatspṛṣṭamantaḥsthānām / īṣadvivṛtamūṣmaṇām / vivṛtaṃ svarāṇām / hrasvasyāvarṇasya prayoge saṃvṛtam / prakriyādaśāyāṃ tu vivṛtameva /
children.translated_text: — through the distinctions of full contact (<s>spṛṣṭa</s>), slight contact (<s>īṣatspṛṣṭa</s>), slight opening (<s>īṣadvivṛta</s>), opening (<s>vivṛta</s>), and closure (<s>saṃvṛta</s>). Among these, full contact is the effort for stops (<s>sparśa</s>). Slight contact for semivowels (<s>antaḥstha</s>). Slight opening for sibilants (<s>ūṣman</s>). Opening for vowels (<s>svara</s>). For the short <s>a</s>-sound in actual usage, [the effort is] closure. But in the derivational stage (<s>prakriyā</s>), it is open only.
External effort is of eleven kinds

children.text: - vivāraḥ saṃvāraḥ śvāso nādo ghoṣo 'ghoṣo 'lpaprāṇomahāprāṇa udātto 'nudāttaḥ svaratiśceti / kharo vivārāḥ śvāsā aghoṣāśca / haśaḥ saṃvārā nādā ghoṣāśca / vargāṇāṃ prathamatṛtīyapañcamā yaṇaścālpaprāṇāḥ / vargāṇāṃ dvitīyacaturthau śalaśca mahāprāṇāḥ / kādayo māvasānāḥ sparśāḥ / yaṇo 'ntaḥsthāḥ / śala ūṣmāṇaḥ / acaḥ svarāḥ / -ka-kha iti kakhābhyāṃ pragardhavisargasadṛśo jihvāmūlīyaḥ / -pa-pha iti paphābhyāṃ prāgardhavisargasadṛśa upadhmānīyaḥ / aṃ aḥ ityacaḥ parāvanusvāravisargau //
children.translated_text: — opening (<s>vivāra</s>), closure (<s>saṃvāra</s>), aspiration (<s>śvāsa</s>), voicing (<s>nāda</s>), voiced (<s>ghoṣa</s>), voiceless (<s>aghoṣa</s>), unaspirated (<s>alpaprāṇa</s>), aspirated (<s>mahāprāṇa</s>), <s>udātta</s>, <s>anudātta</s>, and <s>svarita</s>. The <s>khar</s> sounds have opening, aspiration, and voicelessness. The <s>haś</s> sounds have closure, voicing, and voiced quality. The first, third, and fifth of the <s>vargas</s> (consonant groups), and the <s>yaṇ</s> sounds, are unaspirated. The second and fourth of the <s>vargas</s>, and <s>śal</s> sounds, are aspirated. From <s>ka</s> to <s>ma</s>, including the final, are stops (<s>sparśa</s>). The <s>yaṇ</s> sounds are semivowels (<s>antaḥstha</s>). The <s>śal</s> sounds are sibilants (<s>ūṣman</s>). The <s>ac</s> sounds are vowels (<s>svara</s>). Before <s>ka</s>-<s>kha</s>, the <s>jihvāmūlīya</s> resembles a half-<s>visarga</s>. Before <s>pa</s>-<s>pha</s>, the <s>upadhmānīya</s> resembles a half-<s>visarga</s>. <s>Anusvāra</s> and <s>visarga</s> follow after a vowel (<s>ac</s>).

body.translated_text: The twofold [criterion] — place of articulation such as the palate and the rest, and internal effort — that which is identical in these two respects is mutually designated <s>savarṇa</s>.
An <s>aṇ</s> sound or an <s>udit</s> (having <s>u</s> as <s>it</s>) [designates] its <s>savarṇa</s>, and [this applies] when it is not a suffix (<s>pratyaya</s>). (VLk 11 = P 1.1.69)

body.text: pratīyate vidhīyata iti pratyayaḥ / avidhīyamāno 'ṇudicca savarṇasya saṃjñā syāt / atraivāṇ pareṇa ṇakāreṇa / ku cu ṭu tu pu ete uditaḥ / tadevam - a ityaṣṭādaśānāṃ saṃjñā / tathekārokārau / ṛkārastriṃśataḥ / evaṃ ḷkāro 'pi / eco dvādaśānām / anunāsikānanunāsikabhedena yavalā dvidhā; tenānanunāsikāste dvayordvayossaṃjñā /
body.translated_text: That which is understood as a grammatical element is a <s>pratyaya</s> (suffix). An <s>aṇ</s> sound or <s>udit</s> sound that is not being prescribed [as a suffix] is the designation of its <s>savarṇa</s>. Here, <s>aṇ</s> [is formed] with the following <s>ṇa</s>-consonant. <s>Ku</s>, <s>cu</s>, <s>ṭu</s>, <s>tu</s>, <s>pu</s> — these are <s>udit</s>. Thus — <s>a</s> is the designation of eighteen [sounds]. Likewise <s>i</s> and <s>u</s>. <s>Ṛ</s> [designates] thirty. Likewise <s>ḷ</s> also. <s>Ec</s> [designates] twelve. Through the distinction of nasalized and non-nasalized, <s>ya</s>, <s>va</s>, <s>la</s> are each twofold; therefore the non-nasalized ones are the designation of two each.
The closest proximity is <s>saṃhitā</s> (juncture). (VLk 12 = P 1.1.109)
The exceedingly close proximity of sounds is designated <s>saṃhitā</s>.
Consonants (<s>hal</s>) without intervening [vowels] are <s>saṃyoga</s> (conjunct). (VLk 13 = P 1.1.7)
Consonants not separated by vowels (<s>ac</s>) are designated <s>saṃyoga</s>.
That which ends in a <s>sup</s> or <s>tiṅ</s> [suffix] is a <s>pada</s> (word). (VLk 14 = P 1.4.14)
That which ends in a <s>sup</s> (nominal ending) or <s>tiṅ</s> (verbal ending) is designated <s>pada</s>.
Thus ends the chapter on technical designations.
Now, vowel <s>sandhi</s> (<s>ac-sandhi</s>).
In place of <s>ik</s> (<s>i</s>, <s>u</s>, <s>ṛ</s>, <s>ḷ</s>), <s>yaṇ</s> [is substituted] when a vowel follows. (VLk 15 = P 6.1.77)

body.text: ikaḥ sthāne yaṇ syādaci saṃhitāyāṃ viṣaye / sudhī upāsya iti sthite //
body.translated_text: In place of <s>ik</s>, <s>yaṇ</s> is substituted when a vowel (<s>ac</s>) follows, within the domain of <s>saṃhitā</s>. Given: <s>sudhī upāsya</s> —
When [the following sound] is denoted by a locative, [the operation applies] to the preceding [sound]. (VLk 16 = P 1.1.66)

body.text: saptamīnirdeśena vidhīyamānaṃ kāryaṃ varṇāntareṇāvyavahatisya pūrvasya bodhyam //
body.translated_text: An operation prescribed by means of a locative designation is to be understood as applying to the preceding [sound] that is not separated by another sound.
In substitution, the most similar [is chosen]. (VLk 17 = P 1.1.50)

body.text: prasaṅge sati sadṛśatama ādeśaḥ syāt / sudhy upāsya iti jāte //
body.translated_text: When [substitution] is applicable, the most similar substitute should be [chosen]. Having obtained <s>sudhy upāsya</s> —
And [doubling occurs] when a non-vowel [follows]. (VLk 18 = P 8.4.47)

body.text: acaḥ parasya yaro dve vā sto na tvaci / iti dhakārasya dvitvena sudhdhy upāsya iti jāte //
body.translated_text: Optionally, two [consonants] replace a <s>yar</s> sound following a vowel, but not when a vowel follows. Thus, by the doubling of <s>dha</s>, <s>sudhdhy upāsya</s> is obtained.
For <s>jhal</s> sounds, <s>jaś</s> [is substituted] before a <s>jhaś</s> sound. (VLk 19 = P 8.4.53)
This is clear. Thus, for the preceding <s>dha</s>, <s>da</s> [is substituted].
Elision of the final [consonant] of a conjunct-final [word]. (VLk 20 = P 8.2.23)
When a <s>pada</s> (word) ends in a conjunct (<s>saṃyoga</s>), the final [consonant] of that [conjunct] undergoes <s>lopa</s> (elision).
Of the final <s>al</s> sound [the operation applies]. (VLk 21 = P 1.1.52)

body.text: ṣaṣṭhīnirdiṣṭā'ntyasyāla ādeśaḥ syāt / iti yalope prāpte

children.translated_text: (The prohibition of <s>yaṇ</s> [substitution] is to be stated.)

body.translated_text: A substitute denoted by the genitive replaces the final <s>al</s> sound. Thus, when the elision of <s>ya</s> is about to apply —
For <s>ec</s> (<s>e</s>, <s>o</s>, <s>ai</s>, <s>au</s>), <s>ay</s>, <s>av</s>, <s>āy</s>, <s>āv</s> [are substituted when a vowel follows]. (VLk 22 = P 6.1.78)

body.text: ecaḥ kramāday av āy āv ete syuraci //
body.translated_text: For <s>ec</s>, in order, <s>ay</s>, <s>av</s>, <s>āy</s>, <s>āv</s> are substituted when a vowel (<s>ac</s>) follows.
Corresponding enumeration applies to equal [sets]. (VLk 23 = P 1.3.10)

body.text: samasaṃbandhī vidhiryathāsaṃkhyaṃ syāt / haraye / viṣṇave / nāyakaḥ / pāvakaḥ //
body.translated_text: An operation relating to equal sets applies in corresponding order. <s>Haraye</s>. <s>Viṣṇave</s>. <s>Nāyakaḥ</s>. <s>Pāvakaḥ</s>.
The <s>v</s>-final [<s>au</s>] before a <s>y</s>-initial suffix. (VLk 24 = P 6.1.79)

body.text: yakārādau pratyaye pare odautorav āv etau staḥ / gavyam / nāvyam / (
body.translated_text: Before a suffix beginning with <s>ya</s>, <s>o</s> and <s>au</s> become <s>av</s> and <s>āv</s>. <s>Gavyam</s>. <s>Nāvyam</s>.
<s>A</s> and <s>eṅ</s> are [designated] <s>guṇa</s>. (VLk 25 = P 1.1.2)
<s>A</s> and <s>eṅ</s> (<s>e</s>, <s>o</s>) are designated <s>guṇa</s>.
When followed by <s>t</s>, [the designation applies] to [a sound] of the same duration. (VLk 26 = P 1.1.70)

body.text: taḥ paro yasmātsa ca tātparaścoccāryamāṇasamakālasyaiva saṃjñā syāt //
body.translated_text: That after which <s>t</s> stands — a [sound] uttered simultaneously with what is being pronounced — only of the same duration, that alone receives the designation.
After <s>a</s>, <s>guṇa</s> [is the single substitute]. (VLk 27 = P 6.1.87)

body.text: avarṇādaci pare pūrvaparayoreko guṇa ādeśaḥ syāt / upendraḥ / gaṅgodakam //
body.translated_text: When a vowel (<s>ac</s>) follows after the <s>a</s>-sound, a single <s>guṇa</s> substitute replaces the preceding and following [sounds]. <s>Upendraḥ</s>. <s>Gaṅgodakam</s>.
In an <s>upadeśa</s>, a nasal vowel is an <s>it</s>. (VLk 28 = P 1.3.2)

body.text: upadeśe 'nunāsiko 'jitsaṃjñaḥ syāt / pratijñānunāsikyāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ / laṇsūtrasthāvarṇena sahoccāryamāṇo repho ralayoḥ saṃjñā //
body.translated_text: In an <s>upadeśa</s> (original enunciation), a nasalized vowel (<s>ac</s>) is designated <s>it</s>. 'Nasalization is by convention' — [so say] the <s>Pāṇinīyas</s>. The <s>ra</s> sound uttered together with the <s>a</s>-vowel in the <s>laṇ</s>-<s>sūtra</s> is the designation of <s>ra</s> and <s>la</s>.
After <s>ṛ</s>, <s>aṇ</s> [is substituted] followed by <s>r</s>. (VLk 29 = P 1.1.51)

body.text: ṛ iti triṃśataḥ saṃjñetyuktam / tatsthāne yo 'ṇ sa raparaḥ sanneva pravartate / kṛṣṇarddhiḥ / tavalkāraḥ //
body.translated_text: It has been stated that <s>ṛ</s> is the designation of thirty [sounds]. The <s>aṇ</s> substitute that replaces it operates only when followed by <s>r</s>. <s>Kṛṣṇarddhiḥ</s>. <s>Tavalkāraḥ</s>.
Elision according to <s>Śākalya</s>. (VLk 30 = P 8.3.19)
The <s>ya</s> and <s>va</s> at the end of a <s>pada</s>, preceded by an <s>a</s>-sound, optionally undergo elision when a sound in <s>aś</s> follows.
The preceding is treated as not having taken effect (<s>asiddha</s>). (VLk 31 = P 8.2.1)

body.text: sapādasaptādhyāyīṃ prati tripādyasiddhā, tripādyāmapi pūrvaṃ prati paraṃ śāstramasiddham / hara iha, harayiha / viṣṇa iha, viṣṇaviha //
body.translated_text: With respect to the first seven and a quarter chapters, the last three quarters are treated as not having taken effect; and within the last three quarters, the later rule is treated as not having taken effect with respect to the earlier. <s>Hara iha</s>, <s>harayiha</s>. <s>Viṣṇa iha</s>, <s>viṣṇaviha</s>.
<s>Ā</s> and <s>aic</s> (<s>ai</s>, <s>au</s>) are [designated] <s>vṛddhi</s>. (VLk 32 = P 1.1.1)
<s>Ā</s> and <s>aic</s> are designated <s>vṛddhi</s>.
<s>Vṛddhi</s> [replaces <s>a</s>] before <s>ec</s> (<s>e</s>, <s>o</s>, <s>ai</s>, <s>au</s>). (VLk 33 = P 6.1.88)

body.text: ādeci pare vṛddhirekādeśaḥ syāt / guṇāpavādaḥ / kṛṣṇaikatvam / gaṅgaughaḥ / devaiśvaryam / kṛṣṇautkaṇṭhyam //
body.translated_text: When <s>ec</s> follows after <s>a</s>, a single <s>vṛddhi</s> substitute [replaces both]. This overrides (<s>apavāda</s>) the <s>guṇa</s> rule. <s>Kṛṣṇaikatvam</s>. <s>Gaṅgaughaḥ</s>. <s>Devaiśvaryam</s>. <s>Kṛṣṇautkaṇṭhyam</s>.
Before <s>eti</s>, <s>edhati</s>, and <s>ūṭh</s>. (VLk 34 = P 6.1.89)

body.text: avarṇādejādyoretyedhatyorūṭhi ca pare vṛddhirekādeśaḥ syāt / upaiti / upaidhate / praṣṭhauhaḥ / ejādyoḥ kim ? upetaḥ / mā bhavānpredidhat / (

children.translated_text: (The inclusion of <s>akṣa</s>-<s>ūhanyā</s> is to be mentioned
(And optionally in a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> compound with a third-case [member]

children.text: ) / sukhena ṛtaḥ sukhārtaḥ / tṛtīyeti kim ? paramartaḥ / (
children.translated_text: ). Pleased by happiness — <s>sukhārtaḥ</s>. Why [the restriction to] 'third-case'? <s>Paramartaḥ</s>.

body.translated_text: After an <s>a</s>-sound, before the <s>ej</s>-initial [roots] <s>eti</s> and <s>edhati</s>, and before <s>ūṭh</s>, a single <s>vṛddhi</s> substitute [applies]. <s>Upaiti</s>. <s>Upaidhate</s>. <s>Praṣṭhauhaḥ</s>. Why [the restriction to] <s>ej</s>-initial? <s>Upetaḥ</s>. Let not <s>predidhat</s> [be affected].
The <s>upasargas</s> (preverbs) [are so called] when connected with a verb. (VLk 35 = P 1.4.59)

body.text: prādayaḥ kriyāyoge upasargasaṃjñāḥ syuḥ / pra parā apa sam anu ava nis nira dus dura vi āṅ ni adhi api ati su ut abhi prati para upi - ete prādayaḥ //
body.translated_text: The particles beginning with <s>pra</s>, when connected with a verbal action, are designated <s>upasarga</s>. <s>Pra</s>, <s>parā</s>, <s>apa</s>, <s>sam</s>, <s>anu</s>, <s>ava</s>, <s>nis</s>, <s>nira</s>, <s>dus</s>, <s>dura</s>, <s>vi</s>, <s>āṅ</s>, <s>ni</s>, <s>adhi</s>, <s>api</s>, <s>ati</s>, <s>su</s>, <s>ut</s>, <s>abhi</s>, <s>prati</s>, <s>para</s>, <s>upi</s> — these are the particles beginning with <s>pra</s>.
<s>Bhū</s> and the rest are <s>dhātus</s> (verbal roots). (VLk 36 = P 1.3.1)
Words denoting action, beginning with <s>bhū</s>, are designated <s>dhātu</s> (verbal root).
After an <s>upasarga</s>, before a <s>dhātu</s> beginning with <s>ṛ</s>. (VLk 37 = P 6.1.91)

body.text: avarṇāntādupasargāddakārādau dhātau pare vṛddhirekādeśaḥ syāt / prārcchati //

body.translated_text: <s>ṅamo hrasvādaci ṅamuṇ nityam</s> // (VLk 89 = P 8.3.32) //

body.text: hrasvātpare yo ṅam tadantaṃ yatpadaṃ tasmātparasyāco ṅamuṭ / pratyaṅṅātmā / sugaṇṇīśaḥ / sannacyutaḥ //
body.translated_text: After a word ending in <s>ṅam</s> (nasal) preceded by a short vowel, the augment <s>ṅamuṭ</s> is obligatorily inserted before a following vowel (<s>ac</s>). [Examples:] '<s>pratyaṅṅātmā</s>' / '<s>sugaṇṇīśaḥ</s>' / '<s>sannacyutaḥ</s>.'
<s>samaḥ suṭi</s> // (VLk 90 = P 8.3.5) //
The <s>s</s> of <s>sam</s> becomes <s>ru</s> before <s>suṭ</s>.
<s>atrānunāsikaḥ pūrvasya tuvā</s> // (VLk 91 = P 8.3.2) //
In this context of the <s>ru</s>-operation, <s>r</s> optionally makes the preceding [vowel] nasal.
<s>anunāsikātparo 'nusvāraḥ</s> // (VLk 92 = P 8.3.4) //
After a nasal vowel, excluding [when] <s>r</s> [follows], an <s>anusvāra</s> augment [is inserted] after the preceding [vowel].
<s>kharavasānayorvisarjanīyaḥ</s> // (VLk 93 = P 8.3.15) //

body.text: khari avasāne ca padāntasāya rephasya visargaḥ /

children.translated_text: (It should be stated: 'of <s>sam</s>, <s>pum</s>, and <s>kā</s>, [the result is] <s>s</s>')

body.translated_text: Before a <s>khar</s> consonant and at the end [of an utterance], a word-final <s>s</s>'s <s>repha</s> becomes <s>visarga</s>.
<s>pumaḥ khayyampare</s> // (VLk 94 = P 8.3.6) //

body.text: ampare khayi pumo ruḥ / puṃskokilaḥ, puṃskokilaḥ //
body.translated_text: Before <s>khay</s> followed by <s>am</s>, <s>pum</s> [takes] <s>ru</s>. [Examples:] '<s>puṃskokilaḥ</s>,' '<s>puṃskokilaḥ</s>.'
<s>naśchavyapraśān</s> // (VLk 95 = P 8.3.7) //

body.text: ampare chavi nāntasya padasyaruḥ; na tu praśānśabdasya //
body.translated_text: Before <s>chav</s>, a word ending in <s>n</s> does not [take] <s>ru</s>; but not [in the case of] the word <s>praśān</s>.
<s>visarjanīyasya saḥ</s> // (VLk 96 = P 8.3.34) //

body.text: khari / cakriṃstrāyasva, cakriṃstrāyasva / apraśān kim ? praśāntanoti / padasyeti kim ? hanti //
body.translated_text: Before <s>khar</s>. [Examples:] '<s>cakriṃstrāyasva</s>,' '<s>cakriṃstrāyasva</s>.' Why 'excluding <s>praśān</s>'? [Counter-example:] '<s>praśāntanoti</s>.' Why 'of a word (<s>pada</s>)'? [Counter-example:] '<s>hanti</s>.'
The [<s>n</s> of] <s>nṝn</s> optionally [takes] <s>ru</s> before <s>p</s>.

body.text: kupvoḥ eka epau ca // VLk_98 = P_8,3.37 //
body.translated_text: <s>kupvoḥ eka epau ca</s> // (VLk 98 = P 8.3.37) //

body.text: kavarge pavarge ca visargasya eka epau staḥ, cādvisargaḥ / nṝṃ pāhi, nṝṃḥ pāhi, nṝṃḥ pāhi / nṝn pāhi //
body.translated_text: Before <s>ka</s>-class and <s>pa</s>-class, <s>visarga</s> optionally becomes <s>eka</s> (jihvāmūlīya) or <s>epa</s> (upadhmānīya), and also [remains as] <s>visarga</s>. [Examples:] '<s>nṝṃ pāhi</s>,' '<s>nṝṃḥ pāhi</s>,' '<s>nṝṃḥ pāhi</s>' / '<s>nṝn pāhi</s>.'
<s>tasya paramāmreḍitam</s> // (VLk 99 = P 8.1.2) //
The second part of a reduplicated [expression] is called <s>āmreḍita</s>.
<s>kānāmreḍite</s> // (VLk 100 = P 8.3.12) //
The <s>n</s> of <s>kān</s> becomes <s>ru</s> before <s>āmreḍita</s>. [Examples:] '<s>kāṃskān</s>,' '<s>kāṃskān</s>.'
Before <s>cha</s>, a short vowel [takes] the augment <s>tuk</s>. [Example:] '<s>śivacchāyā</s>.'
<s>padāntādvā</s> // (VLk 102 = P 6.1.79) //

body.text: dīrghāt padāntāt che tugvā / lakṣmīcchāyā, lakṣmī chāyā //
body.translated_text: After a long [vowel] at the end of a word, before <s>cha</s>, <s>tuk</s> is optional. [Examples:] '<s>lakṣmīcchāyā</s>,' '<s>lakṣmī chāyā</s>.'
Thus [ends] consonant sandhi (<s>hal-sandhi</s>).
Now, <s>visarga</s>-sandhi.
<s>visarjanīyasya saḥ</s> // (VLk 103 = P 8.3.34) //
Before <s>khar</s> [consonants]. [Example:] '<s>viṣṇustrātā</s>.'

body.text: śari visargasya visargo vā / hariḥ śete, hariśśete //
body.translated_text: Before <s>śar</s> consonants, <s>visarga</s> optionally [remains as] <s>visarga</s>. [Examples:] '<s>hariḥ śete</s>,' '<s>hariśśete</s>.'
<s>samajuṣo ruḥ</s> // (VLk 105 = P 8.2.66) //
A word-final <s>s</s>, and [the <s>s</s> of] <s>sajuṣ</s>, becomes <s>ru</s>.
<s>ato roraplutādaplutādaplute</s> // (VLk 106 = P 6.1.113) //
After a non-prolated <s>a</s>, a following <s>r</s> (from <s>ru</s>) becomes <s>u</s> before a non-prolated [vowel]. [Example:] '<s>śivor'cyaḥ</s>.'
Likewise. [Example:] '<s>śivo vandyaḥ</s>.'

body.text: bho bhago agho apūrvasya yo 'śi // VLk_108 = P_8,3.17 //
body.translated_text: <s>bho bhago agho apūrvasya yo 'śi</s> // (VLk 108 = P 8.3.17) //

body.text: etatpūrvasya roryādeśo 'śi / devā iha, devāyiha / bhos bhagos aghos iti sāntā nipātāḥ / teṣāṃ roryatve kṛte //
body.translated_text: The <s>y</s>-substitute of <s>r</s> [applies when] preceded by these [<s>bho</s>, <s>bhago</s>, <s>agho</s>], before <s>aś</s> (vowels and soft consonants). [Examples:] '<s>devā iha</s>,' '<s>devāyiha</s>.' <s>Bhos</s>, <s>bhagos</s>, <s>aghos</s> are indeclinables ending in <s>s</s>. When their <s>r</s> (from <s>ru</s>) has become <s>y</s> —
<s>hali sarveṣām</s> // (VLk 109 = P 8.3.22) //

body.text: bhobhagoaghoapūrvasya yasya lopaḥ syāddhali / bho devāḥ / bhago namaste / agho yāhi //
body.translated_text: The <s>y</s> preceded by <s>bho</s>, <s>bhago</s>, or <s>agho</s> is elided before a <s>hal</s> consonant. [Examples:] '<s>bho devāḥ</s>' / '<s>bhago namaste</s>' / '<s>agho yāhi</s>.'

body.text: ahno rephādeśo na tu supi / aharahaḥ / ahargaṇaḥ //
body.translated_text: The <s>repha</s>-substitute of <s>ahan</s> [occurs] except before <s>sup</s> (case endings). [Examples:] '<s>aharahaḥ</s>' / '<s>ahargaṇaḥ</s>.'
A <s>repha</s> is elided when another <s>repha</s> follows.
<s>ḍhralope pūrvasya dīrgho 'ṇaḥ</s> // (VLk 112 = P 6.3.111) //

body.text: ḍharephayorlopanimittayoḥ pūrvasyāṇo dīrghaḥ / punā ramate / harī ramyaḥ / śambhū rājate / aṇaḥ kim ? tṛḍhaḥ / vṛḍhaḥ / manas ratha ityatra rutve kṛte haśi cetyutve rorīti lope ca prāpte //
body.translated_text: When the elision of <s>ḍha</s> or <s>repha</s> [has occurred as] the occasion, the preceding <s>aṇ</s> vowel is lengthened. [Examples:] '<s>punā ramate</s>' / '<s>harī ramyaḥ</s>' / '<s>śambhū rājate</s>.' Why 'of <s>aṇ</s>'? [Counter-examples:] '<s>tṛḍhaḥ</s>' / '<s>vṛḍhaḥ</s>.' In '<s>manas ratha</s>' — here, after <s>ru</s>-substitution, when both '<s>haśi ca</s>' (<s>u</s>-substitution) and '<s>ro ri</s>' (elision of <s>r</s>) are applicable —
<s>vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāryam</s> // (VLk 113 = P 1.4.2) //

body.text: tulyabalavirodhe paraṃ kāryaṃ syāt / iti lope prāpte / pūrvatrāsiddhamiti rorītyasyāsiddhatvādutvameva / manorathaḥ //
body.translated_text: In a conflict of equal strength, the later rule prevails. Thus, when elision is applicable — [but] because of '<s>pūrvatrāsiddham</s>' (a prior rule is non-existent [for a later rule]), the rule '<s>ro ri</s>' being treated as non-existent, <s>u</s>-substitution alone [applies]. [Result:] '<s>manorathaḥ</s>.'
<s>etattadoḥ sulopo 'koranañsamāse hali</s> // (VLk 114 = P 6.1.132) //

body.text: akakārayoretattadoryaḥ sustasya lopo hali na tu nañsamāse / eṣa viṣṇuḥ / sa śambhuḥ / akoḥ kim ? eṣako rudraḥ / anañsamāse kim ? asaḥ śivaḥ / hali kim ? eṣo 'tra //
body.translated_text: Of <s>etat</s> and <s>tat</s>, when not ending in <s>ak</s> vowels, the <s>su</s>-ending is elided before a <s>hal</s> consonant, but not in a <s>nañ</s>-compound. [Examples:] '<s>eṣa viṣṇuḥ</s>' / '<s>sa śambhuḥ</s>.' Why 'not ending in <s>ak</s>'? [Counter-example:] '<s>eṣako rudraḥ</s>.' Why 'not in a <s>nañ</s>-compound'? [Counter-example:] '<s>asaḥ śivaḥ</s>.' Why 'before <s>hal</s>'? [Counter-example:] '<s>eṣo 'tra</s>.'
<s>so 'ci lope cetpādapūraṇam</s> // (VLk 115 = P 6.1.134) //

body.text: sa ityasya sorlopaḥ syādaci pādaścellope satyeva pūryyeta / semāmaviḍḍhi prabhṛtim / saiṣa dāśarathī rāmaḥ //
body.translated_text: The <s>s</s> of <s>sa</s> is elided before a vowel (<s>ac</s>), if the [metrical] foot would be filled by the elision. [Examples:] '<s>semāmaviḍḍhi</s>' and so forth / '<s>saiṣa dāśarathī rāmaḥ</s>.'
Thus [ends] <s>visarga</s>-sandhi.
Thus [ends] the section on the five [types of] sandhi.
Now, among the six genders, vowel-ending masculine [stems]:
<s>arthavadadhāturapratyayaḥ prātipadikam</s> // (VLk 116 = P 1.2.45) //

body.text: dhātuṃ pratyayaṃ pratyayāntaṃ ca varjayitvā arthavacchabdasvarūpaṃ prātipadikasaṃjñaṃ syāt //
body.translated_text: Excluding roots (<s>dhātu</s>), suffixes (<s>pratyaya</s>), and suffix-ending [forms], a meaningful word-form is designated <s>prātipadika</s> (nominal stem).
<s>kṛttaddhitasamāsāśca</s> // (VLk 117 = P 1.2.46) //
[Forms] ending in <s>kṛt</s> or <s>taddhita</s> [suffixes], and compounds (<s>samāsa</s>), are likewise [<s>prātipadikas</s>].
<s>svaujasamauṭchaṣṭābhyāmbhisṅebhyāmbhyasṅasibhyāmbhyasṅasosāmṅyossup</s> (VLk 118 = P 4.1.2) //

body.text: su au jas iti prathamā / am auṭ śas iti dvitīyā / ṭā bhyām bhis iti tṛtīyā / ṅe bhyām bhyas iti caturthī / ṅasi bhyām bhyas iti pañcamī / ṅas os ām iti ṣaṣṭhī / ṅi os sup iti saptamī //
body.translated_text: <s>su</s>, <s>au</s>, <s>jas</s> — [these are] the nominative (first [case]). <s>Am</s>, <s>auṭ</s>, <s>śas</s> — [these are] the accusative (second). <s>Ṭā</s>, <s>bhyām</s>, <s>bhis</s> — [these are] the instrumental (third). <s>Ṅe</s>, <s>bhyām</s>, <s>bhyas</s> — [these are] the dative (fourth). <s>Ṅasi</s>, <s>bhyām</s>, <s>bhyas</s> — [these are] the ablative (fifth). <s>Ṅas</s>, <s>os</s>, <s>ām</s> — [these are] the genitive (sixth). <s>Ṅi</s>, <s>os</s>, <s>sup</s> — [these are] the locative (seventh).
<s>ṅyāpprātipadikāt</s> // (VLk 119 = P 4.1.1) //
<s>pratyayaḥ</s> // (VLk 120 = P 3.1.1) //

body.text: ityadhikṛtya / ṅyantādābantātprātipadikācca pare svādayaḥ pratyayāḥ syuḥ //
body.translated_text: Having taken these as governing rules: from a [stem] ending in <s>ṅī</s> or <s>āp</s>, and from a <s>prātipadika</s>, the [case-endings] <s>su</s> and the rest are [affixed] as subsequent suffixes.
The three <s>sup</s> [case-ending groups] are three numbers (<s>vacana</s>): singular (<s>ekavacana</s>), dual (<s>dvivacana</s>), and plural (<s>bahuvacana</s>) designations, respectively.
For duality and singularity, dual and singular [are the designations]. (P 1.4.22)
These [dual and singular designations] apply when there is duality and singularity [of the referent].
Cessation (<s>virāma</s>) is termination (<s>avasāna</s>). (P 1.4.110)
The absence of phonemes receives the designation <s>avasāna</s> (termination). [Examples of pauses:] <s>rutva</s> and <s>visarga</s>.
Of forms having the same appearance (<s>sarūpa</s>), one remainder [is retained] when the case-ending is the same. (P 1.2.64)

body.text: ekavibhaktau yāni sarūpāṇyeva dṛṣṭāni teṣāmeka eva śiṣyate //
body.translated_text: When forms that are identical in appearance are seen with the same case-ending, only one is retained.
In the first and [second], homogeneous lengthening of the prior [vowel occurs]. (P 6.1.102)

body.text: akaḥ prathamādvitīyayoraci pūrvasavarṇadīrgha ekādeśaḥ syāt / iti prāpte //
body.translated_text: When the first or second [vowel of the a-class] is followed by a vowel, the substitute should be a long vowel homogeneous with the prior. This being expected —
Not when [the second element] begins with a vowel of the a-class. (P 6.1.104)
When [the second element] begins with a vowel of the a-class, homogeneous lengthening does not apply. <s>Vṛddhi</s> [applies] when followed by <s>e</s>. [Example:] <s>rāmau</s>.
For many, the plural. (P 1.4.21)
When plurality is intended to be expressed, the plural number should be used.
<s>cu</s> and <s>ṭu</s> [are <s>it</s> markers]. (P 1.3.7)
The initial <s>cu</s> and <s>ṭu</s> of a suffix are <s>it</s> (indicatory) markers.
<s>Vibhakti</s> (case-ending) also [receives that designation]. (P 1.4.104)
<s>Sup</s> and <s>tiṅ</s> receive the designation <s>vibhakti</s> (inflectional ending).
In a <s>vibhakti</s>, <s>tu</s>, <s>s</s>, and <s>ma</s> [are not <s>it</s>]. (P 1.3.4)

body.text: vibhaktisthāstavargasamā netaḥ / iti sasya nettvam / rāmāḥ //
body.translated_text: The <s>t</s>-class letters standing in a <s>vibhakti</s> and the <s>s</s>-class equivalents are not <s>it</s> markers. Thus, the <s>s</s> [of <s>jas</s>] does not become <s>it</s>. [Example:] <s>rāmāḥ</s>.
The singular of [the nominative in] the vocative is called <s>sambuddhi</s>. (P 2.3.49)
In the vocative (<s>sambodhana</s>), the singular of the first [case-ending] should receive the designation <s>sambuddhi</s>.
That from which a suffix is prescribed, and what begins with it, is called <s>aṅga</s> (stem) before that suffix. (P 1.4.13)

body.text: yaḥ pratyayo yasmāt kriyate tadādiśabdasvarūpaṃ tasminnaṅgaṃ syāt //
body.translated_text: The word-form beginning with that [base] from which a suffix is derived — before that suffix, it should be [called] <s>aṅga</s> (stem).
After [stems ending in] <s>eṅ</s> or a short [vowel], the <s>hal</s> [of <s>sambuddhi</s> is elided]. (P 6.1.69)

body.text: eṅantāddhrasvāntāccāṅgāddhallupyate sambuddheścet / he rāma / he rāmau / he rāmāḥ //
body.translated_text: After a stem ending in <s>eṅ</s> or a short [vowel], the <s>hal</s> [consonant, i.e. <s>s</s>] is elided when <s>sambuddhi</s> follows. [Examples:] <s>he rāma</s> / <s>he rāmau</s> / <s>he rāmāḥ</s>.
Before <s>am</s> [suffixes], the prior [form is retained]. (P 6.1.107)
When an a-class [vowel is followed] by <s>am</s> [suffixes] before a vowel, the prior form is the single substitute. [Examples:] <s>rāmam</s> / <s>rāmau</s>.
<s>la</s>, <s>śa</s>, <s>ku</s> [are <s>it</s> markers of suffixes] except in <s>taddhita</s>. (P 1.3.8)
The initial <s>la</s>, <s>śa</s>, and <s>ku</s>-class [letters] of suffixes other than <s>taddhita</s> should be <s>it</s> markers.
After that [homogeneous lengthening], the <s>s</s> of <s>śas</s> becomes <s>n</s> in the masculine. (P 6.1.103)

body.text: pūrvasavarṇadīrghātparo yaḥ śasaḥ sastasya naḥ syātpuṃsi //
body.translated_text: After homogeneous lengthening, the <s>s</s> that follows, which belongs to <s>śas</s> — its <s>s</s> becomes <s>n</s> in the masculine.
[The change applies] even with the intervention of <s>aṭ</s>, <s>ku</s>-class, <s>pu</s>-class, <s>āṅ</s>, or <s>num</s>. (P 8.4.2)

body.text: aṭ kavargaḥ pavargaḥ āṅ num etairvyastairyathāsaṃbhavaṃ militaiśca vyavadhāne 'pi raṣābhyāṃ parasya nasya ṇaḥ samānapade / iti prāpte //
body.translated_text: <s>Aṭ</s>, <s>ka</s>-class, <s>pa</s>-class, <s>āṅ</s>, and <s>num</s> — even when these intervene, separately or combined as the case may be, the <s>n</s> following <s>r</s> or <s>ṣ</s> becomes <s>ṇ</s> within the same word. This being expected —
[But not] at the end of a word (<s>pada</s>). (P 8.4.37)
The <s>ṇa</s>-change of <s>n</s> does not [apply at the end of a word]. [Example:] <s>rāmān</s>.
<s>Ṭā</s>, <s>ṅas</s>, <s>iṅ</s>, <s>as</s>, <s>ām</s>, <s>in</s>, <s>āt</s>, <s>syā</s> [are substitutes]. (P 7.1.12)
For stems ending in <s>a</s>, the substitutes <s>ṭā</s> and the rest become <s>in</s> and the rest. <s>Ṇatva</s> [applies]. [Example:] <s>rāmeṇa</s>.
And before a <s>sup</s> [ending]. (P 7.3.102)
Before a <s>sup</s> beginning with <s>yañ</s>, the final of a stem [ending in <s>a</s>] becomes long. [Example:] <s>rāmābhyām</s>.
After [a stem ending in] <s>a</s>, <s>ais</s> replaces <s>bhis</s>. (P 7.1.9)
[This is a] multi-segment replacement of the whole. [Example:] <s>rāmaiḥ</s>.
<s>Ya</s> [replaces] <s>ṅe</s>. (P 7.1.13)
After a stem [ending in <s>a</s>], <s>ya</s> replaces <s>ṅe</s> and the rest.
A substitute is like the original (<s>sthānivat</s>), except in operations dependent on the original. (P 1.1.56)

body.text: ādeśaḥ sthānivatsyānna tu sthānyalāśrayavidhau / iti sthānivattvāt supi ceti dīrghaḥ / rāmāya / rāmābhyām //
body.translated_text: A substitute behaves like the original, except in operations that depend on the original. Thus, by this principle of substitute-equivalence, the lengthening by 'and before a <s>sup</s>' [applies]. [Examples:] <s>rāmāya</s> / <s>rāmābhyām</s>.
In the plural, <s>e</s> [replaces the final] when [the ending begins with] <s>jhal</s>. (P 7.3.103)

body.text: jhalādau bahuvacane supyato 'ṅgasyaikāraḥ / rāmebhyaḥ / supi kim ? pacadhvam //
body.translated_text: Before a plural <s>sup</s> beginning with <s>jhal</s>, the final of a stem [ending in <s>a</s>] becomes <s>e</s>. [Example:] <s>rāmebhyaḥ</s>. Why [only] before <s>sup</s>? [Because of the restriction:] <s>pacadhvam</s> [is not affected].
Optionally at the end [of an utterance]. (P 8.4.56)

body.text: avasāne jhalāṃ caro vā / rāmāt, rāmād / rāmābhyām / rāmebhyaḥ / rāmasya //
body.translated_text: At the end [of an utterance], <s>jhal</s> consonants optionally become <s>car</s>. [Examples:] <s>rāmāt</s>, <s>rāmād</s> / <s>rāmābhyām</s> / <s>rāmebhyaḥ</s> / <s>rāmasya</s>.
And before <s>os</s>. (P 7.3.104)
The final of a stem [ending in <s>a</s>] becomes <s>e</s>. [Example:] <s>rāmayoḥ</s>.
<s>Nuṭ</s> is augmented after a short [vowel], <s>nadī</s>, and <s>āp</s>. (P 7.1.54)
After a stem ending in a short [vowel], a <s>nadī</s>-ending, or an <s>āp</s>-ending, <s>nuṭ</s> is augmented to the following <s>ām</s>.
Before <s>nām</s> [i.e. before an ending beginning with <s>n</s>]. (P 6.4.3)

For a pronoun, <s>smai</s> [replaces <s>ṅe</s>]. (P 7.1.14)

body.translated_text: After [a stem] ending in an <s>a</s>-class vowel, <s>suṭ</s> is augmented to the <s>ām</s> prescribed for a pronoun. The <s>e</s>-change and <s>ṣa</s>-change [apply]. [Example:] <s>sarveṣām</s> / <s>sarvasmin</s> / The rest is like <s>rāma</s>. Thus <s>viśva</s> and the like, which are also <s>a</s>-ending [stems, are declined similarly].
<s>Pūrva</s>, <s>para</s>, <s>avara</s>, <s>dakṣiṇa</s>, <s>uttara</s>, <s>apara</s>, <s>adhara</s> — when denoting arrangement, not as proper names. (P 1.1.34)

body.text: eteṣāṃ vyavasthāyāmasaṃjñāyāṃ ca sarvanāmasaṃjñā gaṇasūtrātsarvatra yā prāptā sā jasi vā syāt / pūrve, pūrvāḥ / asaṃjñāyāṃ kim ? uttarāḥ kuravaḥ / svābhidheyāpekṣāvadhiniyamo vyavasthā / vyavasthāyāṃ kim ? dakṣiṇā gāthakāḥ, kuśalā ityarthaḥ //
body.translated_text: For these [words], the pronoun designation that would apply everywhere from the class-enumeration (<s>gaṇasūtra</s>), when [used] in the sense of arrangement and when not a proper name — that [designation] optionally applies before <s>jas</s>. [Examples:] <s>pūrve</s>, <s>pūrvāḥ</s>. Why 'not as a proper name'? [Example:] <s>uttarāḥ kuravaḥ</s> (the northern <s>Kurus</s>). The restriction to arrangement relative to one's own referent's boundary is <s>vyavasthā</s> (arrangement). Why 'in arrangement'? [Example:] <s>dakṣiṇā gāthakāḥ</s> — meaning 'skilled.'
<s>Sva</s> — when not denoting relatives or wealth. (P 1.1.35)

body.text: jñātidhanānyavācinaḥ svaśabdasya prāptā saṃjñā jasi vā / sve, svāḥ; ātmīyāḥ, ātmāna iti vā / jñātidhanavācinastu, svāḥ; jñātayor'thā vā //
body.translated_text: For the word <s>sva</s> when not denoting relatives or wealth, the applicable pronoun designation optionally [applies] before <s>jas</s>. [Examples:] <s>sve</s>, <s>svāḥ</s> — meaning 'one's own' or 'selves.' But when denoting relatives or wealth: <s>svāḥ</s> — meaning 'relatives' or 'wealth.'
<s>Antara</s> — in [the senses of] external and undergarment. (P 1.4.36)

body.text: bāhye paridhānīye cārthe 'ntaraśabdasya prāptā saṃjñā jasi vā / antare, antarā vā gṛhāḥ; bāhyā ityarthaḥ / antare, antarā vā śāṭakāḥ; paridhānīyā ityarthaḥ //
body.translated_text: In the senses of 'external' and 'garment to be worn,' the applicable pronoun designation of the word <s>antara</s> optionally [applies] before <s>jas</s>. [Examples:] <s>antare</s> or <s>antarā gṛhāḥ</s> — meaning 'external houses'; <s>antare</s> or <s>antarā śāṭakāḥ</s> — meaning 'garments to be worn.'
Optionally for the nine beginning with <s>pūrva</s>. (P 7.1.16)

body.text: ebhyo ṅasiṅyoḥ smātsminau vā staḥ / pūrvasmāt, pūrvāt / pūrvasmin, pūrve / evaṃ parādīnām / śeṣaṃ sarvavat //

<s>Prathama</s>, <s>carama</s>, <s>taya</s>, <s>alpa</s>, <s>arddha</s>, <s>katipaya</s>, <s>nema</s> — and [these too]. (P 1.1.33)

<s>Jaras</s> or <s>jarā</s> optionally [replaces <s>jarā</s>]. (P 7.2.101)

Substitutes apply to what is being denoted.

body.translated_text: Before a <s>vibhakti</s> beginning with a vowel. (paribhāṣā:)
After a long [vowel], not before <s>jas</s>. (P 6.1.105)

<s>Suṭ</s> [and the first five case-endings are <s>sarvanāmasthāna</s>] for non-neuter [stems]. (P 1.1.43)

Before <s>su</s> and the rest, when not a <s>sarvanāmasthāna</s> [= before the remaining case-endings]. (P 1.4.17)

body.text: ākārānto yo dhātustadantasya bhasyāṅgasya lopaḥ / alo 'ntyasya / viśvapaḥ / viśvapā / viśvapābhyāmityādi / evaṃ śaṅkhadhmādayaḥ / dhātoḥ kim ? hāhān //

[Example:] <s>viśvapaḥ</s> / <s>viśvapā</s> / <s>viśvapābhyām</s> and the rest. Likewise <s>śaṅkhadhma</s> and the rest. Why 'of a dhātu'? [Counter-example:] <s>hāhān</s>.
And before <s>jas</s>. (P 7.3.109)
The final of a stem ending in a short [vowel] undergoes <s>guṇa</s>. [Example:] <s>harayaḥ</s>.
<s>Guṇa</s> of a short [vowel]. (P 7.3.108)

The sound preceding the final (<s>antya</s>) <s>al</s> (phoneme) receives the designation <s>upadhā</s>.

A single-sound suffix is <s>apṛkta</s> (unjoined). (P 1.2.41)

<s>Vṛddhi</s> of a vowel-ending [stem] before <s>ñ</s>-marked and <s>ṇ</s>-marked [suffixes]. (P 7.2.115)

body.text: ajantāṅgasya vṛddhirñiti ṇiti ca pare / sakhāyau / sakhāyaḥ / he sakhe / sakhāyam / sakhāyau / sakhīn / sakhyā / sakhye //

After [the stems ending in] <s>khi</s> and <s>ti</s> — (VLk 183 = P 6.1.112)

body.text: khitiśabdābhyāṃ khītīśabdābhyāṃ kṛtayaṇādeśābhyāṃ parasya ṅasiṅasorata uḥ / sakhyuḥ //
body.translated_text: After the two stems <s>khi</s> and <s>ti</s> — i.e. the two stems <s>khī</s> and <s>tī</s> with the <s>yaṇ</s> substitution applied — the case-endings <s>ṅasi</s>, <s>ṅas</s>, and <s>os</s> are replaced by <s>uḥ</s>. [Example:] <s>sakhyuḥ</s> (of a friend).

body.text: itaḥ parasya ṅeraut / sakhyau / śeṣaṃ harivat //

<s>Pati</s> [gets the <s>ghi</s> designation] only in a compound. (VLk 185 = P 1.4.8)

body.text: ghisaṃjñaḥ / patyuḥ 2 / patyau / śeṣaṃ harivat / samāse tu bhūpataye /

<s>Bahu</s>, <s>gaṇa</s>, <s>vatu</s>, <s>ḍati</s>, and numeral [words] — (VLk 186 = P 1.1.23)
and <s>ḍati</s>. (VLk 187 = P 1.1.25)
