<s>pūrvo 'bhyāsaḥ</s> // (VLk 397 = P 6.1.4) //

body.text: atra ye dve vihite tayoḥ pūrvo 'bhyāsasaṃjñaḥ syāt //
body.translated_text: Of the two [syllables] prescribed here, the prior one receives the designation <s>abhyāsa</s> (reduplicative syllable).
<s>halādiḥ śeṣaḥ</s> // (VLk 398 = P 7.4.60) //

body.text: abhyāsasyādirhal śiṣyate anye halo lupyante / iti valopaḥ //
body.translated_text: Of the <s>abhyāsa</s>, only the initial consonant (<s>hal</s>) is retained; the other consonants are elided. Thus the <s>v</s> is elided.
The vowel (<s>ac</s>) of the <s>abhyāsa</s> becomes short.
<s>bhavateraḥ</s> // (VLk 400 = P 7.4.73) //
The <s>o</s>-vowel of the <s>abhyāsa</s> of <s>bhavati</s> [i.e., <s>bhū</s>] becomes <s>a</s> before <s>liṭ</s>.
<s>abhyāse carca</s> // (VLk 401 = P 8.4.54) //

body.text: abhyāse jhalāṃ caraḥ syurjaśaśca / jhaśāṃ jaśaḥ khayāṃ cara iti vivekaḥ / babhūva / babhuvatuḥ / babhūvuḥ //
body.translated_text: In the <s>abhyāsa</s>, <s>jhal</s> consonants become <s>car</s>, and <s>jaś</s> [substitutions apply]. The distinction is: <s>jhaś</s> consonants [become] <s>jaś</s>; <s>khay</s> consonants [become] <s>car</s>. [Examples:] '<s>babhūva</s>' / '<s>babhuvatuḥ</s>' / '<s>babhūvuḥ</s>.'
The <s>liṭ</s>-substitute of <s>tiṅ</s> receives the designation <s>ārdhadhātuka</s>.
<s>ārdhadhātukasyeḍvalādeḥ</s> // (VLk 403 = P 7.2.35) //

body.text: valāderārdhadhāturasyeḍāgamaḥ syāt / babhūvitha / babhūvathuḥ / babhūva / babhūva / babhūviva / babhūvima /
body.translated_text: An <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> [suffix] beginning with <s>val</s> [consonant] receives the augment <s>iṭ</s>. [Examples:] '<s>babhūvitha</s>' / '<s>babhūvathuḥ</s>' / '<s>babhūva</s>' / '<s>babhūva</s>' / '<s>babhūviva</s>' / '<s>babhūvima</s>.'
<s>anadyatane luṭ</s> // (VLk 404 = P 3.3.15) //
For a verbal root denoting future action not of today, <s>luṭ</s> (the periphrastic future) applies.
<s>syatāsī ḷluṭoḥ</s> // (VLk 405 = P 3.1.33) //

children.text: etau pratyayau sto ḷluṭoḥ parataḥ / śabādyapavādaḥ /
children.translated_text: these two suffixes are [attached] after <s>ḷ</s> and <s>luṭ</s> respectively. [This] supersedes [the suffixes taught] from <s>śap</s> onward.

body.translated_text: After the verbal root,
<s>ārdhadhātukaṃ śeṣaḥ</s> // (VLk 406 = P 2.4.114) //

body.text: tiṅśidbhyo 'nyo dhātoriti vihitaḥ pratyaya etatsaṃjñaḥ syāt / iṭ //
body.translated_text: A suffix other than <s>tiṅ</s> and <s>śit</s>, prescribed for a verbal root, receives this designation (<s>ārdhadhātuka</s>). [Thus,] <s>iṭ</s> [is inserted].
<s>luṭaḥ prathamasya ḍāraurasaḥ</s> // (VLk 407 = P 2.4.85) //

children.translated_text: these [replace] the first-person [endings] in order. By the force of the <s>ḍ</s>-marker, the <s>ṭer</s>-elision (<s>ṭi</s>-portion elision) also [applies]. [Example:] '<s>bhavitā</s>.'

body.translated_text: <s>tāsastyorlopaḥ</s> // (VLk 408 = P 7.4.50) //

body.text: tāserasteśca sasya lopassyāt sādau pratyaye pare /
body.translated_text: The <s>s</s> of <s>tāsi</s> and <s>asti</s> is elided when a suffix beginning with <s>s</s> follows.

body.text: rādau pratyaye tathā / bhavitārau / bhavitāraḥ / bhavitāsi / bhavitāsthaḥ / bhavitāstha / bhavitāsmi / bhavitāsvaḥ / bhavitāsmaḥ/
body.translated_text: Before a suffix beginning with <s>r</s> likewise. [Full paradigm:] '<s>bhavitārau</s>' / '<s>bhavitāraḥ</s>' / '<s>bhavitāsi</s>' / '<s>bhavitāsthaḥ</s>' / '<s>bhavitāstha</s>' / '<s>bhavitāsmi</s>' / '<s>bhavitāsvaḥ</s>' / '<s>bhavitāsmaḥ</s>.'
<s>ḷṭ śeṣe ca</s> // (VLk 410 = P 3.3.13) //

body.text: bhaviṣyadarthāddhātorḷṭ kriyārthāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ satyāmasatyāṃ vā / s ya iṭ / bhaviṣyati / bhaviṣyataḥ / bhaviṣyanti / bhaviṣyasi / bhaviṣyathaḥ / bhaviṣyatha / bhaviṣyāmi / bhaviṣyāvaḥ / bhaviṣyāmaḥ/

children.translated_text: For meanings such as injunction and the like, <s>loṭ</s> (the imperative) [applies] from the verbal root.

body.translated_text: From a verbal root expressing future meaning, <s>ḷṭ</s> (the simple future) [applies], whether the action is purposive or not. [With] <s>s</s> + <s>ya</s> + <s>iṭ</s>: [Full paradigm:] '<s>bhaviṣyati</s>' / '<s>bhaviṣyataḥ</s>' / '<s>bhaviṣyanti</s>' / '<s>bhaviṣyasi</s>' / '<s>bhaviṣyathaḥ</s>' / '<s>bhaviṣyatha</s>' / '<s>bhaviṣyāmi</s>' / '<s>bhaviṣyāvaḥ</s>' / '<s>bhaviṣyāmaḥ</s>.'
<s>āśiṣi liṅloṭau</s> // (VLk 412 = P 3.3.173) //
The <s>i</s>-vowel of <s>loṭ</s> [ending] becomes <s>u</s>. [Example:] '<s>bhavatu</s>.'
<s>tuhyostātaṅṅāśiṣyanyatarasyām</s> // (VLk 414 = P 7.1.35) //

In benediction (<s>āśis</s>), <s>tu</s> and <s>hi</s> optionally [receive the substitute] <s>tātaṅ</s>. Being a complete substitute by virtue of being later [in the derivation]. [Example:] '<s>bhavatāt</s>.'
<s>loṭo laṅvat</s> // (VLk 415 = P 3.4.85) //
Of <s>loṭ</s>, the [endings] <s>tām</s> and the rest, and <s>s</s>-elision [apply as in <s>laṅ</s>].
<s>tasthasthamipāṃ tāṃtaṃtāmaḥ</s> // (VLk 416 = P 3.4.101) //
For the four [endings] that are <s>ṅit</s>, <s>tām</s> and the rest [apply] in order. [Examples:] '<s>bhavatām</s>' / '<s>bhavantu</s>.'
<s>serhyapicca</s> // (VLk 417 = P 3.4.87) //
Of <s>loṭ</s>, for <s>si</s>, [the substitute is] <s>hi</s>; and it is also <s>pit</s>.

body.text: ataḥ parasya herluk / bhava / bhavatāt / bhavatam / bhavata /
body.translated_text: After <s>a</s>, <s>hi</s> undergoes <s>luk</s> (complete elision). [Examples:] '<s>bhava</s>' / '<s>bhavatāt</s>' / '<s>bhavatam</s>' / '<s>bhavata</s>.'
For <s>mi</s> of <s>loṭ</s>, [the substitute is] <s>ni</s>.
<s>āḍuttamasya picca</s> // (VLk 420 = P 3.4.92) //

body.text: loḍuttamasyāṭ syāt picca / hinyorutvaṃ na, ikāroccāraṇa sāmarthyāt //
body.translated_text: For the last person (<s>uttama</s>) of <s>loṭ</s>, <s>āṭ</s> [is prefixed]; and it is also <s>pit</s>. The <s>u</s>-substitution of <s>hi</s> and <s>ni</s> does not [apply], by the force of the <s>i</s>-vowel pronunciation [in the marker].
<s>te prāgdhātoḥ</s> // (VLk 421 = P 1.4.80) //
Those [words] having the designations <s>gati</s> and <s>upasarga</s> are to be used only before the verbal root.

body.text: upasargasithānnimittātparasya loḍādeśasyānītyasya nasya ṇaḥ syāt / prabhavāṇi

children.translated_text: It should be stated that the <s>upasarga</s>-status is to be denied for <s>dur</s> [regarding] <s>ṣatva</s> and <s>ṇatva</s>) / '<s>duḥsthitiḥ</s>' / '<s>durbhavāni</s>' / (
It should be stated that the word <s>antar</s> has <s>upasarga</s>-status for the purposes of <s>āṅ</s>-rule, injunction, and <s>ṇatva</s> —

body.translated_text: After an <s>upasarga</s> or <s>sitha</s>-ending [stem], the <s>n</s> of the <s>loṭ</s>-substitute <s>āni</s> becomes <s>ṇ</s>. [Example:] '<s>prabhavāṇi</s>.'
<s>nityaṃ ṅitaḥ</s> // (VLk 423 = P 3.4.99) //

body.text: sakārāntasya ṅiduttamasya nityaṃ lopaḥ / alo 'ntyasyeti salopaḥ / bhavāva / bhavāma /
body.translated_text: The elision of a <s>ṅit</s> last-person [ending] ending in <s>s</s> is obligatory. By [the rule] 'of the final sound' — the <s>s</s> is elided. [Examples:] '<s>bhavāva</s>' / '<s>bhavāma</s>.'
<s>anadyatane laṅ</s> // (VLk 424 = P 3.2.111) //

body.text: anadyatana bhūtārtha vṛtter dhātor laṅ syāt //
body.translated_text: For a verbal root denoting past action not of today, <s>laṅ</s> (the imperfect) applies.
<s>luṅlaṅḷṅkṣvaḍudāttaḥ</s> // (VLk 425 = P 6.4.71) //
In these [tenses], the augment <s>aṭ</s> [is prefixed] to the stem.

body.text: ṅito lasya parasmaipadamikārāntaṃ yattadantasya lopaḥ / abhavat / abhavatām / abhavan / abhavaḥ / abhavatam / abhavata / abhavam / abhavāva / abhavāma //
body.translated_text: Of a <s>ṅit</s> <s>la</s>-substitute, whatever <s>parasmaipada</s> [ending] ends in <s>i</s> — the final of that is elided. [Full paradigm:] '<s>abhavat</s>' / '<s>abhavatām</s>' / '<s>abhavan</s>' / '<s>abhavaḥ</s>' / '<s>abhavatam</s>' / '<s>abhavata</s>' / '<s>abhavam</s>' / '<s>abhavāva</s>' / '<s>abhavāma</s>.'
<s>vidhinimantraṇāmantraṇādhīṣṭasaṃpraśnaprārthaneṣu liṅ</s> // (VLk 427 = P 3.3.161) //
In the meanings of injunction, invitation, address, command, inquiry, and entreaty, <s>liṅ</s> (the optative) [applies] from the verbal root.
<s>yāsuṭ parasmaipadeṣūdātto ṅicca</s> // (VLk 428 = P 3.4.103) //
For the <s>parasmaipada</s> [endings] of <s>liṅ</s>, the augment <s>yāsuṭ</s> [is inserted]; and it is <s>ṅit</s>.
<s>liṅaḥ salopo 'nantyasya</s> // (VLk 429 = P 7.2.79) //
The <s>s</s> of the <s>sārvadhātuka liṅ</s> [suffix], not being the final [sound], is elided. When this is applicable —
<s>ato yeyaḥ</s> // (VLk 430 = P 7.2.80) //

body.text: ataḥ parasya sārvadhātukāvayavasya yās ityasya iy / guṇaḥ //
body.translated_text: After <s>a</s>, the <s>sārvadhātuka</s> component <s>yās</s> [becomes] <s>iy</s>. <s>Guṇa</s> [applies].
<s>lopo vyorvali</s> // (VLk 431 = P 6.1.66) //
[Examples:] '<s>bhavet</s>' / '<s>bhavetām</s>.'

body.text: liṅo jherjus syāt / bhaveyuḥ / bhaveḥ / bhavetam / bhaveta / bhaveyam / bhaveva / bhavema //
body.translated_text: Of <s>liṅ</s>, <s>jhi</s> becomes <s>jus</s>. [Full paradigm:] '<s>bhaveyuḥ</s>' / '<s>bhaveḥ</s>' / '<s>bhavetam</s>' / '<s>bhaveta</s>' / '<s>bhaveyam</s>' / '<s>bhaveva</s>' / '<s>bhavema</s>.'
In benediction (<s>āśis</s>), the <s>tiṅ</s>-substitutes of <s>liṅ</s> receive the designation <s>ārdhadhātuka</s>.

body.text: āśiṣi liṅo yāsuṭ kit / skoḥ saṃyogādyoriti salopaḥ //
body.translated_text: In benediction, <s>yāsuṭ</s> of <s>liṅ</s> is <s>kit</s>. By [the rule] 'of conjunct-initial <s>s</s> and <s>k</s>' — the <s>s</s> is elided.

body.text: gitkinṅinnimitte iglakṣaṇe guṇavṛddhī na staḥ / bhūyāt / bhūyāstām / bhūyāsuḥ / bhūyāḥ / bhūyāstam / bhūyāsta / bhūyāsam / bhūyāsva / bhūyāsma /
body.translated_text: Before <s>git</s>, <s>kit</s>, or <s>ṅit</s> [suffixes], <s>guṇa</s> and <s>vṛddhi</s> — which are conditioned by <s>ik</s> [vowels] — do not apply. [Full paradigm:] '<s>bhūyāt</s>' / '<s>bhūyāstām</s>' / '<s>bhūyāsuḥ</s>' / '<s>bhūyāḥ</s>' / '<s>bhūyāstam</s>' / '<s>bhūyāsta</s>' / '<s>bhūyāsam</s>' / '<s>bhūyāsva</s>' / '<s>bhūyāsma</s>.'
For a verbal root denoting past meaning, <s>luṅ</s> (the aorist) applies.
[This] supersedes all [other] <s>lakāras</s>.
<s>smottare laṅ ca</s> // (VLk 438 = P 3.3.176) //
When <s>sma</s> follows, after <s>mā</s>, both <s>laṅ</s> and <s>luṅ</s> [may apply].
[This] supersedes [the suffixes taught] from <s>śap</s> onward.
[The marker] <s>ic</s> [is dropped, leaving <s>s</s>]; both are <s>it</s>-markers.
<s>gātisthāpābhūbhyaḥ sicaḥ parasmaipadeṣu</s> // (VLk 441 = P 2.4.77) //

body.text: ebhyaḥ sico luk syāt / gāpāviheṇādeśapibatī gṛhyate //
body.translated_text: After these [roots: <s>gā</s>, <s>sthā</s>, <s>pā</s>, <s>bhū</s>], <s>sic</s> undergoes <s>luk</s> (complete elision) in <s>parasmaipada</s>. <s>Gā</s> and <s>pā</s> here denote the substitutes of <s>iṇ</s> and <s>pibati</s>.
<s>bhūsuvostiṅi</s> // (VLk 442 = P 7.3.88) //

body.text: bhū sū etayoḥ sārvadhātuke tiṅi pare guṇo na / abhūt / abhūtām / abhūvan / abhūḥ / abhūtam / abhūta / abhūvam / abhūva / abhūma /
body.translated_text: For <s>bhū</s> and <s>sū</s>, before a <s>sārvadhātuka tiṅ</s> ending, <s>guṇa</s> does not [apply]. [Full paradigm:] '<s>abhūt</s>' / '<s>abhūtām</s>' / '<s>abhūvan</s>' / '<s>abhūḥ</s>' / '<s>abhūtam</s>' / '<s>abhūta</s>' / '<s>abhūvam</s>' / '<s>abhūva</s>' / '<s>abhūma</s>.'
<s>na māṅyoge</s> // (VLk 443 = P 6.4.74) //

body.text: aḍāṭau na staḥ / mā bhavān bhūt / mā sma bhavat / mā sma bhūt //
body.translated_text: The augments <s>aṭ</s> do not [apply in conjunction with <s>mā</s>]. [Examples:] '<s>mā bhavān bhūt</s>' / '<s>mā sma bhavat</s>' / '<s>mā sma bhūt</s>.'
<s>liṅnimitte ḷṅ kriyātipattau</s> // (VLk 444 = P 3.3.139) //

body.text: hetuhetumadbhāvādi liṅnimittaṃ tatra bhaviṣyatyarthe ḷṅ syāt kriyāyā aniṣpattau gamyamānāyām / abhaviṣyat / abhaviṣyatām / abhaviṣyan / abhaviṣyaḥ / abhaviṣyatam / abhaviṣyata / abhaviṣyam / abhaviṣyāva / abhaviṣyāma / suvṛṣṭiścedabhaviṣyattadā subhikṣamabhaviṣyat, ityādi jñeyam //
body.translated_text: Where the conditions for <s>liṅ</s> — such as the relation of cause and effect — obtain, and the meaning is future, <s>ḷṅ</s> (the conditional) applies when non-accomplishment of the action is understood. [Full paradigm:] '<s>abhaviṣyat</s>' / '<s>abhaviṣyatām</s>' / '<s>abhaviṣyan</s>' / '<s>abhaviṣyaḥ</s>' / '<s>abhaviṣyatam</s>' / '<s>abhaviṣyata</s>' / '<s>abhaviṣyam</s>' / '<s>abhaviṣyāva</s>' / '<s>abhaviṣyāma</s>' / [Example sentence:] 'If there had been good rainfall, there would have been abundance' — and so forth, to be understood.

body.text: abhyāsasyāderato dīrghaḥ syāt / āta / ātatuḥ / ātuḥ / ātitha / ātathuḥ / āta / āta / ātiva / ātima / atitā / atiṣyati / atatu //
body.translated_text: The initial [vowel] <s>a</s> of the <s>abhyāsa</s> becomes long. [Full paradigm:] '<s>āta</s>' / '<s>ātatuḥ</s>' / '<s>ātuḥ</s>' / '<s>ātitha</s>' / '<s>ātathuḥ</s>' / '<s>āta</s>' / '<s>āta</s>' / '<s>ātiva</s>' / '<s>ātima</s>' / '<s>atitā</s>' / '<s>atiṣyati</s>' / '<s>atatu</s>.'
<s>āḍajādīnām</s> // (VLk 446 = P 6.4.72) //

body.text: ajāderaṅgasyāṭ luṅlaṅḷṅkṣu / ātat / atet / atyāt / atyāstām / luṅi sici iḍāgame kṛte --- .
body.translated_text: For a vowel-initial stem, the augment <s>āṭ</s> [applies] in <s>luṅ</s>, <s>laṅ</s>, and <s>ḷṅ</s>. [Examples:] '<s>ātat</s>' / '<s>atet</s>' / '<s>atyāt</s>' / '<s>atyāstām</s>.' In <s>luṅ</s>, after <s>sic</s>, when <s>iṭ</s>-augment has been applied:
<s>astisico 'pṛkte</s> // (VLk 447 = P 7.3.96) //
For the <s>apṛkta</s> (single-sound) <s>hal</s> [consonant] following an existing <s>sic</s> or <s>asti</s>, the augment <s>īṭ</s> [is inserted].

body.text: iṭaḥ parasya sasya lopaḥ syādīṭi pare / (

children.translated_text: It should be stated: <s>sic</s>-elision [when there is] a single substitute.)

body.translated_text: The <s>s</s> following <s>iṭ</s> is elided when <s>īṭ</s> follows. (
<s>sijabhyastavidibhyaśca</s> // (VLk 449 = P 3.4.109) //

body.text: sico 'bhyastādvideśca parasya ṅitsaṃbandhino jherjus / ātiṣuḥ / ātīḥ / ātiṣṭam / ātiṣṭa / ātiṣam / ātiṣva / ātiṣma / ātiṣyat //
body.translated_text: After <s>sic</s>, after a reduplicated [stem], and after <s>vid</s>, the <s>ṅit</s>-related <s>jhi</s> [becomes] <s>jus</s>. [Full paradigm:] '<s>ātiṣuḥ</s>' / '<s>ātīḥ</s>' / '<s>ātiṣṭam</s>' / '<s>ātiṣṭa</s>' / '<s>ātiṣam</s>' / '<s>ātiṣva</s>' / '<s>ātiṣma</s>' / '<s>ātiṣyat</s>.'
<s>hrasvaṃ laghu</s> // (VLk 450 = P 1.4.10) //
<s>saṃyoge guru</s> // (VLk 451 = P 1.4.11) //
A short [vowel] followed by a conjunct [consonant] is heavy (<s>guru</s>).
<s>dīrghaṃ ca</s> // (VLk 452 = P 1.4.12) //
[A long vowel] is also heavy.
<s>pugantalaghūpadhasya ca</s> // (VLk 453 = P 7.3.86) //

body.text: pugantasya laghūpadhasya cāṅgasyeko guṇaḥ sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ / dhātvāderiti saḥ / sedhati / ṣatvam / siṣedha //
body.translated_text: A stem ending in <s>puk</s> or having a light penultimate (<s>upadhā</s>) undergoes <s>guṇa</s> before <s>sārvadhātuka</s> and <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> [suffixes]. 'The initial of the verbal root' — that [is the <s>ik</s> vowel that undergoes <s>guṇa</s>]. [Examples:] '<s>sedhati</s>' / [After] <s>ṣatva</s>: '<s>siṣedha</s>.'
<s>asaṃyogālliṭ kit</s> // (VLk 454 = P 1.2.5) //

body.text: asaṃyogātparo 'pilliṭ kit syāt / siṣidhatuḥ / siṣidhuḥ / siṣedhitha / siṣidhathuḥ / siṣidha / siṣedha / siṣidhiva / siṣidhima / sedhitā / sedhiṣyati / sedhatu / asedhat / sedhet / sidhyāt / asedhīt / asedhiṣyat / evam --
body.translated_text: [Sūtra:] 'When not after a conjunct, the following <s>liṭ</s> [augment] that is <s>kit</s> [applies].' [Examples:] <s>siṣidhatuḥ</s> (perfect dual). <s>siṣidhuḥ</s> (perfect plural). <s>siṣedhitha</s> (perfect 2nd singular). <s>siṣidhathuḥ</s> (perfect 2nd dual). <s>siṣidha</s> (perfect 2nd plural). <s>siṣedha</s> (perfect 1st singular). <s>siṣidhiva</s> (perfect 1st dual). <s>siṣidhima</s> (perfect 1st plural). <s>sedhitā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>sedhiṣyati</s> (simple future). <s>sedhatu</s> (imperative). <s>asedhat</s> (imperfect). <s>sedhet</s> (optative). <s>sidhyāt</s> (benedictive). <s>asedhīt</s> (aorist). <s>asedhiṣyat</s> (conditional). Likewise —
[Sūtra:] '<s>ner gadanadapatapadaghumāsyatihantiyātivātidrātipsātivapativahatiśāmyati cinotidegdhiṣu ca</s>' (VLk 455 = P 8.4.17)

body.text: upasargasthānnimittātparasya nernasya ṇo gadādiṣu pareṣu / praṇigadati //
body.translated_text: The <s>n</s> of the prefix <s>ni</s>, when triggered by the conditions [previously stated], becomes <s>ṇ</s> when followed by <s>gada</s> and the other [roots listed]. [Example:] <s>praṇigadati</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>kuhoś cuḥ</s>' (VLk 456 = P 7.4.62)
In the reduplicative syllable, <s>ku</s>-class and <s>ha</s> are replaced by <s>ca</s>-class consonants.
[Sūtra:] '<s>ata upadhāyāḥ</s>' (VLk 457 = P 7.2.116)

body.text: upadhāyā ato vṛddhiḥ syāt ñiti ṇiti ca pratyaye pare / jagāda / jagadatuḥ / jagaduḥ / jagaditha / jagadathuḥ / jagada //
body.translated_text: The penultimate <s>a</s> undergoes <s>vṛddhi</s> when a <s>ñit</s> or <s>ṇit</s> affix follows. [Examples:] <s>jagāda</s> (perfect 3rd singular). <s>jagadatuḥ</s> (perfect 3rd dual). <s>jagaduḥ</s> (perfect 3rd plural). <s>jagaditha</s> (perfect 2nd singular). <s>jagadathuḥ</s> (perfect 2nd dual). <s>jagada</s> (perfect 2nd plural).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṇal uttamo vā</s>' (VLk 458 = P 7.1.91)

body.text: uttamo ṇal vā ṇitsyāt / jagāda, jagada / jagadiva / jagadima / gaditā / gadiṣyati / gadatu / agadat / gadet / gadyāt //
body.translated_text: The first person <s>ṇal</s> ending is optionally <s>ṇit</s>. [Examples:] <s>jagāda</s> or <s>jagada</s> (perfect 1st singular). <s>jagadiva</s> (perfect 1st dual). <s>jagadima</s> (perfect 1st plural). <s>gaditā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>gadiṣyati</s> (simple future). <s>gadatu</s> (imperative). <s>agadat</s> (imperfect). <s>gadet</s> (optative). <s>gadyāt</s> (benedictive).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ato hala āder laghoḥ</s>' (VLk 459 = P 7.2.7)

body.text: halāderlaghorakārasya vṛddhirveḍādau parasmaipade sici / agādīt, agadīt / agadiṣyat //
body.translated_text: For a [root that is] light, beginning with a consonant, and having <s>a</s> [as vowel] — <s>vṛddhi</s> [of the root vowel applies] when <s>sic</s> is followed by [endings beginning with] <s>veṭ</s> in <s>parasmaipada</s>. [Examples:] <s>agādīt</s> or <s>agadīt</s> (aorist). <s>agadiṣyat</s> (conditional).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṇo naḥ</s>' (VLk 460 = P 6.1.65)

The initial <s>ṇ</s> of a verbal root becomes <s>n</s>. The roots with initial <s>ṇ</s> in the <s>upadeśa</s> are: <s>ṇard</s>, <s>ṇāṭ</s>, <s>ṇāth</s>, <s>ṇādh</s>, <s>ṇand</s>, <s>ṇakk</s>, <s>ṇṝ</s>, <s>ṇṛt</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>upasargād asamāse 'pi ṇopadeśasya</s>' (VLk 461 = P 8.4.14)

body.text: upasargasthānnimittātparasya dhātornasya ṇaḥ / praṇadati / praṇinadati / nadati / nanāda //
body.translated_text: The <s>n</s> of a root whose original form has <s>ṇ</s> becomes <s>ṇ</s> when preceded by a trigger in a prefix, even outside a compound. [Examples:] <s>praṇadati</s>. <s>praṇinadati</s>. <s>nadati</s> (sounds). <s>nanāda</s> (perfect 3rd singular).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ata ekahalmadhye 'nādeśāder liṭi</s>' (VLk 462 = P 6.4.120)

body.text: liṇnimittādeśādikaṃ na bhavati yadaṅgaṃ tadavayavasyāsaṃyuktahalmadhyasthasyāta etvamabhyāsalopaśca kiti liṭi / nedatuḥ / neduḥ //
body.translated_text: When a <s>liṭ</s> affix follows, and the stem does not begin with a substitute — of the <s>a</s> standing between single consonants that is part of that stem, <s>e</s>-replacement and reduplicative-syllable deletion [occur] when the affix is <s>kit</s>. [Examples:] <s>nedatuḥ</s> (perfect 3rd dual). <s>neduḥ</s> (perfect 3rd plural).
[Sūtra:] '<s>thali ca seṭi</s>' (VLk 463 = P 6.4.121)

body.text: prāguktaṃ syāt / neditha / nedathuḥ / neda / nanāda, nanada / nediva / nedima / naditā / nadiṣyati / nadatu / anadat / nadet / nadyāt / anādīt, anadīt / anadiṣyat //
body.translated_text: The same [<s>e</s>-replacement] applies [before <s>thal</s> with <s>iṭ</s>]. [Examples:] <s>neditha</s> (perfect 2nd singular). <s>nedathuḥ</s> (perfect 2nd dual). <s>neda</s> (perfect 2nd plural). <s>nanāda</s> or <s>nanada</s> (perfect 1st singular). <s>nediva</s> (perfect 1st dual). <s>nedima</s> (perfect 1st plural). <s>naditā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>nadiṣyati</s> (simple future). <s>nadatu</s> (imperative). <s>anadat</s> (imperfect). <s>nadet</s> (optative). <s>nadyāt</s> (benedictive). <s>anādīt</s> or <s>anadīt</s> (aorist). <s>anadiṣyat</s> (conditional).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ādir ñi-ṭu-ḍavaḥ</s>' (VLk 464 = P 1.3.5)
In the <s>upadeśa</s> (original listing), the initial <s>ñi</s>, <s>ṭu</s>, and <s>ḍu</s> of a root are <s>it</s> (indicatory markers).
[Sūtra:] '<s>idito num dhātoḥ</s>' (VLk 465 = P 7.1.58)

body.text: nandati / nananda / nanditā / nandiṣyati / nandatu / anandat / nandet / nandyāt / anandīt / anandiṣyat / arca pūjāyām // 9 // arcati //
body.translated_text: [A root marked with] <s>i</s> as <s>it</s> takes the <s>num</s> augment. [Examples:] <s>nandati</s> (rejoices). <s>nananda</s> (perfect). <s>nanditā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>nandiṣyati</s> (simple future). <s>nandatu</s> (imperative). <s>anandat</s> (imperfect). <s>nandet</s> (optative). <s>nandyāt</s> (benedictive). <s>anandīt</s> (aorist). <s>anandiṣyat</s> (conditional). <s>arca</s> — [means] worship. (Root 9) <s>arcati</s> (worships).
[Sūtra:] '<s>tasmān nuḍ dvihalaḥ</s>' (VLk 466 = P 7.4.71)

body.text: dvihalo dhātordīrghībhūtātparasya nuṭ syāt / ānarca / ānarcatuḥ / arcitā / arciṣyati / arcatu / ārcat / arcet / arcyāt / ārcīt / ārciṣyat //

children.text: gatau // 10 // vrajati / vavrāja / vrajitā / vrajiṣyati / vrajatu / avrajat / vrajet / vrajyāt //

body.translated_text: After the lengthened [vowel] of a root with two consonants, <s>nuṭ</s> augment [is inserted in the reduplicative syllable]. [Examples:] <s>ānarca</s> (perfect 3rd singular). <s>ānarcatuḥ</s> (perfect 3rd dual). <s>arcitā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>arciṣyati</s> (simple future). <s>arcatu</s> (imperative). <s>ārcat</s> (imperfect). <s>arcet</s> (optative). <s>arcyāt</s> (benedictive). <s>ārcīt</s> (aorist). <s>ārciṣyat</s> (conditional).
[Sūtra:] '<s>vad-vraja-halantasyācaḥ</s>' (VLk 467 = P 7.2.3)

body.text: eṣāmaco vṛddhiḥ sici parasmaipadeṣu / avrājīt / avrajiṣyat //

children.text: varṣāvaraṇayoḥ // 11 // kaṭati / cakāṭa / cakaṭatuḥ / kaṭitā / kaṭiṣyati / kaṭatu / akaṭat / kaṭet / kaṭyāt //
children.translated_text: [means] rain and covering. (Root 11) <s>kaṭati</s> (rains/covers). <s>cakāṭa</s> (perfect 3rd singular). <s>cakaṭatuḥ</s> (perfect 3rd dual). <s>kaṭitā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>kaṭiṣyati</s> (simple future). <s>kaṭatu</s> (imperative). <s>akaṭat</s> (imperfect). <s>kaṭet</s> (optative). <s>kaṭyāt</s> (benedictive).

body.translated_text: For these [roots <s>vad</s>, <s>vraja</s>, and consonant-ending roots], the <s>a</s>-vowel undergoes <s>vṛddhi</s> before <s>sic</s> in <s>parasmaipada</s> [endings]. [Examples:] <s>avrājīt</s> (aorist). <s>avrajiṣyat</s> (conditional).
[Sūtra:] '<s>hmyanta-kṣaṇa-śvasa-jāgṛṇi-śvy-editām</s>' (VLk 468 = P 7.2.5)

body.text: hamayāntasya kṣaṇāderṇyantasya śvayatereditaśca vṛddhirneḍādau sici / akaṭīt / akaṭiṣyat //
body.translated_text: For a root ending in <s>ha</s>, <s>ma</s>, or <s>ya</s>, for <s>kṣaṇa</s> and the following [roots], for <s>ṇy</s>-ending roots, for <s>śvayati</s>, and for one marked with <s>e</s> as <s>it</s> — <s>vṛddhi</s> does not apply when <s>sic</s> beginning with <s>veṭ</s> follows. [Examples:] <s>akaṭīt</s> (aorist). <s>akaṭiṣyat</s> (conditional).
[Sūtra:] '<s>gupū-dhūpa-vicchi-paṇi-panibhya āyaḥ</s>' (VLk 469 = P 3.1.28)
From these [roots <s>gup</s>, <s>dhūp</s>, <s>vicch</s>, <s>paṇ</s>, <s>pan</s>], the affix <s>āya</s> is added in the same sense [as the root].
[Sūtra:] '<s>sanādy-antā dhātavaḥ</s>' (VLk 470 = P 3.1.32)

body.text: sanādayaḥ kamerṇiṅantāḥ pratyayā ante yeṣāṃ te dhātusaṃjñakāḥ / dhātutvāllaḍādayaḥ / gopāyati //
body.translated_text: Those [stems] ending in [affixes from] <s>san</s> up to <s>kamer ṇiṅ</s> are designated as verbal roots. Because of [this] root-status, <s>laṭ</s> and other [verbal affixes apply]. [Example:] <s>gopāyati</s> (guards).
[Sūtra:] '<s>āyādaya ārdhadhātuke vā</s>' (VLk 471 = P 3.1.31)

children.translated_text: (<s>Vārttika</s>:) 'For a polysyllabic root, <s>ām</s> should be prescribed.'
In the <s>liṭ</s>, because <s>ām</s> is prescribed for <s>āsa</s> and <s>kāsa</s> [type roots], the <s>masya</s> [rule for <s>m</s>-replacement] does not apply.

body.translated_text: When an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> affix is intended, <s>āya</s> and the other [affixes] are optionally applied.
[Sūtra:] '<s>ato lopaḥ</s>' (VLk 472 = P 6.4.48)
When an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> affix follows, the <s>a</s> of an <s>a</s>-ending stem [that is so] in the <s>upadeśa</s> is deleted before an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> [affix].
[Sūtra:] '<s>āmaḥ</s>' (VLk 473 = P 2.4.81)
The affix following <s>ām</s> undergoes <s>luk</s> (deletion).
[Sūtra:] '<s>kṛñ cānuprayujyate liṭi</s>' (VLk 474 = P 3.1.40)
After the <s>ām</s>-ending [stem], <s>kṛ</s>, <s>bhū</s>, and <s>as</s> are used as auxiliaries with <s>liṭ</s> [endings]. For these, reduplication and so forth [apply].
[Sūtra:] '<s>urat</s>' (VLk 475 = P 7.4.66)

body.text: abhyāsaṛvarṇasyāt pratyaye / raparaḥ / halādiḥ śeṣaḥ / vṛddhiḥ / gopāyāñcakāra / dvitvātparatvādyaṇi prāpte ----- .
body.translated_text: The <s>ṛ</s>-vowel of the reduplicative syllable becomes <s>a</s> when followed by an affix [beginning with a vowel]. [It is] followed by <s>r</s>. The remainder begins with a consonant. <s>Vṛddhi</s> [applies]. [Example:] <s>gopāyāñcakāra</s> (periphrastic perfect). When, due to reduplication, <s>yaṇ</s> would apply by the rule of subsequent application —
[Sūtra:] '<s>dvirvacane 'ci</s>' (VLk 476 = P 1.1.59)

body.text: dvitvanimitte 'ci aca ādeśo na dvitve kartavye / gopāyāñcakratuḥ //
body.translated_text: When reduplication is the operation to be performed, a vowel substitute [that would trigger it] is not [treated as having taken effect]. [Example:] <s>gopāyāñcakratuḥ</s> (periphrastic perfect 3rd dual).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ekāc upadeśe 'nudāttāt</s>' (VLk 477 = P 7.2.10)

children.translated_text: A root that is monosyllabic and <s>anudātta</s> (unaccented) in the <s>upadeśa</s> — from such a root, the <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> affix does not take <s>iṭ</s>.
and <s>vṛṅ</s> and <s>vṛñ</s> — excluding these, [those that are] monosyllabic among the vowel-ending roots are designated [as <s>aniṭ</s>].

body.text:
kānteṣu śaklekaḥ / cānteṣu pacmucricvacvicsicaḥ ṣaṭ / chānteṣu pracchekaḥ / jānteṣu tyajnijirbhajbhañjbhujbhrasjmasjyajyujruj rañjvijirsvañjsañjsṛjaḥ pañcadaśa // dānteṣu adkṣudkhidchidtud nudpadyabhidvidyativinadvindśadsadsvidyaskandhadaḥ ṣoḍaśa / dhānteṣu krudhkṣudhbudhyabandhyudhrudhrādhvyadhsādhśudhsidhyā ekādaśa / nānteṣu manyahanī dvau / pānteṣu āpchupkṣiptaptiptṛpyadṛpyalipalupvapśapsvap sṛpastrayodaśa / bhānteṣu yabhrabhlabhastrayaḥ / mānteṣu gamyamnamramaścatvāraḥ / śānteṣu kraśdaṃśdiśdṛśmṛśriśruśliśviśspṛśo daśa / ṣānteṣu kṛṣ tviṣtuṣdviṣpuṣyapiṣviṣśiṣśuṣśliṣyā ekādaśa // sānteṣu ghasvasatī dvau / hānteṣu dahdihduhnahmihruhlihvaho 'ṣṭau /
 anudāttā halanteṣu dhātavastryadhikaṃ śatam /
gopāyāñcakartha / gopāyāñcakrathuḥ / gopāyāñcakra / gopāyāñcakāra / gopāyāñcakara / gopāyāñcakṛva / gopāyāñcakṛma / gopāyāmbabhūva, gopāyāmāsa / jugopa / jugupatuḥ / jugupuḥ //
body.translated_text:
Among <s>ka</s>-ending roots, <s>śak</s> alone [is <s>aniṭ</s>]. Among <s>ca</s>-ending roots, <s>pac</s>, <s>muc</s>, <s>ric</s>, <s>vac</s>, <s>vic</s>, <s>sic</s> — six. Among <s>cha</s>-ending roots, <s>pracch</s> alone. Among <s>ja</s>-ending roots, <s>tyaj</s>, <s>nij</s>, <s>ir</s>, <s>bhaj</s>, <s>bhañj</s>, <s>bhuj</s>, <s>bhrasj</s>, <s>masj</s>, <s>yaj</s>, <s>yuj</s>, <s>ruj</s>, <s>rañj</s>, <s>vij</s>, <s>ir</s>, <s>svañj</s>, <s>sañj</s>, <s>sṛj</s> — fifteen. Among <s>da</s>-ending roots, <s>ad</s>, <s>kṣud</s>, <s>khid</s>, <s>chid</s>, <s>tud</s>, <s>nud</s>, <s>pad</s>, <s>yabhid</s>, <s>vid</s>, <s>yati</s>, <s>vinad</s>, <s>vind</s>, <s>śad</s>, <s>sad</s>, <s>svid</s>, <s>yaskand</s>, <s>had</s> — sixteen. Among <s>dha</s>-ending roots, <s>krudh</s>, <s>kṣudh</s>, <s>budh</s>, <s>ya</s>, <s>bandh</s>, <s>yudh</s>, <s>rudh</s>, <s>rādh</s>, <s>vyadh</s>, <s>sādh</s>, <s>śudh</s>, <s>sidhyā</s> — eleven. Among <s>na</s>-ending roots, <s>man</s> and <s>han</s> — two. Among <s>pa</s>-ending roots, <s>āp</s>, <s>chup</s>, <s>kṣip</s>, <s>tap</s>, <s>tip</s>, <s>tṛp</s>, <s>yadṛpya</s>, <s>lip</s>, <s>alup</s>, <s>vap</s>, <s>śap</s>, <s>svap</s>, <s>sṛp</s> — thirteen. Among <s>bha</s>-ending roots, <s>yabh</s>, <s>rabh</s>, <s>labh</s> — three. Among <s>ma</s>-ending roots, <s>gam</s>, <s>yam</s>, <s>nam</s>, <s>ram</s> — four. Among <s>śa</s>-ending roots, <s>kraś</s>, <s>daṃś</s>, <s>diś</s>, <s>dṛś</s>, <s>mṛś</s>, <s>riś</s>, <s>ruś</s>, <s>liś</s>, <s>viś</s>, <s>spṛś</s> — ten. Among <s>ṣa</s>-ending roots, <s>kṛṣ</s>, <s>tviṣ</s>, <s>tuṣ</s>, <s>dviṣ</s>, <s>puṣ</s>, <s>yapiṣ</s>, <s>viṣ</s>, <s>śiṣ</s>, <s>śuṣ</s>, <s>śliṣyā</s> — eleven. Among <s>sa</s>-ending roots, <s>ghas</s>, <s>vas</s>, <s>at</s> — two. Among <s>ha</s>-ending roots, <s>dah</s>, <s>dih</s>, <s>duh</s>, <s>nah</s>, <s>mih</s>, <s>ruh</s>, <s>lih</s>, <s>vah</s> — eight.
The <s>anudātta</s> consonant-ending roots [total] one hundred and three.
[Sūtra:] '<s>svarati-sūti-sūyati-dhūñ-ūdito vā</s>' (VLk 478 = P 7.2.44)

body.text: svaratyāderūditaśca parasya valāderārdhadhātukasyeḍ vā syāt / jugopitha, jugoptha / gopāyitā, gopitā, goptā / gopāyiṣyati, gopiṣyati, gopsyati / gopāyatu / agopāyat / gopāyet / gopāyyāt, gupyāt / agopāyīt //
body.translated_text: For <s>svarati</s> and the following [roots], and for roots marked with <s>ū</s> as <s>it</s>, the <s>iṭ</s> augment is optionally applied to the following <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> [affix] beginning with <s>val</s>. [Examples:] <s>jugopitha</s> or <s>jugoptha</s> (perfect 2nd singular). <s>gopāyitā</s>, <s>gopitā</s>, or <s>goptā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>gopāyiṣyati</s>, <s>gopiṣyati</s>, or <s>gopsyati</s> (simple future). <s>gopāyatu</s> (imperative). <s>agopāyat</s> (imperfect). <s>gopāyet</s> (optative). <s>gopāyyāt</s> or <s>gupyāt</s> (benedictive). <s>agopāyīt</s> (aorist).
[Sūtra:] '<s>neṭi</s>' (VLk 479 = P 7.2.4)

body.text: iḍādau sici halantasya vṛddhirna / agopīt, agaupsīt //
body.translated_text: When <s>iṭ</s> precedes <s>sic</s>, <s>vṛddhi</s> does not apply to a consonant-ending [root]. [Examples:] <s>agopīt</s> or <s>agaupsīt</s> (aorist).
[Sūtra:] '<s>jhalo jhali</s>' (VLk 480 = P 8.2.26)

body.text: jhalaḥ parasya sasya lopo jhali / agauptām / agaupsuḥ / agaupsīḥ / agauptam / agaupta / agaupsam / agaupsva / agaupsma / agopāyiṣyat, agopiṣyat, agopsyat //

children.text: kṣaye // 13 // kṣayati / cikṣāya / cikṣiyatuḥ / cikṣiyuḥ / ekāca iti niṣedhe prāpte -- .
children.translated_text: [means] destruction. (Root 13) <s>kṣayati</s> (destroys). <s>cikṣāya</s> (perfect 3rd singular). <s>cikṣiyatuḥ</s> (perfect 3rd dual). <s>cikṣiyuḥ</s> (perfect 3rd plural). When the prohibition by the rule '<s>ekāc</s>' would apply —

body.translated_text: The <s>s</s> following a <s>jhal</s> consonant is deleted before a <s>jhal</s> consonant. [Examples:] <s>agauptām</s> (aorist 3rd dual). <s>agaupsuḥ</s> (aorist 3rd plural). <s>agaupsīḥ</s> (aorist 2nd singular). <s>agauptam</s> (aorist 2nd dual). <s>agaupta</s> (aorist 2nd plural). <s>agaupsam</s> (aorist 1st singular). <s>agaupsva</s> (aorist 1st dual). <s>agaupsma</s> (aorist 1st plural). <s>agopāyiṣyat</s>, <s>agopiṣyat</s>, or <s>agopsyat</s> (conditional).
[Sūtra:] '<s>kṛ-sṛ-bhṛ-vṛ-stu-dru-sru-śru-vo liṭi</s>' (VLk 481 = P 7.2.13)

body.text: krādibhya eva liṭa iṇna syādanyasmādaniṭo 'pi syāt //
body.translated_text: Only from <s>kṛ</s> and the other [listed roots] does <s>iṭ</s> not occur in <s>liṭ</s>; from other [monosyllabic <s>anudātta</s> roots], even though they are <s>aniṭ</s> [elsewhere], <s>iṭ</s> may occur [in <s>liṭ</s>].
[Sūtra:] '<s>acas tāsv at-thaly aniṭo nityam</s>' (VLk 482 = P 7.2.61)

body.text: upadeśe 'janto yo dhātustāsau nityāniṭ tatasthala iṇna //
body.translated_text: A root that is vowel-ending in the <s>upadeśa</s> — such a root is invariably <s>aniṭ</s>; from it, <s>iṭ</s> does not occur before <s>thal</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>upadeśe 'tvataḥ</s>' (VLk 483 = P 7.2.62)

body.text: upadeśe 'kāravatastāsau nityāniṭaḥ parasya thala iṇna syāt //
body.translated_text: A root having <s>a</s> in the <s>upadeśa</s> — such a root is invariably <s>aniṭ</s>; <s>iṭ</s> does not apply to the <s>thal</s> following it.
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṛto Bhāradvājasya</s>' (VLk 484 = P 7.2.63)

body.text:
tāsau nityāniṭa ṛdantādeva thalo neṭ bhāradvājasya mate / tena anyasya syādeva / ayamatra saṃgrahaḥ --- ajanto 'kāravānvā yastāsyaniṭthali veḍayam /
 ṛdanta īdṛṅnityāniṭ krādyanyo liṭi seḍbhavet //
body.translated_text: Such a root being invariably <s>aniṭ</s>, <s>iṭ</s> does not occur before <s>thal</s> after an <s>ṛ</s>-ending root, in the view of <s>Bhāradvāja</s>. Therefore, according to others, it would indeed [occur]. Here is the summary verse: 'A vowel-ending root having <s>a</s>, is optionally [<s>aniṭ</s>] before <s>tās</s> and invariably <s>aniṭ</s> before <s>thal</s>; an <s>ṛ</s>-ending one of this type is invariably <s>aniṭ</s>; <s>kṛ</s>-class [roots] in <s>liṭ</s> take <s>iṭ</s> [elsewhere].'

body.text: cikṣayitha, cikṣetha / cikṣiyathuḥ / cikṣiya / cikṣāya, cikṣaya / cikṣiyiva / cikṣiyima / kṣetā / kṣeṣyati / kṣayatu / akṣayat / kṣayet //
body.translated_text: [Examples:] <s>cikṣayitha</s> or <s>cikṣetha</s> (perfect 2nd singular). <s>cikṣiyathuḥ</s> (perfect 2nd dual). <s>cikṣiya</s> (perfect 2nd plural). <s>cikṣāya</s> or <s>cikṣaya</s> (perfect 1st singular). <s>cikṣiyiva</s> (perfect 1st dual). <s>cikṣiyima</s> (perfect 1st plural). <s>kṣetā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>kṣeṣyati</s> (simple future). <s>kṣayatu</s> (imperative). <s>akṣayat</s> (imperfect). <s>kṣayet</s> (optative).
[Sūtra:] '<s>akṛt-sārvadhātukayoḥ dīrghaḥ</s>' (VLk 485 = P 7.4.25)

body.text: ajantāṅgasya dīrgho yādau pratyaye na tu kṛtsārvadhātukayoḥ / kṣīyāt //
body.translated_text: The [final vowel of a] vowel-ending stem undergoes lengthening before an affix beginning with <s>y</s>, but not before a <s>kṛt</s> or <s>sārvadhātuka</s> [affix]. [Example:] <s>kṣīyāt</s> (benedictive).
[Sūtra:] '<s>sici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu</s>' (VLk 486 = P 7.2.1)

body.text: igantāṅgasya vṛddhiḥ syāt parasmaipade sici / akṣaiṣīt / akṣeṣyat //

children.text: santāpe // 14 // tapati / tatāpa / tepatuḥ / tepuḥ / tepitha, tataptha / tepiva / tepima / taptā / tapsyati / tapatu / atapat / tapet / tapyāt / atāpsīt / atāptām / atapsyat //
children.translated_text: [means] heat/austerity. (Root 14) <s>tapati</s> (burns/performs austerity). <s>tatāpa</s> (perfect 3rd singular). <s>tepatuḥ</s> (perfect 3rd dual). <s>tepuḥ</s> (perfect 3rd plural). <s>tepitha</s> or <s>tataptha</s> (perfect 2nd singular). <s>tepiva</s> (perfect 1st dual). <s>tepima</s> (perfect 1st plural). <s>taptā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>tapsyati</s> (simple future). <s>tapatu</s> (imperative). <s>atapat</s> (imperfect). <s>tapet</s> (optative). <s>tapyāt</s> (benedictive). <s>atāpsīt</s> (aorist). <s>atāptām</s> (aorist dual). <s>atapsyat</s> (conditional).

body.translated_text: The [final vowel of an] <s>ik</s>-ending stem undergoes <s>vṛddhi</s> before <s>sic</s> in <s>parasmaipada</s>. [Examples:] <s>akṣaiṣīt</s> (aorist). <s>akṣeṣyat</s> (conditional).
[Sūtra:] '<s>vā bhrāśa-bhlāśa-bhramu-kramu-klamu-trasi-truṭi-laṣaḥ</s>' (VLk 487 = P 3.1.70)

body.text: ebhyaḥ śyanvā kartrarthe sārvadhātuke pare / pakṣe śap //
body.translated_text: From these [roots], <s>śyan</s> [vikaraṇa] is optionally [applied] in <s>kartṛ</s> (agent) sense when a <s>sārvadhātuka</s> affix follows. In the other option, <s>śap</s> [applies].
[Sūtra:] '<s>kramaḥ parasmaipadeṣu</s>' (VLk 488 = P 7.3.76)

body.text: kramo dīrghaḥ parasmaipade śiti / krāmyati, krāmati / cakrāma / kramitā / kramiṣyati / krāmyatu, krāmatu / akrāmyat, akrāmat / krāmyet / krāmet / kramyāt / akramīt / akramiṣyat //
body.translated_text: <s>Krama</s> undergoes lengthening [of its vowel] before a <s>śit</s> <s>parasmaipada</s> [ending]. [Examples:] <s>krāmyati</s> or <s>krāmati</s> (walks). <s>cakrāma</s> (perfect). <s>kramitā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>kramiṣyati</s> (simple future). <s>krāmyatu</s> or <s>krāmatu</s> (imperative). <s>akrāmyat</s> or <s>akrāmat</s> (imperfect). <s>krāmyet</s> (optative [with <s>śyan</s>]). <s>krāmet</s> (optative [with <s>śap</s>]). <s>kramyāt</s> (benedictive). <s>akramīt</s> (aorist). <s>akramiṣyat</s> (conditional).
[Sūtra:] '<s>pā-ghrā-dhmā-sthā-mnā-dāṇ-dṛśya-rti-sarti-śada-sadāṃ piba-jighra-dhama-tiṣṭha-mana-yaccha-paśya-rccha-dhau-śīya-sīdāḥ</s>' (VLk 489 = P 7.3.78)

body.text: pādīnāṃ pibādayaḥ syuritsaṃjñakaśakārādau pratyaye pare / pibādeśo 'dantastena na guṇaḥ / pibati //
body.translated_text: For <s>pā</s> and the other [listed roots], <s>piba</s> and the other [substitutes] apply when an affix with <s>it</s> designation beginning with <s>śa</s> follows. The substitute <s>piba</s> ends in <s>a</s>, therefore <s>guṇa</s> does not [apply]. [Example:] <s>pibati</s> (drinks).
[Sūtra:] '<s>āta au ṇalaḥ</s>' (VLk 490 = P 7.1.34)
After an <s>ā</s>-ending root, <s>ṇal</s> [the perfect 3rd singular ending] is replaced by <s>au</s>. [Example:] <s>papau</s> (perfect 3rd singular, 'drank').

body.text: āto lopa iṭi ca // VLk_491 = P_6,4.64 //
body.translated_text: [Sūtra:] '<s>āto lopa iṭi ca</s>' (VLk 491 = P 6.4.64)

body.text: ajādyorārdhadhātukayoḥ kṅidiṭoḥ parayorāto lopaḥ / papatuḥ / papuḥ / papitha, papātha / papathuḥ / papa / papau / papiva / papima / pātā / pāsyati / pibatu / apibat / pibet //
body.translated_text: Before the two [types of affixes] — those beginning with a vowel among <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> affixes that are <s>kṅit</s> or have <s>iṭ</s> — the <s>ā</s> [of the root] is deleted. [Examples:] <s>papatuḥ</s> (perfect 3rd dual). <s>papuḥ</s> (perfect 3rd plural). <s>papitha</s> or <s>papātha</s> (perfect 2nd singular). <s>papathuḥ</s> (perfect 2nd dual). <s>papa</s> (perfect 2nd plural). <s>papau</s> (perfect 1st singular). <s>papiva</s> (perfect 1st dual). <s>papima</s> (perfect 1st plural). <s>pātā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>pāsyati</s> (simple future). <s>pibatu</s> (imperative). <s>apibat</s> (imperfect). <s>pibet</s> (optative).
[Sūtra:] '<s>er liṅi</s>' (VLk 492 = P 6.4.67)

body.text: ghusaṃjñakānāṃ māsthādīnāṃ ca etvaṃ syādārdhadhātuke kiti liṅi / peyāt / gātistheti sico luk / apāt / apātām //
body.translated_text: For <s>ghu</s>-designated [roots], <s>mā</s>, <s>sthā</s>, and the others — <s>e</s>-replacement [of the root vowel] occurs before a <s>kit</s> <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> affix in <s>liṅ</s> (optative/benedictive). [Example:] <s>peyāt</s> (benedictive). By [the rule] '<s>gāti-sthā</s>' etc., <s>sic</s> undergoes <s>luk</s> (deletion). [Examples:] <s>apāt</s> (aorist 3rd singular). <s>apātām</s> (aorist 3rd dual).
When <s>sic</s> has undergone <s>luk</s>, from an <s>ā</s>-ending [root], <s>jhi</s> is replaced by <s>jus</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>usy apadāntāt</s>' (VLk 494 = P 6.1.96)
After a non-word-final <s>a</s>, when <s>us</s> follows, the single substitute is the latter form (<s>pararūpa</s>). [Example:] <s>apuḥ</s> (aorist 3rd plural). <s>apāsyat</s> (conditional).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ādec upadeśe 'śiti</s>' (VLk 495 = P 6.1.45)

body.text: upadeśe ejantasya dhātorātvaṃ na tu śiti / jaglau / glātā / glāsyati / glāyatu / aglāyat / glāyet //
body.translated_text: A root that ends in <s>e</s> or <s>ai</s> in the <s>upadeśa</s> undergoes <s>ā</s>-replacement, but not before a <s>śit</s> [affix]. [Examples:] <s>jaglau</s> (perfect). <s>glātā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>glāsyati</s> (simple future). <s>glāyatu</s> (imperative). <s>aglāyat</s> (imperfect). <s>glāyet</s> (optative).
[Sūtra:] '<s>vānyasya saṃyogādeḥ</s>' (VLk 496 = P 6.4.68)

body.text: ghumāsthāderanyasya saṃyogāderdhātorāta etvaṃ vārdhadhātuke kiti liṅi / gleyāt, glāyāt //
body.translated_text: For a root other than <s>ghu</s>, <s>mā</s>, <s>sthā</s>, etc. — one beginning with a conjunct — <s>e</s>-replacement of the <s>ā</s> [vowel] optionally occurs before a <s>kit</s> <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> in <s>liṅ</s>. [Examples:] <s>gleyāt</s> or <s>glāyāt</s> (benedictive).
[Sūtra:] '<s>yama-rama-nama-atāṃ sak ca</s>' (VLk 497 = P 7.2.73)

body.text: eṣāṃ sak syādebhyaḥ sica iṭ syātparasmaipadeṣu / aglāsīt / aglāsyat //
body.translated_text: For these [roots], <s>sak</s> [augment] applies, and from them <s>iṭ</s> [is inserted] before <s>sic</s> in <s>parasmaipada</s>. [Examples:] <s>aglāsīt</s> (aorist). <s>aglāsyat</s> (conditional).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṛtaś ca saṃyogāder guṇaḥ</s>' (VLk 498 = P 7.4.10)

body.text: ṛdantasya saṃyogāderaṅgasya guṇo liṭi / upadhāyā vṛddhiḥ / jahvāra / jahvaratuḥ / jahvaruḥ / jahvartha / jahvarathuḥ / jahvara / jahvāra, jahvara / jahvariva / jahvarima / hvartā //
body.translated_text: An <s>ṛ</s>-ending stem beginning with a conjunct takes <s>guṇa</s> in the <s>liṭ</s> (perfect tense). The penultimate takes <s>vṛddhi</s>. [Forms:] <s>jahvāra</s> (3rd sg.). <s>jahvaratuḥ</s> (3rd du.). <s>jahvaruḥ</s> (3rd pl.). <s>jahvartha</s> (2nd sg.). <s>jahvarathuḥ</s> (2nd du.). <s>jahvara</s> (2nd pl.). <s>jahvāra</s>, <s>jahvara</s> (1st sg.). <s>jahvariva</s> (1st du.). <s>jahvarima</s> (1st pl.). [Future:] <s>hvartā</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṛd-dhanoḥ sye</s>' (VLk 499 = P 7.2.10)

body.text: ṛto hanteśca syasyeṭ / hvariṣyati / hvaratu / ahvarat / hvaret //
body.translated_text: After an <s>ṛ</s>-ending root and <s>han</s>, <s>iṭ</s> is inserted before <s>sya</s> [of the future]. [Forms:] <s>hvariṣyati</s> (future). <s>hvaratu</s> (imperative). <s>ahvarat</s> (imperfect). <s>hvaret</s> (optative).
[Sūtra:] '<s>guṇo 'rti-saṃyogādyoḥ</s>' (VLk 500 = P 7.4.29)

body.text: arteḥ saṃyogāderṛdantasya ca guṇaḥ syādyaki yādāvārdhadhātuke liṅi ca / hvaryāt / ahvārṣīt / ahvariṣyat //
body.translated_text: For [the root] <s>ṛ</s> and for an <s>ṛ</s>-ending root beginning with a conjunct, <s>guṇa</s> occurs before a <s>yak</s>-initial <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> affix and in the optative (<s>liṅ</s>). [Forms:] <s>hvaryāt</s> (precative). <s>ahvārṣīt</s> (aorist). <s>ahvariṣyat</s> (conditional).
[Sūtra:] '<s>śruvaḥ śṛ ca</s>' (VLk 501 = P 6.1.74)

body.text: śruvaḥ śṛ ityādeśaḥ syāt śnupratyayaśca / śṛṇoti //
body.translated_text: <s>Śru</s> is replaced by <s>śṛ</s>, and the <s>śnu</s> affix [is added]. [Form:] <s>śṛṇoti</s> (he hears).
[Sūtra:] '<s>sārvadhātukam apit</s>' (VLk 502 = P 1.2.4)
A <s>sārvadhātuka</s> affix not marked with <s>p</s> as <s>it</s> is treated like [an affix marked with] <s>ṅ</s>. [Form:] <s>śṛṇutaḥ</s> (3rd dual).
[Sūtra:] '<s>hu-śnuvoḥ sārvadhātuke</s>' (VLk 503 = P 6.4.87)

body.text: huśnuvoranekāco 'saṃyogapūrvasyovarṇasya yaṇ syādaci sārvadhātuke / śṛṇvanti / śṛṇoṣi / śṛṇuthaḥ / śṛṇutha / śṛṇomi //
body.translated_text: The <s>u</s>-vowel of <s>hu</s> and <s>śnu</s> — when it is not preceded by a conjunct and follows more than one vowel — becomes <s>yaṇ</s> before a vowel-initial <s>sārvadhātuka</s> affix. [Forms:] <s>śṛṇvanti</s> (3rd pl.). <s>śṛṇoṣi</s> (2nd sg.). <s>śṛṇuthaḥ</s> (2nd du.). <s>śṛṇutha</s> (2nd pl.). <s>śṛṇomi</s> (1st sg.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>lopaś cāsyānyatarasyāṃ mvoḥ</s>' (VLk 504 = P 6.4.107)

body.text: asaṃyogapūrvasya pratyayokārasya lopo vā mvoḥ parayoḥ / śṛṇvaḥ, śṛṇuvaḥ / śṛṇmaḥ, śṛṇumaḥ / śuśrāva / śuśruvatuḥ / śuśruvuḥ / śuśrotha / śuśruvathuḥ / śuśruva / śuśrāva, śuśrava / śuśruva / śuśruma / śrotā / śroṣyati / śṛṇotu, śṛṇutāt / śṛṇutām / śṛṇvantu //
body.translated_text: The <s>u</s>-vowel of the affix, when not preceded by a conjunct, is optionally deleted before <s>m</s> and <s>v</s>. [Forms:] <s>śṛṇvaḥ</s>, <s>śṛṇuvaḥ</s> (1st du.). <s>śṛṇmaḥ</s>, <s>śṛṇumaḥ</s> (1st pl.). [Perfect:] <s>śuśrāva</s> (3rd sg.). <s>śuśruvatuḥ</s> (3rd du.). <s>śuśruvuḥ</s> (3rd pl.). <s>śuśrotha</s> (2nd sg.). <s>śuśruvathuḥ</s> (2nd du.). <s>śuśruva</s> (2nd pl.). <s>śuśrāva</s>, <s>śuśrava</s> (1st sg.). <s>śuśruva</s> (1st du.). <s>śuśruma</s> (1st pl.). [Future:] <s>śrotā</s>. <s>śroṣyati</s>. [Imperative:] <s>śṛṇotu</s>, <s>śṛṇutāt</s> (3rd sg.). <s>śṛṇutām</s> (3rd du.). <s>śṛṇvantu</s> (3rd pl.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>utaś ca pratyayād asaṃyogapūrvāt</s>' (VLk 505 = P 6.4.106)

body.text: asaṃyogapūrvātpratyayoto herluk / śṛṇu, śṛṇutāt / śṛṇutam / śṛṇuta / guṇāvādeśau / śṛṇavāni / śṛṇavāva / śṛṇavāma / aśṛṇot / aśṛṇutām / aśṛṇvan / aśṛṇoḥ / aśṛṇutam / aśṛṇuta / aśṛṇavam / aśṛṇva, aśṛṇuva / aśṛṇma, aśṛṇuma / śṛṇuyāt / śṛṇuyātām / śṛṇuyuḥ / śṛṇuyāḥ / śṛṇuyātam / śṛṇuyāta / śṛṇuyām / śṛṇuyāva / śṛṇuyāma / śrūyāt / aśrauṣīt / aśroṣyat //
body.translated_text: After a non-conjunct-preceded <s>u</s> of an affix, <s>hi</s> is deleted (<s>luk</s>). [Forms:] <s>śṛṇu</s>, <s>śṛṇutāt</s> (2nd sg. imperative). <s>śṛṇutam</s> (2nd du.). <s>śṛṇuta</s> (2nd pl.). [By] <s>guṇa</s> and substitution — <s>śṛṇavāni</s> (1st sg.). <s>śṛṇavāva</s> (1st du.). <s>śṛṇavāma</s> (1st pl.). [Imperfect:] <s>aśṛṇot</s> (3rd sg.). <s>aśṛṇutām</s> (3rd du.). <s>aśṛṇvan</s> (3rd pl.). <s>aśṛṇoḥ</s> (2nd sg.). <s>aśṛṇutam</s> (2nd du.). <s>aśṛṇuta</s> (2nd pl.). <s>aśṛṇavam</s> (1st sg.). <s>aśṛṇva</s>, <s>aśṛṇuva</s> (1st du.). <s>aśṛṇma</s>, <s>aśṛṇuma</s> (1st pl.). [Optative:] <s>śṛṇuyāt</s> (3rd sg.). <s>śṛṇuyātām</s> (3rd du.). <s>śṛṇuyuḥ</s> (3rd pl.). <s>śṛṇuyāḥ</s> (2nd sg.). <s>śṛṇuyātam</s> (2nd du.). <s>śṛṇuyāta</s> (2nd pl.). <s>śṛṇuyām</s> (1st sg.). <s>śṛṇuyāva</s> (1st du.). <s>śṛṇuyāma</s> (1st pl.). [Precative:] <s>śrūyāt</s>. [Aorist:] <s>aśrauṣīt</s>. [Conditional:] <s>aśroṣyat</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>iṣu-gami-yamāṃ chaḥ</s>' (VLk 506 = P 7.3.77)

body.text: eṣāṃ chaḥ syāt śiti / gacchati / jagāma //
body.translated_text: For these [roots], <s>cha</s> [i.e. <s>cch</s>] replaces [the initial consonant of the vikaraṇa] before <s>śit</s> [affixes]. [Form:] <s>gacchati</s> (he goes). [Perfect:] <s>jagāma</s> (3rd sg.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>gama-hana-jana-khana-ghasāṃ lopaḥ kṅity anaṅi</s>' (VLk 507 = P 6.4.98)

body.text: eṣāmupadhāyā lopo 'jādau kṅiti na tvaṅi / jagmatuḥ / jagmuḥ / jagamitha, jagantha / jagmathuḥ / jagma / jagāma, jagama / jagmiva / jagmima / gantā //
body.translated_text: For these roots, the penultimate [vowel] is deleted before an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> affix beginning with a vowel that is marked with <s>k</s> or <s>ṅ</s>, but not before <s>anaṅ</s>. [Forms:] <s>jagmatuḥ</s> (3rd du.). <s>jagmuḥ</s> (3rd pl.). <s>jagamitha</s>, <s>jagantha</s> (2nd sg.). <s>jagmathuḥ</s> (2nd du.). <s>jagma</s> (2nd pl.). <s>jagāma</s>, <s>jagama</s> (1st sg.). <s>jagmiva</s> (1st du.). <s>jagmima</s> (1st pl.). [Future:] <s>gantā</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>gamer iṭ parasmaipadeṣu</s>' (VLk 508 = P 7.2.58)

body.text: gameḥ parasya sāderārdhadhātukasyeṭ syāt parasmaipadeṣu / gamiṣyati / gacchatu / agacchat / gacchet / gamyāt //
body.translated_text: After <s>gam</s>, <s>iṭ</s> is inserted before a following <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> beginning with <s>s</s>, in <s>parasmaipada</s> [forms]. [Form:] <s>gamiṣyati</s> (future). [Imperative:] <s>gacchatu</s>. [Imperfect:] <s>agacchat</s>. [Optative:] <s>gacchet</s>. [Precative:] <s>gamyāt</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>puṣādi-dyutādy-ḷditaḥ parasmaipadeṣu</s>' (VLk 509 = P 3.1.55)

After a <s>puṣādi</s> root, a <s>dyutādi</s> root, and a root marked with <s>ḷ</s> — <s>aṅ</s> replaces <s>cli</s> in the <s>parasmaipada</s>. [Aorist:] <s>agamat</s>. [Conditional:] <s>agamiṣyat</s>.
Thus [end] the <s>parasmaipadin</s> (active-voice) [roots].
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṭita ātmanepadānāṃ ṭeḥ e</s>' (VLk 510 = P 3.4.79)
For a root marked with <s>ṭ</s>, the <s>ṭ</s>-initial endings of the <s>ātmanepada</s> replace <s>la</s>. [Form:] <s>edhate</s> (he prospers).
[Sūtra:] '<s>āto ṅitaḥ</s>' (VLk 511 = P 7.2.81)

body.text: ataḥ parasya ṅitāmākārasya iy syāt / edhete / edhante //
body.translated_text: After [a stem ending in] <s>a</s>, the <s>ā</s> of the <s>ṅit</s> [endings] becomes <s>iy</s>. [Forms:] <s>edhete</s> (3rd du.). <s>edhante</s> (3rd pl.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>thāsaḥ se</s>' (VLk 512 = P 3.4.80)

body.text: ṭito lasya thāsaḥ se syāt / edhase / edhethe / edhadhve / ato guṇe / edhe / edhāvahe / edhāmahe //
body.translated_text: For a root marked with <s>ṭ</s>, <s>thās</s> of <s>la</s> becomes <s>se</s>. [Forms:] <s>edhase</s> (2nd sg.). <s>edhethe</s> (2nd du.). <s>edhadhve</s> (2nd pl.). By '<s>ato guṇe</s>' — <s>edhe</s> (1st sg.). <s>edhāvahe</s> (1st du.). <s>edhāmahe</s> (1st pl.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ijādeś ca gurumato 'nṛcchaḥ</s>' (VLk 513 = P 3.1.36)
A root that begins with a vowel, is heavy, and is not <s>ṛcch</s> — takes <s>ām</s> in the <s>liṭ</s> (perfect).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ām-pratyayavat kṛño 'nuprayogasya</s>' (VLk 514 = P 1.3.63)

body.text: āmpratyayo yasmādityatadguṇasaṃvijñāno bahuvrīhiḥ / āmprakṛtyā tulyamanuprayujyamānāt kṛño 'pyātmanepadam //
body.translated_text: 'That which has <s>ām</s> as its affix' is a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> compound denoting something not of that quality [i.e. a periphrastic formation]. The auxiliary verb <s>kṛ</s> (to do), used alongside [the <s>ām</s>-form], also takes <s>ātmanepada</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>liṭas tajhayoḥ eś irec</s>' (VLk 515 = P 3.4.81)

body.text: liḍādeśayostajhayoreś irejetau staḥ / edhāñcakre / edhāñcakrāte / edhāñcakrire / edhāñcakṛṣe / edhāñcakrāthe //
body.translated_text: The <s>liṭ</s> replacements <s>ta</s> and <s>jha</s> become <s>e</s> and <s>ire</s> respectively. [Forms:] <s>edhāñcakre</s> (3rd sg. perfect). <s>edhāñcakrāte</s> (3rd du.). <s>edhāñcakrire</s> (3rd pl.). <s>edhāñcakṛṣe</s> (2nd sg.). <s>edhāñcakrāthe</s> (2nd du.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>iṇaḥ ṣī-dhvaṃ-luṅ-liṭāṃ dho 'ṅgāt</s>' (VLk 516 = P 8.3.78)

body.text: iṇantādaṅgātpareṣāṃ ṣīdhvaṃluṅliṭāṃ dhasya ḍhaḥ syāt // edhāñcakṛḍhve / edhāñcakre / edhāñcakṛvahe / edhāñcakṛmahe / edhāmbabhūva / edhāmāsa / edhitā / edhitārau / edhitāraḥ / edhitāse / edhitāsāthe //
body.translated_text: After a stem ending in [the root] <s>iṇ</s> (to go), the <s>dh</s> of <s>ṣī</s>, <s>dhvam</s>, <s>luṅ</s>, and <s>liṭ</s> [endings] becomes <s>ḍh</s>. [Forms:] <s>edhāñcakṛḍhve</s> (2nd pl.). <s>edhāñcakre</s> (1st sg.). <s>edhāñcakṛvahe</s> (1st du.). <s>edhāñcakṛmahe</s> (1st pl.). [Periphrastic perfect alternatives:] <s>edhāmbabhūva</s>. <s>edhāmāsa</s>. [Future forms:] <s>edhitā</s> (agent noun). <s>edhitārau</s> (du.). <s>edhitāraḥ</s> (pl.). <s>edhitāse</s> (2nd sg.). <s>edhitāsāthe</s> (2nd du.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>dhi ca</s>' (VLk 517 = P 8.2.25)

body.text: dhādau pratyaye pare sasya lopaḥ / edhitādhve //
body.translated_text: Before an affix beginning with <s>dh</s>, <s>s</s> is deleted. [Form:] <s>edhitādhve</s> (2nd pl.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ha eti</s>' (VLk 518 = P 7.4.25)

body.text: tāsastyoḥ sasya haḥ syādeti pare / edhitāhe / edhitāsvahe / edhitāsmahe / edhiṣyate / edhiṣyete / edhiṣyante / edhiṣyase / edhiṣyethe / edhiṣyadhve / edhiṣye / edhiṣyāvahe / edhiṣyāmahe //
body.translated_text: <s>S</s> of <s>tās</s> and <s>as</s> becomes <s>h</s> before <s>e</s>. [Forms:] <s>edhitāhe</s> (1st sg.). <s>edhitāsvahe</s> (1st du.). <s>edhitāsmahe</s> (1st pl.). [Periphrastic future middle:] <s>edhiṣyate</s> (3rd sg.). <s>edhiṣyete</s> (3rd du.). <s>edhiṣyante</s> (3rd pl.). <s>edhiṣyase</s> (2nd sg.). <s>edhiṣyethe</s> (2nd du.). <s>edhiṣyadhve</s> (2nd pl.). <s>edhiṣye</s> (1st sg.). <s>edhiṣyāvahe</s> (1st du.). <s>edhiṣyāmahe</s> (1st pl.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>āmetaḥ</s>' (VLk 519 = P 3.4.90)

body.text: loṭa ekārasyām syāt / edhatām / edhetām / edhantām //
body.translated_text: Of <s>loṭ</s> (imperative), [the ending] <s>e</s> becomes <s>ām</s>. [Forms:] <s>edhatām</s> (3rd sg.). <s>edhetām</s> (3rd du.). <s>edhantām</s> (3rd pl.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>savābhyāṃ vāmau</s>' (VLk 520 = P 3.4.91)

body.text: savābhyām parasya loḍetaḥ kramādvāmau staḥ / edhasva / edhethām / edhadhvam //
body.translated_text: After <s>s</s> and <s>v</s> [of the affix], <s>e</s> of <s>loṭ</s> is replaced by <s>va</s> and <s>ma</s> respectively. [Forms:] <s>edhasva</s> (2nd sg. imperative). <s>edhethām</s> (2nd du.). <s>edhadhvam</s> (2nd pl.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>eta ai</s>' (VLk 521 = P 3.4.93)

body.text: loḍuttamasya eta ai syāt / edhai / edhāvahai / edhāmahai // āṭaśca / aidhata / aidhetām / aidhanta / aidhathāḥ / aidhethām / aidhadhvam / aidhe / aidhāvahi / aidhāmahi //
body.translated_text: The first-person <s>e</s> of <s>loṭ</s> becomes <s>ai</s>. [Forms:] <s>edhai</s> (1st sg.). <s>edhāvahai</s> (1st du.). <s>edhāmahai</s> (1st pl.). With <s>āṭ</s> augment — [Imperfect:] <s>aidhata</s> (3rd sg.). <s>aidhetām</s> (3rd du.). <s>aidhanta</s> (3rd pl.). <s>aidhathāḥ</s> (2nd sg.). <s>aidhethām</s> (2nd du.). <s>aidhadhvam</s> (2nd pl.). <s>aidhe</s> (1st sg.). <s>aidhāvahi</s> (1st du.). <s>aidhāmahi</s> (1st pl.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>liḍaḥ sīyuṭ</s>' (VLk 522 = P 3.4.102)
[Then] deletion of <s>s</s>. [Optative:] <s>edheta</s> (3rd sg.). <s>edheyātām</s> (3rd du.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>jhasya ran</s>' (VLk 523 = P 3.4.105)

body.text: liṅo jhasya ran syāt / edheran / edhethāḥ / edheyāthām / edhedhvam //
body.translated_text: <s>Ran</s> replaces <s>jha</s> of <s>liṅ</s> (optative). [Forms:] <s>edheran</s> (3rd pl.). <s>edhethāḥ</s> (2nd sg.). <s>edheyāthām</s> (2nd du.). <s>edhedhvam</s> (2nd pl.).
The <s>iṭ</s> portion of the <s>liṅ</s> replacement gets <s>at</s>. [Forms:] <s>edheya</s> (1st sg.). <s>edhevahi</s> (1st du.). <s>edhemahi</s> (1st pl.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>suṭ tithoḥ</s>' (VLk 525 = P 3.4.107)

body.text: liṅastathoḥ suṭ / yalopaḥ / ārdhadhātukatvātsalopo na / edhiṣīṣṭa / edhiṣīyāstām / edhiṣīran / edhiṣīṣṭhāḥ / edhiṣīyāsthām / edhiṣīdhvam / edhiṣīya / edhiṣīvahi / edhiṣīmahi / aidhiṣṭa / aidhiṣātām //
body.translated_text: Before <s>ta</s> and <s>th</s> of <s>liṅ</s>, <s>suṭ</s> [is augmented]. [Then] deletion of <s>y</s>. Because of being <s>ārdhadhātuka</s>, <s>s</s> is not deleted. [Precative forms:] <s>edhiṣīṣṭa</s> (3rd sg.). <s>edhiṣīyāstām</s> (3rd du.). <s>edhiṣīran</s> (3rd pl.). <s>edhiṣīṣṭhāḥ</s> (2nd sg.). <s>edhiṣīyāsthām</s> (2nd du.). <s>edhiṣīdhvam</s> (2nd pl.). <s>edhiṣīya</s> (1st sg.). <s>edhiṣīvahi</s> (1st du.). <s>edhiṣīmahi</s> (1st pl.). [Aorist:] <s>aidhiṣṭa</s> (3rd sg.). <s>aidhiṣātām</s> (3rd du.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ātmanepadeṣv anataḥ</s>' (VLk 526 = P 7.1.5)

body.text: anakārātparasyātmanepadeṣu jhasya adityādeśaḥ syāt / aidhiṣata / aidhiṣṭhāḥ / aidhiṣāthām / aidhiḍhvam / aidhiṣi / aidhiṣvahi / aidhiṣmahi / aidhiṣyata / aidhiṣyetām / aidhiṣyanta / aidhiṣyathāḥ / aidhiṣyethām / aidhiṣyadhvam / aidhiṣye / aidhiṣyāvahi / aidhiṣyāmahi //
body.translated_text: After a non-<s>a</s> stem, before <s>ātmanepada</s> endings, <s>jha</s> is replaced by <s>at</s>. [Forms:] <s>aidhiṣata</s> (3rd pl.). <s>aidhiṣṭhāḥ</s> (2nd sg.). <s>aidhiṣāthām</s> (2nd du.). <s>aidhiḍhvam</s> (2nd pl.). <s>aidhiṣi</s> (1st sg.). <s>aidhiṣvahi</s> (1st du.). <s>aidhiṣmahi</s> (1st pl.). [Conditional:] <s>aidhiṣyata</s> (3rd sg.). <s>aidhiṣyetām</s> (3rd du.). <s>aidhiṣyanta</s> (3rd pl.). <s>aidhiṣyathāḥ</s> (2nd sg.). <s>aidhiṣyethām</s> (2nd du.). <s>aidhiṣyadhvam</s> (2nd pl.). <s>aidhiṣye</s> (1st sg.). <s>aidhiṣyāvahi</s> (1st du.). <s>aidhiṣyāmahi</s> (1st pl.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>kramer ṇiṅ</s>' (VLk 527 = P 3.1.30)
[The <s>ṇic</s> affix is applied] in its own meaning. Because of being <s>ṅit</s>, <s>taṅ</s> [i.e. <s>ātmanepada</s> endings apply]. [Form:] <s>kāmayate</s> (he desires).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ayām-ant-ālu-āyya-itnu-iṣṇuṣu</s>' (VLk 528 = P 6.4.55)

body.text: ām anta ālu āyya itnu iṣṇu eṣu ṇerayādeśaḥ syāt / kāmāyāñcakre / āyādaya iti ṇiṅ vā / cakame / cakamāte / cakamire / cakamiṣe / cakamāthe / cakamidhve / cakame / cakamivahe / cakamimahe / kāmayitā / kāmayitāse / kamitā / kāmayiṣyate, kamiṣyate / kāmayatām / akāmayata / kāmayeta / kāmayiṣīṣṭa //
body.translated_text: Before [the affixes] <s>ām</s>, <s>anta</s>, <s>ālu</s>, <s>āyya</s>, <s>itnu</s>, and <s>iṣṇu</s>, <s>ṇi</s> is replaced by <s>ay</s>. [Perfect:] <s>kāmāyāñcakre</s>. [By the rule] '<s>āyādayaḥ</s>' — <s>ṇiṅ</s> is optional. [Alternative perfect forms without <s>ṇic</s>:] <s>cakame</s> (3rd sg.). <s>cakamāte</s> (3rd du.). <s>cakamire</s> (3rd pl.). <s>cakamiṣe</s> (2nd sg.). <s>cakamāthe</s> (2nd du.). <s>cakamidhve</s> (2nd pl.). <s>cakame</s> (1st sg.). <s>cakamivahe</s> (1st du.). <s>cakamimahe</s> (1st pl.). [Future:] <s>kāmayitā</s>. <s>kāmayitāse</s>. [Simple future:] <s>kamitā</s>. [Futures:] <s>kāmayiṣyate</s>, <s>kamiṣyate</s>. [Imperative:] <s>kāmayatām</s>. [Imperfect:] <s>akāmayata</s>. [Optative:] <s>kāmayeta</s>. [Precative:] <s>kāmayiṣīṣṭa</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>vibhāṣeṭaḥ</s>' (VLk 529 = P 8.3.79)

body.text: iṇaḥ paro ya iṭ tataḥ pareṣāṃ ṣīdhvaṃluṅliṭāṃ dhasya vā ḍhaḥ / kāmayiṣīḍhvam, kāmayiṣīdhvam / kamiṣīṣṭa / kamiṣīdhvam //
body.translated_text: After <s>iṭ</s> following [the root] <s>iṇ</s>, the <s>dh</s> of <s>ṣī</s>, <s>dhvam</s>, <s>luṅ</s>, and <s>liṭ</s> [endings] is optionally replaced by <s>ḍh</s>. [Forms:] <s>kāmayiṣīḍhvam</s>, <s>kāmayiṣīdhvam</s> (2nd pl. precative). [Without <s>ṇic</s>:] <s>kamiṣīṣṭa</s>. <s>kamiṣīdhvam</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṇi-śri-dru-sru-bhyaḥ kartari caṅ</s>' (VLk 530 = P 3.1.48)

body.text: ṇyantāt śryādibhyaśca cleścaṅ syāt kartrarthe luṅi pare /

children.translated_text: When this state has been reached —

body.translated_text: After a <s>ṇic</s>-ending stem, and after <s>śri</s> etc., <s>caṅ</s> replaces <s>cli</s> in the active-sense <s>luṅ</s> (aorist).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṇer aniṭi</s>' (VLk 531 = P 6.4.51)
Before an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> affix not beginning with <s>iṭ</s>, <s>ṇi</s> is deleted.
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṇau caṅy upadhāyā hrasvaḥ</s>' (VLk 532 = P 7.4.1)

body.text: caṅpare ṇau yadaṅgaṃ tasyopadhāyā hrasvaḥ syāt //
body.translated_text: When <s>ṇi</s> [is present] before <s>caṅ</s>, the penultimate vowel of the stem is shortened.
[Sūtra:] '<s>caṅi</s>' (VLk 533 = P 6.1.11)

body.text: caṅi pare anabhyāsasya dhātvavayavasyaikācaḥ prathamasya dve sto 'jāderdvitīyasya //
body.translated_text: Before <s>caṅ</s>, the first monosyllabic part of the verbal stem (not already reduplicated) is reduplicated, [and] the second [element begins] with a vowel.
[Sūtra:] '<s>sanval laghuni caṅ pare 'naglope</s>' (VLk 534 = P 7.4.93)

body.text: caṅpare ṇau yadaṅgaṃ tasya yo 'bhyāso laghuparaḥ, tasya sanīva kāryaṃ syāṇṇāvaglope 'sati //
body.translated_text: When <s>ṇi</s> is followed by <s>caṅ</s>, the reduplicative syllable followed by a light [syllable] undergoes the same treatment as in [the desiderative] <s>san</s>, when there is no deletion of <s>aṅ</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>sany ataḥ</s>' (VLk 535 = P 7.4.79)
The [vowel] of the reduplicative syllable becomes <s>i</s> in <s>san</s> [desiderative].
[Sūtra:] '<s>dīrgho laghoḥ</s>' (VLk 536 = P 7.4.94)

body.text: laghorabhyāsasya dīrghaḥ syāt sanvadbhāvaviṣaye / acīkamata, ṇiṅbhāvapakṣe -- (
body.translated_text: The [vowel] of a light reduplicative syllable is lengthened in the domain of <s>sanvat</s> treatment. [Aorist:] <s>acīkamata</s>. In the alternative where <s>ṇiṅ</s> is not applied —
[Sūtra:] '<s>upasargasyāyatau</s>' (VLk 537 = P 8.2.19)

body.text: ayatiparasyopasargasya yo rephastasya latvaṃ syāt / plāyate / palāyate //
body.translated_text: The <s>r</s> (repha) of a prefix (<s>upasarga</s>) preceding <s>ayati</s> becomes <s>l</s>. [Forms:] <s>plāyate</s>. <s>palāyate</s> (he flees).
[Sūtra:] '<s>dayāyāsaś ca</s>' (VLk 538 = P 3.1.37)

body.text: day ay ās ebhya ām syālliṭi / ayāñcakre / ayitā / ayiṣyate / ayatām / āyata / ayeta / ayiṣīṣṭa / vibhāṣeṭaḥ / ayiṣīḍhvam, ayiṣīdhvam / āyiṣṭa / āyiḍhvam, āyidhvam / āyiṣyata //
body.translated_text: After <s>day</s>, <s>ay</s>, and <s>ās</s>, <s>ām</s> is used in the <s>liṭ</s> (perfect). [Perfect:] <s>ayāñcakre</s>. [Future:] <s>ayitā</s>. <s>ayiṣyate</s>. [Imperative:] <s>ayatām</s>. [Imperfect:] <s>āyata</s>. [Optative:] <s>ayeta</s>. [Precative:] <s>ayiṣīṣṭa</s>. By [the rule] '<s>vibhāṣeṭaḥ</s>' — <s>ayiṣīḍhvam</s>, <s>ayiṣīdhvam</s> (2nd pl. precative). [Aorist:] <s>āyiṣṭa</s>. <s>āyiḍhvam</s>, <s>āyidhvam</s>. [Conditional:] <s>āyiṣyata</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>dyuti-svāpyoḥ saṃprasāraṇam</s>' (VLk 539 = P 7.4.67)
For these two, the reduplicative syllable undergoes <s>saṃprasāraṇa</s>. [Perfect:] <s>didyute</s> (3rd sg.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>dyudbhyo luṅi</s>' (VLk 540 = P 1.3.91)

body.text: dyutādibhyo luṅaḥ parasmaipadaṃ vā syāt / puṣādītyaṅ / adyutat, adyotiṣṭa / adyotiṣyata // evaṃ

children.translated_text: [meaning:] oiling and releasing. (7th root) Some say [the meanings are] 'deluding and releasing.'
Some [say this is a variant root].

body.translated_text: After the <s>dyut</s>-class roots, <s>parasmaipada</s> endings optionally apply in the <s>luṅ</s> (aorist). By [the rule] '<s>puṣādi</s>' — <s>aṅ</s> [replaces <s>cli</s>]. [Aorist:] <s>adyutat</s>, <s>adyotiṣṭa</s>. [Conditional:] <s>adyotiṣyata</s>. Similarly —
[Sūtra:] '<s>vṛdbhyaḥ sya-sanoḥ</s>' (VLk 541 = P 1.4.92)

body.text: vṛtādibhyaḥ pañcabhyo vā parasmaipadaṃ syātsye sani ca //
body.translated_text: After the five roots beginning with <s>vṛt</s>, <s>parasmaipada</s> endings optionally apply before <s>sya</s> (future) and <s>san</s> (desiderative).
[Sūtra:] '<s>na vṛdbhyaś caturbhyaḥ</s>' (VLk 542 = P 7.2.59)

body.text: vṛtuvṛdhuśṛdhusyandūbhyaḥ sakārāderārdhadhātukasyeṇ na syāt taṅānayorabhāve / vartsyati, vartiṣyate / vartatām / avartata / varteta / vartiṣīṣṭa / avartiṣṭa / avartsyat, avartiṣyat //
body.translated_text: After the four roots <s>vṛtu</s>, <s>vṛdhu</s>, <s>śṛdhu</s>, and <s>syandū</s>, <s>iṭ</s> is not inserted before an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> beginning with <s>s</s>, when <s>taṅ</s> [endings] are absent. [Futures:] <s>vartsyati</s>, <s>vartiṣyate</s>. [Imperative:] <s>vartatām</s>. [Imperfect:] <s>avartata</s>. [Optative:] <s>varteta</s>. [Precative:] <s>vartiṣīṣṭa</s>. [Aorist:] <s>avartiṣṭa</s>. [Conditional:] <s>avartsyat</s>, <s>avartiṣyat</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>na śasa-dada-vādi-guṇānām</s>' (VLk 543 = P 6.4.126)

body.text: śaserdadervakārādīnāṃ guṇaśabdena vihito yo 'kārastasya ettvābhyāsalopau na / dadade / dadadāte / dadadire / daditā / dadiṣyate / dadatām / adadata / dadeta / dadiṣīṣṭa / adadiṣṭa / adadiṣyata //
body.translated_text: For <s>śas</s>, <s>dad</s>, and roots beginning with <s>v</s> — the <s>a</s>-vowel prescribed by the term '<s>guṇa</s>' does not undergo <s>ettva</s> (replacement by <s>e</s>) and <s>abhyāsa-lopa</s> (deletion of the reduplicative syllable). [Forms:] <s>dadade</s> (3rd sg. perfect). <s>dadadāte</s> (3rd du.). <s>dadadire</s> (3rd pl.). [Future:] <s>daditā</s>. <s>dadiṣyate</s>. [Imperative:] <s>dadatām</s>. [Imperfect:] <s>adadata</s>. body.translated_text: This is an exception to <s>śap</s>. By [the rule] '<s>hali ca</s>' — lengthening [applies]. [Examples:] <s>dīvyati</s> (plays). <s>dideva</s> (perfect). <s>devitā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>deviṣyati</s> (simple future). <s>dīvyatu</s> (imperative). <s>adīvyat</s> (imperfect). <s>dīvyet</s> (optative). <s>dīvyāt</s> (benedictive). <s>adevīt</s> (aorist). <s>adeviṣyat</s> (conditional). Likewise —
[Sūtra:] '<s>se 'sici kṛta-cṛta-cchṛda-tṛda-nṛtaḥ</s>' (VLk 633 = P 7.2.57)

body.text: ebhyaḥ parasya sijbhinnasya sāderārdhadhātukasyeḍvā / nartiṣyati, nartsyati / nṛtyatu / anṛtyat / nṛtyet / nṛtyāt / anartīt / anartiṣyat, anartsyat //

children.text: udvege // 4 // vā bhrāśeti śyanvā / trasyati, trasati / tatrāsa //
children.translated_text: [means] fear / anxiety. (Root 4) By [the rule] '<s>vā bhrāśa</s>' — <s>śyan</s> is optional. [Examples:] <s>trasyati</s> or <s>trasati</s> (fears). <s>tatrāsa</s> (perfect).

body.translated_text: From these [roots], when an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> affix beginning with <s>s</s> follows — other than <s>sic</s> — <s>iṭ</s> is optionally [inserted]. [Examples:] <s>nartiṣyati</s> or <s>nartsyati</s> (simple future). <s>nṛtyatu</s> (imperative). <s>anṛtyat</s> (imperfect). <s>nṛtyet</s> (optative). <s>nṛtyāt</s> (benedictive). <s>anartīt</s> (aorist). <s>anartiṣyat</s> or <s>anartsyat</s> (conditional).
[Sūtra:] '<s>vā jṝ-bhramu-trasām</s>' (VLk 634 = P 6.4.124)

body.text: eṣāṃ kiti liṭi seṭi thali ca etvābhyāsalopau vā / tresatuḥ, tatrasatuḥ / tresitha, tatrasitha / trasitā //
body.translated_text: For these [roots], in the <s>liṭ</s> (perfect), when <s>kit</s>, when <s>iṭ</s> is present, and before <s>thal</s> — <s>e</s>-replacement and reduplicative syllable deletion optionally [apply]. [Examples:] <s>tresatuḥ</s> or <s>tatrasatuḥ</s> (perfect 3rd dual). <s>tresitha</s> or <s>tatrasitha</s> (perfect 2nd singular). <s>trasitā</s> (periphrastic future).
[Sūtra:] '<s>otaḥ śyani</s>' (VLk 635 = P 7.3.71)

body.text: lopaḥ syāt / śyati / śyataḥ / śyanti / śaśau / śaśatuḥ / śātā / śāsyati //
body.translated_text: Deletion [of the <s>o</s>-vowel] occurs [before <s>śyan</s>]. [Examples:] <s>śyati</s> (sharpens). <s>śyataḥ</s> (3rd dual). <s>śyanti</s> (3rd plural). <s>śaśau</s> (perfect). <s>śaśatuḥ</s> (perfect 3rd dual). <s>śātā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>śāsyati</s> (simple future).
[Sūtra:] '<s>vibhāṣā ghrā-dheṭ-śā-cchā-saḥ</s>' (VLk 636 = P 2.4.78)

body.text: ebhyassico lugvā syātparasmaipade pare / aśāt / aśātām / aśuḥ / iṭsakau / aśāsīt / aśāsiṣṭām //

children.text: 'vakhaṇḍane // 8 // dyati / dadau / deyāt / adāt // vyadha tāḍane // 9 //

body.translated_text: For these [roots], <s>sic</s> is optionally deleted (<s>luk</s>) when a <s>parasmaipada</s> [ending] follows. [Examples:] <s>aśāt</s> (aorist 3rd singular). <s>aśātām</s> (aorist 3rd dual). <s>aśuḥ</s> (aorist 3rd plural). With <s>iṭ</s> and <s>sak</s> — <s>aśāsīt</s> (aorist with <s>iṭ</s>). <s>aśāsiṣṭām</s> (aorist dual with <s>sak</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>grahi-jyā-vayi-vyadhi-vaṣṭi-vicati-vṛścati-pṛcchati-bhṛñjatīnāṃ ṅiti ca</s>' (VLk 637 = P 6.1.16)

body.text: eṣāṃ samprasāraṇaṃ syātkiti ṅiti ca / vidhyati / vivyādha / vividhatuḥ / vividhuḥ / vivyadhitha, vivyaddha / vyaddhā / vyatsyati / vidhyet / vidhyāt / avyātsīt //

children.text: puṣṭau // 10 // puṣyati / pupoṣa / pupoṣitha / poṣṭā / pokṣyati / puṣādītyaṅ / apuṣat //
children.translated_text: [means] nourishing. (Root 10) <s>puṣyati</s> (nourishes). <s>pupoṣa</s> (perfect). <s>pupoṣitha</s> (perfect 2nd singular). <s>poṣṭā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>pokṣyati</s> (simple future). By [the rule] '<s>puṣādi</s>' — <s>aṅ</s> [replaces <s>cli</s>]. <s>apuṣat</s> (aorist).

body.translated_text: For these [roots], <s>saṃprasāraṇa</s> (semivowel-to-vowel change) occurs when a <s>kit</s> or <s>ṅit</s> [affix] follows. [Examples:] <s>vidhyati</s> (pierces). <s>vivyādha</s> (perfect 3rd singular). <s>vividhatuḥ</s> (perfect 3rd dual). <s>vividhuḥ</s> (perfect 3rd plural). <s>vivyadhitha</s> or <s>vivyaddha</s> (perfect 2nd singular). <s>vyaddhā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>vyatsyati</s> (simple future). <s>vidhyet</s> (optative). <s>vidhyāt</s> (benedictive). <s>avyātsīt</s> (aorist).
[Sūtra:] '<s>radhādibhyaś ca</s>' (VLk 638 = P 7.2.45)

body.text: radh naś tṛp dṛp druh muh ṣṇuh ṣṇih ebhyo valādyārdhadhātukasya veṭ syāt / neśitha //
body.translated_text: From <s>radh</s>, <s>naś</s>, <s>tṛp</s>, <s>dṛp</s>, <s>druh</s>, <s>muh</s>, <s>ṣṇuh</s>, <s>ṣṇih</s> — from these, <s>iṭ</s> is optionally [inserted] before an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> beginning with <s>val</s>. [Example:] <s>neśitha</s> (perfect 2nd singular).
[Sūtra:] '<s>masji-naśor jhali</s>' (VLk 639 = P 7.1.60)

body.text: num syāt / nanaṃṣṭha / neśiva, neśva / neśima, neśma / naśitā, naṃṣṭā / naśiṣyati, naṅkṣyati / naśyatu / anaśyat / naśyet / naśyāt / anaśat //

children.text: prāṇiprasave // 13 // sūyate / suṣuve / krādiniyamādiṭ / suṣuviṣe / suṣuvivahe / suṣuvimahe / savitā sotā //
children.translated_text: [means] giving birth / producing offspring. (Root 13) <s>sūyate</s> (gives birth). <s>suṣuve</s> (perfect). By the <s>kṛ-ādi</s> restriction, <s>iṭ</s> is invariable. [Examples:] <s>suṣuviṣe</s> (perfect 2nd singular). <s>suṣuvivahe</s> (perfect 1st dual). <s>suṣuvimahe</s> (perfect 1st plural). <s>savitā</s> or <s>sotā</s> (periphrastic future).

body.translated_text: <s>Num</s> augment [is inserted] [before a <s>jhal</s> consonant]. [Examples:] <s>nanaṃṣṭha</s> (perfect 2nd singular alternative). <s>neśiva</s> or <s>neśva</s> (perfect 1st dual). <s>neśima</s> or <s>neśma</s> (perfect 1st plural). <s>naśitā</s> or <s>naṃṣṭā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>naśiṣyati</s> or <s>naṅkṣyati</s> (simple future). <s>naśyatu</s> (imperative). <s>anaśyat</s> (imperfect). <s>naśyet</s> (optative). <s>naśyāt</s> (benedictive). <s>anaśat</s> (aorist).
[Sūtra:] '<s>dīṅo yuḍ aci kṅiti</s>' (VLk 640 = P 6.4.63)

children.translated_text: (<s>Vārttika</s>:) '<s>vuG</s> and <s>yuṬ</s> should be stated [as applicable] in the context of <s>uvaṅ</s> and <s>yaṇ</s> operations.'

body.translated_text: For <s>dīṅ</s>, the <s>yuṭ</s> augment is inserted before a following <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> affix that is <s>kṅit</s> and begins with a vowel.
[Sūtra:] '<s>mīnāti-minoti-dīṅāṃ lyapi ca</s>' (VLk 641 = P 6.1.50)

body.text: eṣāmātvaṃ syāllyapi cādaśityejnimitte / dātā / dāsyati / (sthāghvorittve dīṅaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ) / adāsta //

children.translated_text: [means] flying / going through the sky. (Root 16) <s>ḍīyate</s> (flies). <s>ḍiḍye</s> (perfect). <s>ḍayitā</s> (periphrastic future).

body.translated_text: For these [roots], <s>ā</s>-replacement occurs also before <s>lyap</s>, when the trigger is not <s>śit</s> — i.e., when the trigger is [one that causes] <s>ej</s>-replacement. [Examples:] <s>dātā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>dāsyati</s> (simple future). (<s>Vārttika</s>:) 'The prohibition by <s>sthā-ghvoḥ</s> applies [also] to <s>dīṅ</s> regarding <s>e</s>-replacement.' [Aorist:] <s>adāsta</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>jñā-janor jā</s>' (VLk 642 = P 7.3.79)

body.text: anayorjādeśaḥ syācchiti / jāyate / jajñe / janitā / janiṣyate //
body.translated_text: For these two [roots <s>jñā</s> and <s>jan</s>], the substitute <s>jā</s> applies before a <s>śit</s> [affix]. [Examples:] <s>jāyate</s> (is born). <s>jajñe</s> (perfect). <s>janitā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>janiṣyate</s> (simple future).
[Sūtra:] '<s>dīpa-jana-budha-pūri-tāyi-pyāyibhyo 'nyatarasyām</s>' (VLk 643 = P 3.1.61)
From these [roots], <s>cli</s> is optionally replaced by <s>ciṇ</s> in the singular when the word <s>ta</s> follows.
[Sūtra:] '<s>ciṇo luk</s>' (VLk 644 = P 6.4.104)
The affix following <s>ciṇ</s> undergoes <s>luk</s> (deletion).
[Sūtra:] '<s>jani-vadhyoś ca</s>' (VLk 645 = P 7.3.35)

body.text: anayorupadhāyā vṛddhirna syācciṇi ñṇiti kṛti ca / ajani, ajaniṣṭa //
body.translated_text: For these two [roots], the penultimate vowel does not undergo <s>vṛddhi</s> before <s>ciṇ</s>, or before a <s>ñit</s> or <s>ṇit kṛt</s> affix. [Examples:] <s>ajani</s> or <s>ajaniṣṭa</s> (aorist).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ciṇ te padaḥ</s>' (VLk 646 = P 3.1.60)

body.text: padaścleściṇ syāttaśabde pare / apādi / apatsātām / apatsata //

children.text: avagamane // 23 // budhyate / boddhā / bhotsyate / bhutsīṣṭa / abodhi, abuddha / abhutsātām //
children.translated_text: [means] understanding / awakening. (Root 23) <s>budhyate</s> (understands). <s>boddhā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>bhotsyate</s> (simple future). <s>bhutsīṣṭa</s> (benedictive). <s>abodhi</s> or <s>abuddha</s> (aorist). <s>abhutsātām</s> (aorist 3rd dual).

body.translated_text: For [the root] <s>pad</s>, <s>cli</s> is [replaced by] <s>ciṇ</s> when the word <s>ta</s> follows. [Examples:] <s>apādi</s> (aorist 3rd singular). <s>apatsātām</s> (aorist 3rd dual). <s>apatsata</s> (aorist 3rd plural).
[Sūtra:] '<s>sṛji-dṛśor jhaly amakiti</s>' (VLk 647 = P 6.1.58)

body.text: anayoramāgamaḥ syājjhalādāvakiti / sraṣṭā / srakṣyati / sṛkṣīṣṭa / asṛṣṭa / asṛkṣātām //

children.text: titikṣāyām // 26 // mṛṣyati, mṛṣyate // mamarṣa / mamarṣitha / mamṛṣiṣe / marṣitāsi / marṣiṣyati, marṣiṣyate //
children.translated_text: [means] endurance / patience. (Root 26) <s>mṛṣyati</s> or <s>mṛṣyate</s> (endures). <s>mamarṣa</s> (perfect). <s>mamarṣitha</s> (perfect 2nd singular parasmaipada). <s>mamṛṣiṣe</s> (perfect 2nd singular ātmanepada). <s>marṣitāsi</s> (periphrastic future). <s>marṣiṣyati</s> or <s>marṣiṣyate</s> (simple future).

children.text: bandhane // 27 // nahyati, nahyate / nanāha / nehitha, nanaddha / nehe / naddhā / natsyati / anātsīt, anaddha //
children.translated_text: [means] binding. (Root 27) <s>nahyati</s> or <s>nahyate</s> (binds). <s>nanāha</s> (perfect). <s>nehitha</s> or <s>nanaddha</s> (perfect 2nd singular). <s>nehe</s> (perfect ātmanepada). <s>naddhā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>natsyati</s> (simple future). <s>anātsīt</s> or <s>anaddha</s> (aorist).

body.translated_text: For these two [roots], the <s>am</s>-augment does not apply before a <s>jhal</s>-initial [affix] that is not <s>kit</s>. [Examples:] <s>sraṣṭā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>srakṣyati</s> (simple future). <s>sṛkṣīṣṭa</s> (benedictive). <s>asṛṣṭa</s> (aorist). <s>asṛkṣātām</s> (aorist 3rd dual).
Thus [end] the <s>divādi</s> [roots]. (Gaṇa 4)
Now the <s>svādi</s> [roots].
[Sūtra:] '<s>svādibhyaḥ śnuḥ</s>' (VLk 648 = P 3.1.73)

body.text: śapo 'pavādaḥ / sunoti / sunutaḥ / huśnuvoriti yaṇ / sunvanti / sunvaḥ, sunuvaḥ / sunute / sunvāte / sunvate / sunvahe, sunuvahe / suṣāva, suṣuve / sotā / sunu / sunavāni / sunavai / sunuyāt / sūyāt //
body.translated_text: This is an exception to <s>śap</s>. [Examples:] <s>sunoti</s> (presses). <s>sunutaḥ</s> (3rd dual). By [the rule] '<s>hu-śnuvoḥ</s>' — <s>yaṇ</s> [applies]. <s>sunvanti</s> (3rd plural). <s>sunvaḥ</s> or <s>sunuvaḥ</s> (1st dual). <s>sunute</s> (3rd singular ātmanepada). <s>sunvāte</s> (3rd dual ātmanepada). <s>sunvate</s> (3rd plural ātmanepada). <s>sunvahe</s> or <s>sunuvahe</s> (1st dual ātmanepada). <s>suṣāva</s> or <s>suṣuve</s> (perfect). <s>sotā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>sunu</s> (imperative 2nd singular). <s>sunavāni</s> (imperative 1st singular). <s>sunavai</s> (imperative 1st singular ātmanepada). <s>sunuyāt</s> (optative). <s>sūyāt</s> (benedictive).
[Sūtra:] '<s>stu-su-dhūñbhyaḥ parasmaipadeṣu</s>' (VLk 649 = P 7.2.72)
From these [roots], <s>iṭ</s> is [inserted] before <s>sic</s> in <s>parasmaipada</s>. [Examples:] <s>asāvīt</s> or <s>asoṣṭa</s> (aorist).
[Sūtra:] '<s>vibhāṣā ceḥ</s>' (VLk 650 = P 7.3.58)

body.text: abhyāsātparasya kutvaṃ vā syātsani liṭi ca / cikāya, cicāya; cikye, cicye / acaiṣīt, aceṣṭa //
body.translated_text: The <s>ku</s>-replacement of [the consonant] following the reduplicative syllable is optional in <s>san</s> (desiderative) and <s>liṭ</s> (perfect). [Examples:] <s>cikāya</s> or <s>cicāya</s> (perfect parasmaipada); <s>cikye</s> or <s>cicye</s> (perfect ātmanepada). <s>acaiṣīt</s> or <s>aceṣṭa</s> (aorist).
[Sūtra:] '<s>śar-pūrvāḥ khayaḥ</s>' (VLk 651 = P 7.4.61)

body.text: abhyāsasya śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ śiṣyante 'nye halo lupyante / tastāra / tastaratuḥ / tastare / guṇor'tīti guṇaḥ / staryāt //
body.translated_text: In the reduplicative syllable, only the <s>kh</s>-class consonants preceded by <s>śar</s> (sibilants) are retained; other consonants are deleted. [Examples:] <s>tastāra</s> (perfect). <s>tastaratuḥ</s> (perfect 3rd dual). <s>tastare</s> (perfect ātmanepada). By [the rule] '<s>guṇo ṛti</s>' — <s>guṇa</s> [applies]. <s>staryāt</s> (benedictive).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṛtaś ca saṃyogādeḥ</s>' (VLk 652 = P 7.2.43)

body.text: ṛdantātsaṃyogādeḥ parayoḥ liṅsicoriḍvā syāttaṅi / stariṣīṣṭa, stṛṣīṣṭa / astariṣṭa, astṛta //

children.text: kampane // 4 // dhūnoti, dhūnute / dudhāva / svaratīti veṭ / dudhavitha, dudhotha //
children.translated_text: [means] shaking. (Root 4) <s>dhūnoti</s> or <s>dhūnute</s> (shakes). <s>dudhāva</s> (perfect). By [the rule] '<s>svarati</s>' — <s>iṭ</s> is optional. [Examples:] <s>dudhavitha</s> or <s>dudhotha</s> (perfect 2nd singular).

body.translated_text: From an <s>ṛ</s>-ending [root] beginning with a conjunct, <s>iṭ</s> is optionally [inserted] before <s>liṅ</s> and <s>sic</s> when <s>taṅ</s> [endings follow]. [Examples:] <s>stariṣīṣṭa</s> or <s>stṛṣīṣṭa</s> (benedictive). <s>astariṣṭa</s> or <s>astṛta</s> (aorist).
[Sūtra:] '<s>śry-ukaḥ kiti</s>' (VLk 653 = P 7.2.11)

body.text: śriña ekāca ugantācca gitkitoriṇ na / paramapi svaratyādivikalpaṃ bādhitvā purastātpratiṣedha kāṇḍārambha sāmarthyādanena niṣedhe prāpte krādiniyamānnityamiṭ / dudhuviva / dudhuve / adhāvīt, adhaviṣṭa, adhoṣṭa / adhaviṣyat, adhoṣyat / adhaviṣyatām, adhoṣyatām / adhaviṣyata, adhoṣyata //
body.translated_text: From <s>śriñ</s>, from a monosyllabic [root], and from one ending in <s>uk</s> — <s>iṭ</s> does not [occur] before a <s>git</s> or <s>kit</s> [affix]. Furthermore, overriding the optionality [stated in] '<s>svarati</s>' etc. by the force of commencing a new section of prohibitions, this rule being applicable — by the <s>kṛ-ādi</s> restriction, <s>iṭ</s> is invariable [elsewhere]. [Examples:] <s>dudhuviva</s> (perfect 1st dual). <s>dudhuve</s> (perfect ātmanepada). <s>adhāvīt</s>, <s>adhaviṣṭa</s>, or <s>adhoṣṭa</s> (aorist). <s>adhaviṣyat</s> or <s>adhoṣyat</s> (conditional parasmaipada). <s>adhaviṣyatām</s> or <s>adhoṣyatām</s> (conditional dual). <s>adhaviṣyata</s> or <s>adhoṣyata</s> (conditional plural).
Thus [end] the <s>svādi</s> [roots]. (Gaṇa 5)
Now the <s>tudādi</s> [roots].
[Sūtra:] '<s>tudādibhyaḥ śaḥ</s>' (VLk 654 = P 3.1.77)

body.text: śapo 'pavādaḥ / tudati, tudate / tutoda / tutoditha / tutude / tottā / atautsīt, atuta //

children.text: pāke // 3 // grahijyeti samprasāraṇam / sasya ścutvena śaḥ / śasya jaśtvena jaḥ / bhṛjjati, bhṛjjate //
children.translated_text: [means] cooking / frying. (Root 3) By [the rule] '<s>grahi-jyā</s>' — <s>saṃprasāraṇa</s> [applies]. The <s>s</s> [of the root] becomes <s>ś</s> by <s>ścutva</s>. The <s>ś</s> [further] becomes <s>j</s> by <s>jaśtva</s>. [Examples:] <s>bhṛjjati</s> or <s>bhṛjjate</s> (fries).

body.translated_text: This is an exception to <s>śap</s>. [Examples:] <s>tudati</s> or <s>tudate</s> (strikes). <s>tutoda</s> (perfect). <s>tutoditha</s> (perfect 2nd singular). <s>tutude</s> (perfect ātmanepada). <s>tottā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>atautsīt</s> or <s>atuta</s> (aorist).
[Sūtra:] '<s>bhrasjo ropadhayo ramanyatarasyām</s>' (VLk 655 = P 6.4.47)

body.translated_text: For [the root] <s>bhrasj</s>, <s>r</s>-augment is optionally inserted in place of the <s>r</s>-penultimate [vowel] before an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> [affix]. [The augment comes] after the <s>a</s> because of <s>mitva</s> (being <s>mit</s>, i.e., placed after the last vowel). Because the locative-case formulation indicates 'in the place of,' both the <s>r</s> and the penultimate [vowel] cease. [Perfect forms:] <s>babharja</s> (3rd singular). <s>babharjatuḥ</s> (3rd dual). <s>babharjitha</s> (2nd singular). [Without <s>r</s>-augment:] <s>babhrajja</s> (3rd singular). <s>babhrajjatuḥ</s> (3rd dual). <s>babhrajjitha</s> (2nd singular). By '<s>skoḥ</s>' — <s>s</s>-deletion. By '<s>vṛśca</s>' — <s>ṣ</s> [replacement]. <s>babhraṣṭha</s> (2nd singular alternative). <s>babharje</s> or <s>babhrajje</s> (perfect ātmanepada). <s>bharṣṭā</s> or <s>bhraṣṭā</s> (periphrastic future). <s>bharkṣyati</s> or <s>bhrakṣyati</s> (simple future). Overriding the <s>r</s>-augment by <s>saṃprasāraṇa</s> through prior-rule-priority, when <s>kṅit</s> — [Examples:] <s>bhṛjjyāt</s> (benedictive). <s>bhṛjjyāstām</s> (benedictive dual). <s>bhṛjjyāsuḥ</s> (benedictive plural). <s>bharkṣīṣṭa</s> or <s>bhrakṣīṣṭa</s> (benedictive ātmanepada). <s>abhārkṣīt</s> or <s>abhrākṣīt</s> (aorist). <s>abharṣṭa</s> or <s>abhraṣṭa</s> (aorist ātmanepada).
