saṃpeṣaṇe // 7 // kṣuṇatti, kṣunte / kṣottā // akṣudat, akṣautsīt, akṣutta /
dīptidevanayoḥ // 8 // chṛṇatti chṛnte / caccharda / se 'sicīti veṭ / cacchṛdiṣe, cacchṛtse / charditā / chardiṣyati, chartsyati / acchṛdat, acchardīt, acchardiṣṭa //
children.translated_text: [meaning:] shining and vomiting. (8th root) [Forms:] <s>chṛṇatti</s>, <s>chṛnte</s> (he vomits). [Perfect:] <s>caccharda</s>. By [the rule] '<s>se 'sicī</s>' — optionally <s>iṭ</s>. [Perfect 2nd sg.:] <s>cacchṛdiṣe</s>, <s>cacchṛtse</s>. [Future:] <s>charditā</s>. <s>chardiṣyati</s>, <s>chartsyati</s>. [Aorist:] <s>acchṛdat</s>, <s>acchardīt</s>, <s>acchardiṣṭa</s>.

body.translated_text: This is an exception to <s>śap</s>. [Forms:] <s>ruṇaddhi</s> (he obstructs). By '<s>śnaso 'l-lopaḥ</s>' — <s>rundhaḥ</s> (3rd du.). <s>rundhanti</s> (3rd pl.). <s>ruṇatsi</s> (2nd sg.). <s>rundhaḥ</s> (2nd du.). <s>rundha</s> (2nd pl.). <s>ruṇadhmi</s> (1st sg.). <s>rundhvaḥ</s> (1st du.). <s>rundhmaḥ</s> (1st pl.). [<s>Ātmanepada</s>:] <s>rundhe</s> (3rd sg.). <s>rundhāte</s> (3rd du.). <s>rundhate</s> (3rd pl.). <s>runtse</s> (2nd sg.). <s>rundhāthe</s> (2nd du.). <s>rundhve</s> (2nd pl.). <s>rundhe</s> (1st sg.). <s>rundhvahe</s> (1st du.). <s>rundhmahe</s> (1st pl.). [Perfect:] <s>rurodha</s>, <s>rurudhe</s>. [Periphrastic future:] <s>roddhāsi</s>, <s>roddhāse</s>. [Future:] <s>rotsyasi</s>, <s>rotsyase</s>. <s>rotsyati</s>, <s>rotsyate</s>. [Imperative:] <s>ruṇaddhu</s>, <s>rundhāt</s> (3rd sg.). <s>rundhām</s> (3rd du.). <s>rundhantu</s> (3rd pl.). <s>rundhi</s> (2nd sg.). <s>ruṇadhāni</s> (1st sg.). <s>ruṇadhāva</s> (1st du.). <s>ruṇadhāma</s> (1st pl.). [<s>Ātmanepada</s> imperative:] <s>rundhām</s>. <s>rundhātām</s>. <s>rundhatām</s>. <s>runtsva</s>. <s>ruṇadhai</s>. <s>ruṇadhāvahai</s>. <s>ruṇadhāmahai</s>. [Imperfect:] <s>aruṇat</s>, <s>aruṇad</s>. <s>arundhatām</s>. <s>arundhan</s>. <s>aruṇaḥ</s>, <s>aruṇat</s>, <s>aruṇad</s>. <s>arundha</s>. <s>arundhātām</s>. <s>arundhata</s>. <s>arundhāḥ</s>. [Optative:] <s>rundhyāt</s>. <s>rundhīta</s>. [Precative:] <s>rudhyāt</s>, <s>rutsīṣṭa</s>. [Aorist:] <s>arudhat</s>, <s>arautsīt</s>. <s>aruddha</s>. <s>arutsātām</s>. <s>arutsata</s>. [Conditional:] <s>arotsyat</s>, <s>arautsīt</s>. <s>aruddha</s>. <s>arutsātām</s>. <s>arutsata</s>. <s>arotsyat</s>, <s>arotsyata</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>tṛṇaha im</s>' (VLk 670 = P 7.3.92)

body.text: tṛhaḥ śnami kṛte imāgamo halādau piti sārvadhātuke / tṛṇeḍhi / tṛṇḍhaḥ / tatarha / tarhitā / atṛṇeṭ //
body.translated_text: For <s>tṛha</s>, when <s>śnam</s> [vikaraṇa] has been applied, the augment <s>im</s> is [inserted] before a <s>sārvadhātuka</s> affix that begins with a consonant and is marked with <s>p</s>. [Forms:] <s>tṛṇeḍhi</s> (3rd sg.). <s>tṛṇḍhaḥ</s> (3rd du.). [Perfect:] <s>tatarha</s>. [Future:] <s>tarhitā</s>. [Aorist:] <s>atṛṇeṭ</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>śnān na-lopaḥ</s>' (VLk 671 = P 6.4.23)

body.text: śnamaḥ parasya nasya lopaḥ syāt / hinasti / jihiṃsa / hiṃsitā //
body.translated_text: The <s>n</s> of <s>śnam</s> is deleted [before a following consonant]. [Forms:] <s>hinasti</s> (he injures). [Perfect:] <s>jihiṃsa</s>. [Future:] <s>hiṃsitā</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>tipy-anas-teḥ</s>' (VLk 672 = P 8.2.73)

body.text: padāntasya sasya daḥ syāttipi na tvasteḥ / sasajuṣorurityasyāpavādaḥ / ahinat, ahinad / ahiṃstām / ahiṃsan //
body.translated_text: At the end of a word, <s>s</s> becomes <s>d</s> before <s>tip</s> (3rd sg. ending), but not after <s>as</s>. This is an exception to [the rule] '<s>sasajuṣor</s>.' [Imperfect:] <s>ahinat</s>, <s>ahinad</s>. <s>ahiṃstām</s> (3rd du.). <s>ahiṃsan</s> (3rd pl.).
[Sūtra:] '<s>sipi dhātoḥ sa-rur vā</s>' (VLk 673 = P 8.2.74)

body.text: padāntasya dhātoḥ sasya ruḥ syādvā, pakṣe daḥ / ahinaḥ, ahinat, ahinad //

children.text: kledane // 13 // unatti / untaḥ / undanti / undāñcakāra / aunat, aunad / auntām / aundan / aunaḥ, aunat, aunad / aunadam //
children.translated_text: [meaning:] wetting. (13th root) [Forms:] <s>unatti</s> (he wets). <s>untaḥ</s> (3rd du.). <s>undanti</s> (3rd pl.). [Perfect with <s>ām</s>:] <s>undāñcakāra</s>. [Imperfect:] <s>aunat</s>, <s>aunad</s>. <s>auntām</s> (3rd du.). <s>aundan</s> (3rd pl.). <s>aunaḥ</s>, <s>aunat</s>, <s>aunad</s> (2nd sg.). <s>aunadam</s> (1st sg.).

children.text: vyaktimrakṣaṇakāntigatiṣu // 14 // anakti / aṅktaḥ / añjanti / ānañja / ānañjitha, ānaṅktha / añjitā, aṅktā / aṅgdhi / anajāni / ānak //
children.translated_text: [meaning:] manifestation, anointing, beauty, and going. (14th root) [Forms:] <s>anakti</s> (he anoints). <s>aṅktaḥ</s> (3rd du.). <s>añjanti</s> (3rd pl.). [Perfect:] <s>ānañja</s>. <s>ānañjitha</s>, <s>ānaṅktha</s> (2nd sg.). [Future:] <s>añjitā</s>, <s>aṅktā</s>. [Imperative:] <s>aṅgdhi</s>. <s>anajāni</s> (1st sg.). [Aorist:] <s>ānak</s>.

body.translated_text: At the end of a word, <s>s</s> of a verbal root optionally becomes <s>ru</s>; alternatively, <s>d</s> [applies]. [Imperfect 2nd sg.:] <s>ahinaḥ</s>, <s>ahinat</s>, <s>ahinad</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>añjeḥ sici</s>' (VLk 674 = P 7.2.71)

children.text: bhayacalanayoḥ // 16 // vinakti // viṅktaḥ / vija iḍiti ṅittvam / vivijitha / vijitā / avinak / avijīt //
children.translated_text: [meaning:] fear and trembling. (16th root) [Forms:] <s>vinakti</s> (he trembles). <s>viṅktaḥ</s> (3rd du.). By [the rule] '<s>vija iṭ</s>' — [the affix is treated as] <s>ṅit</s>. [Perfect:] <s>vivijitha</s> (2nd sg.). [Future:] <s>vijitā</s>. [Aorist:] <s>avinak</s>. <s>avijīt</s>.

children.text: viśeṣaṇe // 17 // śinaṣṭi / śiṃ śiṃṣṭaḥ / śiṃṣanti / śinakṣi / śiśeṣa / śiśeṣitha / śeṣṭā / śekṣyati / herdhiḥ / śiṇḍḍhi / śinaṣāṇi / aśinaṭ / śiṃṣyāt / śiṣyāt / aśiṣat // evaṃ
children.translated_text: [meaning:] distinguishing. (17th root) [Forms:] <s>śinaṣṭi</s> (he distinguishes). <s>śiṃṣṭaḥ</s> (3rd du.). <s>śiṃṣanti</s> (3rd pl.). <s>śinakṣi</s> (2nd sg.). [Perfect:] <s>śiśeṣa</s>. <s>śiśeṣitha</s> (2nd sg.). [Future:] <s>śeṣṭā</s>. <s>śekṣyati</s>. [By the rule] '<s>her dhiḥ</s>' — [Imperative:] <s>śiṇḍḍhi</s>. <s>śinaṣāṇi</s> (1st sg.). [Imperfect:] <s>aśinaṭ</s>. [Optative:] <s>śiṃṣyāt</s>. [Precative:] <s>śiṣyāt</s>. [Aorist:] <s>aśiṣat</s>. Similarly —

children.text: āmardane // 19 // śnānnalopaḥ / bhanakti / babhañjitha, babhaṅktha / bhaṅktā / bhaṅgdhi / abhāṅkṣīt //
children.translated_text: [meaning:] crushing / shattering. (19th root) By '<s>śnān na-lopaḥ</s>' — [<s>n</s> is deleted]. [Forms:] <s>bhanakti</s> (he shatters). [Perfect:] <s>babhañjitha</s>, <s>babhaṅktha</s> (2nd sg.). [Future:] <s>bhaṅktā</s>. [Imperative:] <s>bhaṅgdhi</s>. [Aorist:] <s>abhāṅkṣīt</s>.
[meaning:] protecting and eating. (20th root) [Forms:] <s>bhunakti</s> (he eats / protects). [Future:] <s>bhoktā</s>. <s>bhokṣyati</s>. [Aorist:] <s>abhunak</s>.

body.translated_text: After <s>añj</s>, <s>iṭ</s> is always (obligatorily) inserted before <s>sic</s> (the aorist marker <s>s</s>). [Aorist:] <s>āñjīt</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>bhujo 'navane</s>' (VLk 675 = P 1.3.66)

body.text: taṅānau staḥ / odanaṃ bhuṅkte / anavane kim? mahīṃ bhunakti //

children.text: dīptau // 21 // inddhe / indhāte / indhātām / inadhai / aindha / aindhatām / aindhāḥ /
children.translated_text: [meaning:] kindling. (21st root) [Forms:] <s>inddhe</s> (he kindles). <s>indhāte</s> (3rd du.). [Imperative:] <s>indhātām</s>. <s>inadhai</s> (1st sg.). [Imperfect:] <s>aindha</s>. <s>aindhatām</s> (3rd du.). <s>aindhāḥ</s> (2nd sg.).

body.translated_text: <s>Taṅ</s> [i.e. <s>ātmanepada</s>] endings apply [when <s>bhuj</s> means eating, not protecting]. [Example:] <s>odanaṃ bhuṅkte</s> (he eats rice). Why 'not in [the sense of] protecting'? [Because:] <s>mahīṃ bhunakti</s> (he protects the earth [takes <s>parasmaipada</s>]).
Thus [end] the <s>rudhādi</s> [roots]. (7th class)
Now [begin] the <s>tanādi</s> [roots].
[Sūtra:] '<s>tanādi-kṛñbhya uḥ</s>' (VLk 676 = P 6.1.79)

body.text: śapo 'pavādaḥ / tanoti, tanute / tatāna, tene / tanitāsi, tanitāse / tanotu / tanutām / atanot, atanuta / tanuyāt, tanvīta / tanyāt, taniṣīṣṭa / atānīt, atanīt //
body.translated_text: This is an exception to <s>śap</s>. [Forms:] <s>tanoti</s>, <s>tanute</s> (he extends). [Perfect:] <s>tatāna</s>, <s>tene</s>. [Periphrastic future:] <s>tanitāsi</s>, <s>tanitāse</s>. [Imperative:] <s>tanotu</s>. <s>tanutām</s>. [Imperfect:] <s>atanot</s>, <s>atanuta</s>. [Optative:] <s>tanuyāt</s>, <s>tanvīta</s>. [Precative:] <s>tanyāt</s>, <s>taniṣīṣṭa</s>. [Aorist:] <s>atānīt</s>, <s>atanīt</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>tanādibhyas tathāsoḥ</s>' (VLk 677 = P 2.4.79)

body.text: tanādeḥ sico vā luk syāttathāsoḥ / atata, ataniṣṭa / atathāḥ, ataniṣṭāḥ / ataniṣyat, ataniṣyata //
body.translated_text: After a <s>tanādi</s> root, <s>sic</s> (the aorist marker) is optionally deleted before <s>ta</s> and <s>thās</s>. [Aorist:] <s>atata</s>, <s>ataniṣṭa</s>. <s>atathāḥ</s>, <s>ataniṣṭāḥ</s>. [Conditional:] <s>ataniṣyat</s>, <s>ataniṣyata</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>ye vibhāṣā</s>' (VLk 678 = P 6.4.43)

body.text: janasanakhanāmātvaṃ vā yādau kṅiti / sāyāt, sanyāt //
body.translated_text: For <s>jan</s>, <s>san</s>, and <s>khan</s> — the replacement by <s>ā</s> is optional before [an affix beginning with] <s>y</s> that is marked with <s>k</s> or <s>ṅ</s>. [Precative:] <s>sāyāt</s>, <s>sanyāt</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>jana-sana-khanāṃ sañ-jhaloḥ</s>' (VLk 679 = P 6.4.42)

body.text: eṣāmākāre 'ntādeśaḥ syāt sani jhalādau kṅiti / asāta, asaniṣṭa //

children.text: hiṃsāyām // 3 // kṣaṇoti, kṣaṇute // hmyanteti na vṛddhiḥ / akṣaṇīt, akṣata, akṣaṇiṣṭa / akṣathāḥ, akṣaṇiṣṭhāḥ //
children.translated_text: [meaning:] injuring. (3rd root) [Forms:] <s>kṣaṇoti</s>, <s>kṣaṇute</s>. By [the rule] '<s>hmyanta</s>' — <s>vṛddhi</s> does not [apply]. [Aorist:] <s>akṣaṇīt</s>, <s>akṣata</s>, <s>akṣaṇiṣṭa</s>. <s>akṣathāḥ</s>, <s>akṣaṇiṣṭhāḥ</s> (2nd sg.).

children.text: ca // 4 // apratyaye laghūpadhasya guṇo vā / kṣeṇoti, kṣiṇoti / kṣeṇitā / akṣeṇīt, akṣita, akṣeṇiṣṭa //
children.translated_text: Also [meaning: injuring]. (4th root) Before an affix without <s>p</s>-marker, <s>guṇa</s> of the light penultimate is optional. [Forms:] <s>kṣeṇoti</s>, <s>kṣiṇoti</s>. [Future:] <s>kṣeṇitā</s>. [Aorist:] <s>akṣeṇīt</s>, <s>akṣita</s>, <s>akṣeṇiṣṭa</s>.

body.translated_text: For these [roots], the final is replaced by <s>ā</s> before <s>san</s> and before a <s>jhal</s>-initial [affix] marked with <s>k</s> or <s>ṅ</s>. [Aorist:] <s>asāta</s>, <s>asaniṣṭa</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>ata utsārvadhātuke</s>' (VLk 680 = P 6.4.110)

body.text: upratyayāntasya kṛño 'kārasya uḥ syāt sārvadhātuke kṅiti / kurutaḥ //
body.translated_text: The <s>a</s>-vowel of the <s>aṅga</s> (stem) ending in [the affix] <s>u</s> before a <s>kṅit sārvadhātuka</s> affix, for [the root] <s>kṛ</s>, becomes <s>u</s>. [Form:] <s>kurutaḥ</s> (they two do).
[Sūtra:] '<s>na bhak-urch-urām</s>' (VLk 681 = P 8.2.79)
There is no lengthening of the penultimate vowel when it is <s>u</s> in [a form ending in] <s>bha</s>, <s>kurch</s>, or <s>ur</s>. [Form:] <s>kurvanti</s> (they do).
[Sūtra:] '<s>nityaṃ karoteḥ</s>' (VLk 682 = P 6.4.108)

body.text: karoteḥ pratyayokārasya nityaṃ lopo mvoḥ parayoḥ / kurvaḥ / kurmaḥ / kurute / cakāra, cakre / kartāsi, kartāse / kariṣyati, kariṣyate / karotu / kurutām / akarot / akuruta //
body.translated_text: The <s>o</s>-vowel of the affix after <s>karoti</s> is always deleted when <s>m</s> or <s>v</s> follows. [Forms:] <s>kurvaḥ</s> (we two do). <s>kurmaḥ</s> (we do). <s>kurute</s> (he does, middle). [Perfect:] <s>cakāra</s>, <s>cakre</s>. [Future:] <s>kartāsi</s>, <s>kartāse</s>. [Future with <s>sya</s>:] <s>kariṣyati</s>, <s>kariṣyate</s>. [Imperative:] <s>karotu</s>. <s>kurutām</s>. [Imperfect:] <s>akarot</s>. <s>akuruta</s>.

body.text: kṛña ulopo yādau pratyaye pare / kuryāt, kurvīta / kriyāt, kṛṣīṣṭa / akārṣīt, akṛta / akariṣyat, akariṣyata //
body.translated_text: For [the root] <s>kṛñ</s>, the <s>u</s> [of the stem] is deleted when a <s>y</s>-initial affix follows. [Forms:] <s>kuryāt</s> (he should do), <s>kurvīta</s> (he should do, middle). [Precative:] <s>kriyāt</s>, <s>kṛṣīṣṭa</s>. [Aorist:] <s>akārṣīt</s>, <s>akṛta</s>. [Conditional:] <s>akariṣyat</s>, <s>akariṣyata</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>samparibhyāṃ karotau bhūṣaṇe</s>' (VLk 684 = P 6.1.137)
[Sūtra:] '<s>samavāye ca</s>' (VLk 685 = P 6.1.138)

body.text: samparipūrvasya karoteḥ suṭ syād bhūṣaṇe saṃghāte cārthe / saṃskaroti / alaṅkarotītyarthaḥ / saṃskurvanti / saṅghībhavantītyarthaḥ / sampūrvasya kvacidabhūṣaṇe 'pi suṭ / saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣā iti jñāpakāt //
body.translated_text: For <s>karoti</s> preceded by <s>sam</s> or <s>pari</s>, the augment <s>suṭ</s> is added in the sense of ornamentation and aggregation. [Form:] <s>saṃskaroti</s> — meaning 'he adorns.' <s>saṃskurvanti</s> — meaning 'they assemble together.' For [<s>karoti</s>] preceded by <s>sam</s>, <s>suṭ</s> sometimes [occurs] even without the sense of ornamentation, because [the rule] '<s>saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣā</s>' serves as an indicator (<s>jñāpaka</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>upāt-prati-yatna-vaikṛta-vākyādhyāhāreṣu ca</s>' (VLk 686 = P 6.1.139)

body.text: upātkṛñaḥ suṭ syādeṣvartheṣu cātprāguktayorarthayoḥ / pratiyatno guṇādhānam / vikṛtameva vaikṛtaṃ vikāraḥ / vākyādhyāhāra ākāṅkṣitaikadeśapūraṇam / upaskṛtā kanyā / upaskṛtā brāhmaṇāḥ / edhodakasyopaskaroti / upaskṛtaṃ bhuṅkte / upaskṛtaṃ brūte //

children.text: avabodhane // 8 // manute / mene / maniṣyate / manutām / amanuta / manvīta / maniṣīṣṭa / amata, amaniṣṭa / amaniṣyata //

body.translated_text: For <s>kṛñ</s> preceded by <s>upa</s>, <s>suṭ</s> is added in these senses, and in the two senses mentioned before. <s>Pratiyatna</s> means 'application of qualities.' <s>Vaikṛta</s> means 'modification' — that is, alteration itself. <s>Vākyādhyāhāra</s> means 'supplying an expected portion of a sentence.' [Examples:] <s>upaskṛtā kanyā</s> (an adorned girl). <s>upaskṛtā brāhmaṇāḥ</s> (honored <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>). <s>edhodakasyopaskaroti</s> (he prepares firewood and water). <s>upaskṛtaṃ bhuṅkte</s> (he eats what is prepared). <s>upaskṛtaṃ brūte</s> (he says what is supplied).
Thus [end] the <s>tanādi</s> [roots] — 8 [in total].
Now the <s>kryādi</s> [roots] (9th class):
[Sūtra:] '<s>kryādibhyaḥ śnā</s>' (VLk 687 = P 3.1.81)

body.text: śapo 'pavādaḥ / krīṇāti / ī halyaghoḥ / krīṇītaḥ / śnābhyastayorātaḥ / krīṇanti / krīṇāsi / krīṇīthaḥ / krīṇītha / krīṇāmi / krīṇīvaḥ / krīṇīmaḥ / krīṇīte / krīṇāte / krīṇate / krīṇīṣe / krīṇāthe / krīṇīdhve / krīṇe / krīṇīvahe / krīṇīmahe / cikrāya / cikriyatuḥ / cikriyuḥ / cikrayitha, cikretha / cikriya / cikriye / kretā / kreṣyati, kreṣyate / krīṇātu, krīṇītāt / krīṇītām / akrīṇāt, akrīṇīta / krīṇīyāt, krīṇīta / krīyāt, kreṣīṣṭa / akraiṣīt, akreṣyata //
body.translated_text: [This is] an exception to <s>śap</s>. [Forms:] <s>krīṇāti</s> (he buys). By [the rule] '<s>ī halyaghoḥ</s>' — <s>krīṇītaḥ</s> (they two buy). By [the rule] '<s>śnābhyastayorātaḥ</s>' — <s>krīṇanti</s> (they buy). <s>krīṇāsi</s>. <s>krīṇīthaḥ</s>. <s>krīṇītha</s>. <s>krīṇāmi</s>. <s>krīṇīvaḥ</s>. <s>krīṇīmaḥ</s>. [Middle:] <s>krīṇīte</s>. <s>krīṇāte</s>. <s>krīṇate</s>. <s>krīṇīṣe</s>. <s>krīṇāthe</s>. <s>krīṇīdhve</s>. <s>krīṇe</s>. <s>krīṇīvahe</s>. <s>krīṇīmahe</s>. [Perfect:] <s>cikrāya</s>. <s>cikriyatuḥ</s>. <s>cikriyuḥ</s>. <s>cikrayitha</s>, <s>cikretha</s>. <s>cikriya</s>. [Middle perfect:] <s>cikriye</s>. [Future:] <s>kretā</s>. <s>kreṣyati</s>, <s>kreṣyate</s>. [Imperative:] <s>krīṇātu</s>, <s>krīṇītāt</s>. <s>krīṇītām</s>. [Imperfect:] <s>akrīṇāt</s>, <s>akrīṇīta</s>. [Optative:] <s>krīṇīyāt</s>, <s>krīṇīta</s>. [Precative:] <s>krīyāt</s>, <s>kreṣīṣṭa</s>. [Aorist:] <s>akraiṣīt</s>, <s>akreṣyata</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>hinu-mīnā</s>' (VLk 688 = P 8.4.15)

body.text: upasargasthānnimittātparasyaitayornasya ṇaḥ syāt / pramīṇāti, pramīṇīte / mīnātītyātvam / mamau / mimyatuḥ / mamitha, mamātha / mimye / mātā / māsyati / mīyāt, māsīṣṭa / amāsīt / amāsiṣṭām / amāsta //

children.text: bandhane // 5 // sināti, sinīte / siṣāya, siṣye / setā //

body.translated_text: The <s>n</s> of <s>hinu</s> and <s>mīnā</s> standing after a cause [for <s>ṇatva</s>] in a prefix (<s>upasarga</s>) becomes <s>ṇ</s>. [Forms:] <s>pramīṇāti</s>, <s>pramīṇīte</s> (he injures greatly). <s>mīnāti</s> — the long vowel (<s>ātva</s>) [occurs here]. [Perfect:] <s>mamau</s>. <s>mimyatuḥ</s>. <s>mamitha</s>, <s>mamātha</s>. [Middle perfect:] <s>mimye</s>. [Future:] <s>mātā</s>. <s>māsyati</s>. [Optative:] <s>mīyāt</s>, <s>māsīṣṭa</s>. [Aorist:] <s>amāsīt</s>. <s>amāsiṣṭām</s>. <s>amāsta</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>stanbhu-stunbhu-skanbhu-skunbhu-sku-ñ-bhyaḥ śnu-ś ca</s>' (VLk 689 = P 3.1.82)

body.text: cāt śnā / skunoti, skunāti / skunute, skunīte / cuskāva, cuskuve / skotā / askauṣīt, askoṣṭa // stanbhvādayaścatvāraḥ sautrāḥ / sarve rodhanārthāḥ parasmaipadinaḥ //
body.translated_text: And [by the word] <s>ca</s>, <s>śnā</s> [also applies]. [Forms:] <s>skunoti</s>, <s>skunāti</s>. <s>skunute</s>, <s>skunīte</s>. [Perfect:] <s>cuskāva</s>, <s>cuskuve</s>. [Future:] <s>skotā</s>. [Aorist:] <s>askauṣīt</s>, <s>askoṣṭa</s>. The four [roots] <s>stanbh</s> etc. are Sūtra-based (<s>sautra</s>). All mean 'obstructing' and take <s>parasmaipada</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>halaḥ śnaḥ śānaj jhau</s>' (VLk 690 = P 3.1.83)

body.text: halaḥ parasya śnaḥ śānajādeśaḥ syāddhau pare / stabhāna //
body.translated_text: After a consonant, <s>śnā</s> is replaced by <s>śānac</s> when <s>jha</s> (3rd pl.) follows. [Form:] <s>stabhāna</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>jṝ-stanbhu-mrucu-mlucu-grucu-glucu-gluñcu-śvi-bhyaś ca</s>' (VLk 691 = P 3.1.58)
For these, <s>aṅ</s> optionally replaces <s>cli</s> [in the aorist].
[Sūtra:] '<s>stanbheḥ</s>' (VLk 692 = P 8.3.67)

body.text: stanbheḥ sautrasya sasya ṣaḥ syāt / vyaṣṭabhat / astambhīt //
body.translated_text: The <s>s</s> of the Sūtra-based [root] <s>stanbh</s> becomes <s>ṣ</s>. [Form:] <s>vyaṣṭabhat</s> (he obstructed). [Aorist:] <s>astambhīt</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>pvādīnāṃ hrasvaḥ</s>' (VLk 693 = P 7.3.80)

body.text: pūñ lūñ stṝñ kṝñ vṝñ dhūñ śṝ pṝ vṝ bhṝ mṝ dṝ jṝ jhṝ dhṝ nṝ kṝ ṝ gṝ jyā rī lī vlī plīnāṃ caturviṃśateḥ śiti hrasvaḥ / punāti, punīte / pavitā //

children.text: ācchādane // 13 // stṛṇāti / śarpūrvāḥ khayaḥ / tastāra / tastaratuḥ / tastare / starītā / staritā / stṛṇīyāt, stṛṇīta / stīryāt //
children.translated_text: [meaning:] covering / spreading. (13th root) [Forms:] <s>stṛṇāti</s>. By [the rule] '<s>śar-pūrvāḥ khayaḥ</s>' — [<s>ṣ</s>-substitution applies]. [Perfect:] <s>tastāra</s>. <s>tastaratuḥ</s>. [Middle perfect:] <s>tastare</s>. [Future:] <s>starītā</s>, <s>staritā</s>. [Optative:] <s>stṛṇīyāt</s>, <s>stṛṇīta</s>. [Precative:] <s>stīryāt</s>.

body.translated_text: For the twenty-four [roots] — <s>pūñ</s>, <s>lūñ</s>, <s>stṝñ</s>, <s>kṝñ</s>, <s>vṝñ</s>, <s>dhūñ</s>, <s>śṝ</s>, <s>pṝ</s>, <s>vṝ</s>, <s>bhṝ</s>, <s>mṝ</s>, <s>dṝ</s>, <s>jṝ</s>, <s>jhṝ</s>, <s>dhṝ</s>, <s>nṝ</s>, <s>kṝ</s>, <s>ṝ</s>, <s>gṝ</s>, <s>jyā</s>, <s>rī</s>, <s>lī</s>, <s>vlī</s>, <s>plī</s> — the vowel becomes short before a <s>śit</s> [affix]. [Forms:] <s>punāti</s>, <s>punīte</s> (he purifies). [Future:] <s>pavitā</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>liṅ-sicoḥ ātmanepadeṣu</s>' (VLk 694 = P 7.2.42)
For [roots] <s>vṛṅ</s>, <s>vṛñ</s>, and those ending in <s>ṝ</s>, <s>iṭ</s> is optionally inserted before <s>liṅ</s> and <s>sic</s> when <s>taṅ</s> (middle) [endings follow].
[Sūtra:] '<s>na liṅi</s>' (VLk 695 = P 7.2.39)

body.text: vṝta iṭo liṅi na dīrghaḥ / stariṣīṣṭa / uśceti kittvam / stīrṣīṣṭa / sici ca parasmaipadeṣu / astārīt / astāriṣṭām / astāriṣuḥ / astarīṣṭa, astariṣṭa, astīrṣṭa //

children.text: varaṇe // 15 // vṛṇāti, vṛṇīte / vavāra, vavare / varitā, varītā / udoṣṭhyetyuttvam / vūryāt / variṣīṣṭa, vūrṣīṣṭa / avārīt / avāriṣṭām / avariṣṭa, avarīṣṭa, avūrṣṭa //
kampane // 16 // dhunāti, dhunīte / dhavitā, dhotā / adhāvīt / adhaviṣṭa, adhoṣṭa //

body.translated_text: For [roots ending in] <s>vṝ</s>, there is no lengthening of <s>iṭ</s> in the <s>liṅ</s>. [Precative:] <s>stariṣīṣṭa</s>. By '<s>uś ca</s>' — <s>kit</s>-treatment [applies]: <s>stīrṣīṣṭa</s>. And in <s>sic</s> (aorist) in <s>parasmaipada</s> — <s>astārīt</s>. <s>astāriṣṭām</s>. <s>astāriṣuḥ</s>. [Middle aorist:] <s>astarīṣṭa</s>, <s>astariṣṭa</s>, <s>astīrṣṭa</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>graho 'liṭi dīrghaḥ</s>' (VLk 696 = P 7.2.37)

body.text: ekāco grahervihitasyeṭo dīrgho na tu liṭi / grahītā / gṛhṇātu / halaḥ śnaḥ śānajjhāviti śnaḥ śānajādeśaḥ / gṛhāṇa / gṛhyāt, grahīṣīṣṭa / hmyanteti na vṛddhiḥ / agrahīt / agrahīṣṭām / agrahīṣṭa / agrahīṣātām //

children.text: bhojane // 19 // aśnāti / āśa / aśitā / aśiṣyati / aśnātu / aśāna //
saṃbhaktau // 22 // vṛṇīte / vavṛṣe // vavṛḍhve / varitā, varītā / avarīṣṭa, avariṣṭa, avṛta //

body.translated_text: The <s>iṭ</s> prescribed for the monosyllabic [stem of] <s>grah</s> becomes long, except in the <s>liṭ</s> (perfect). [Future:] <s>grahītā</s>. [Imperative:] <s>gṛhṇātu</s>. By [the rule] '<s>halaḥ śnaḥ śānaj jhau</s>' — <s>śnā</s> is replaced by <s>śānac</s>: <s>gṛhāṇa</s> (take!). [Optative:] <s>gṛhyāt</s>, <s>grahīṣīṣṭa</s>. By '<s>hmyanta</s>' — no <s>vṛddhi</s>. [Aorist:] <s>agrahīt</s>. <s>agrahīṣṭām</s>. <s>agrahīṣṭa</s>. <s>agrahīṣātām</s>.
Thus [end] the <s>kryādi</s> [roots] — 9th [class, totaling 22 roots].
Now the <s>curādi</s> [roots] (10th class):
[Sūtra:] '<s>satyāpa-pāśa-rūpa-vīṇā-tūla-śloka-senā-loma-tvaca-varma-varṇa-cūrṇa-curādibhyo ṇic</s>' (VLk 697 = P 2.1.25)

body.text: ebhyo ṇic syāt / cūrṇāntebhyaḥ 'prātipadikāddhātvarthe'; ityeva siddhe teṣāmiha grahaṇaṃ prapañcārtham / curādibhyastu svārthe / puganteti guṇaḥ / sanādyantā iti dhātutvam / tipśabādi / guṇāyādeśau / corayati //
body.translated_text: After these, <s>ṇic</s> (the causative suffix) is added. After those ending in <s>cūrṇa</s>, [<s>ṇic</s> comes] from [the rule] '<s>prātipadikād dhātvarthe</s>' — since it is already established; their mention here is for the purpose of elaboration. But after the <s>curādi</s> [roots], <s>ṇic</s> is in one's own sense (<s>svārthe</s>). By '<s>puganta</s>' — <s>guṇa</s> [applies]. By '<s>sanādyantā</s>' — [the derivative has] the status of a <s>dhātu</s> (root). <s>tip</s> and the other [endings apply]. <s>guṇa</s> and <s>āy</s>-substitution [occur]. [Form:] <s>corayati</s> (he steals).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṇicaś ca</s>' (VLk 698 = P 1.3.74)

body.text: ṇijantādātmanepadaṃ syātkartṛgāmini kriyāphale / corayate / corayāmāsa / corayitā / coryāt, corayiṣīṣṭa / ṇiśrīti caṅ / ṇau caṅīti hrasvaḥ / caṅīti dvitvam / halādiḥ śeṣaḥ / dīrgho laghorityabhyāsasya dīrghaḥ / acūcurat, acūcurata //
body.translated_text: After a <s>ṇij</s>-final [root], <s>ātmanepada</s> endings apply when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent. [Middle:] <s>corayate</s>. [Periphrastic perfect:] <s>corayāmāsa</s>. [Future:] <s>corayitā</s>. [Optative:] <s>coryāt</s>, <s>corayiṣīṣṭa</s>. By '<s>ṇi-śrī</s>' — <s>caṅ</s> [replaces <s>cli</s>]. By '<s>ṇau caṅi</s>' — shortening. By '<s>caṅi</s>' — reduplication. The consonant-initial remainder [is kept]. By '<s>dīrgho laghoḥ</s>' — the reduplicative syllable is lengthened. [Aorist:] <s>acūcurat</s>, <s>acūcurata</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>acaḥ parasmin pūrva-vidhau</s>' (VLk 699 = P 1.1.57)

body.text: alvidhyarthamidam / paranimitto 'jādeśaḥ sthānivat syātsthāni bhūtādacaḥ pūrvatvena dṛṣṭasya vidhau kartavye / iti sthānivatvānnopadhāvṛddhiḥ / kathayati / aglopitvāddīrghasanvadbhāvau na / acakathat //
body.translated_text: This [rule] is for the purpose of [determining the scope of] <s>al</s>-operations. A vowel-replacement occasioned by a following [sound] is treated as if it were the original (<s>sthānivat</s>) — that is, it is treated as a vowel positioned before [the conditioning element], for the purpose of an operation to be performed [that depends on the prior element]. Thus, by <s>sthānivadbhāva</s> (treatment as original), <s>vṛddhi</s> of the penultimate vowel [applies]. [Form:] <s>kathayati</s> (he narrates). Because of <s>aglopitvāt</s> (non-deletion of <s>a</s>), neither lengthening nor <s>san</s>-like treatment [occurs]. [Aorist:] <s>acakathat</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>ī ca gaṇaḥ</s>' (VLk 700 = P 7.4.97)

body.text: gaṇayaterabhyāsasya ī syāccaṅpare ṇau cādat / ajīgaṇat, ajagaṇat //
body.translated_text: The reduplicative syllable of <s>gaṇay</s> becomes <s>ī</s> when <s>caṅ</s> follows, and also in <s>ṇi</s> when [the stem ends in] <s>a</s>. [Aorist:] <s>ajīgaṇat</s>, <s>ajagaṇat</s>.
Thus [end] the <s>curādi</s> [roots].
Now the <s>ṇyanta</s> (causative) derivation:
[Sūtra:] '<s>svatantraḥ kartā</s>' (VLk 701 = P 1.4.54)
The entity that is expressed as independent in an action is the agent (<s>kartā</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>tat-prayojako hetuś ca</s>' (VLk 702 = P 1.4.55)
The instigator of the agent receives the designation <s>hetu</s> (cause) and also <s>kartṛ</s> (agent).
[Sūtra:] '<s>hetumati ca</s>' (VLk 703 = P 3.1.26)

body.text: prayojakavyāpāre preṣaṇādau vācye dhātorṇic syāt / bhavantaṃ prerayati bhāvayati //
body.translated_text: When the sense is causative action — instigation and the like — <s>ṇic</s> is added after the root. [Example:] He causes [someone] to be — <s>bhāvayati</s> (he causes to be / he cultivates).
[Sūtra:] '<s>oḥ puyaṇjy apare</s>' (VLk 704 = P 7.4.80)

body.text: sani pare yadaṅgaṃ tadavayavābhyāsokārasya itsyāt pavargayaṇjakāreṣvavarṇapareṣu parataḥ // abībhavat //
body.translated_text: When <s>san</s> follows, the <s>o</s>-vowel of the reduplicative syllable of the stem becomes <s>i</s>, when a <s>p</s>-class consonant, <s>y</s>, <s>aṇ</s>, or <s>j</s> followed by <s>a</s>-vowel comes after. [Aorist:] <s>abībhavat</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>arti-hrī-vlī-rī-knūyī-kṣmāyy-ātāṃ puṅ ṇau</s>' (VLk 705 = P 7.3.36)
[By this rule, the vowel is replaced by the augment <s>puk</s> in the causative.] [Form:] <s>sthāpayati</s> (he causes to stand / he establishes).
[Sūtra:] '<s>tiṣṭhater it</s>' (VLk 706 = P 7.4.5)
The penultimate vowel is replaced by <s>i</s> when <s>caṅ</s> follows in the <s>ṇi</s> [causative]. [Aorist:] <s>atiṣṭhipat</s> (he caused to stand).
[Sūtra:] '<s>mitāṃ hrasvaḥ</s>' (VLk 707 = P 6.4.92)

body.text: ghaṭādīnāṃ jñapādīnāṃ copadhāyā hrasvaḥ syāṇṇau / ghaṭayati //

children.translated_text: [meaning:] knowing and making known. [Form:] <s>jñapayati</s> (he makes known). [Aorist:] <s>ajijñapat</s>.

body.translated_text: For the <s>ghaṭ</s>-class and <s>jñap</s>-class [roots], the penultimate vowel becomes short in the <s>ṇi</s> (causative). [Form:] <s>ghaṭayati</s> (he exerts).
Thus [ends] the <s>ṇyanta</s> (causative) derivation.
Now the <s>sannanta</s> (desiderative) derivation:

body.text: dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samānakartṛkādicchāyāṃ vā // VLk_708 = P_3,1.7 //
body.translated_text: [Sūtra:] '<s>dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samāna-kartṛkād icchāyāṃ vā</s>' (VLk 708 = P 3.1.7)
After a root that has the same agent as [the root] <s>iṣ</s> (to wish) — [and] from the object [of wishing] — the <s>san</s> affix is optionally added in the sense of desire.
[Sūtra:] '<s>san-yaṅoḥ</s>' (VLk 709 = P 6.1.9)

body.text: sannantasya yaṅantasya ca dhātoranabhyāsasya prathamasyaikāco dve sto 'jādestu dvitīyasya / sanyataḥ / paṭhitumicchati pipaṭhiṣati / karmaṇaḥ kim ? gamanenecchati / samāna kartṛkāt kim ? śiṣyāḥ paṭhantvitīcchati guruḥ / vā grahaṇādvākyamapi // luṅsanorghasḷ //
body.translated_text: For the <s>san</s>-final and <s>yaṅ</s>-final root, the first monosyllable of the non-reduplicated [portion] is reduplicated, and if vowel-initial, the second [portion is taken]. By '<s>sanyataḥ</s>' — [Form:] He wishes to read — <s>pipaṭhiṣati</s> (he wishes to read). [Objection:] '<s>karmaṇaḥ kim</s>?' [Why 'of the object'?] [Answer:] He wishes by going — <s>gamanena icchati</s> [is not desiderative since the root is not the object]. '<s>samāna-kartṛkāt kim</s>?' [Why 'same agent'?] [Answer:] The teacher wishes 'let the students read' — [here the agents differ, so no <s>san</s>]. By the word <s>vā</s>, a periphrastic expression is also [possible]. [By the rule] '<s>luṅ-sanoḥ ghaslṛ</s>' —
[Sūtra:] '<s>saḥ syārdhadhātuke</s>' (VLk 710 = P 7.4.49)

body.text: sasya taḥ syātsādāvārdhadhātuke / attumicchati jighatsati / ekāca iti neṭ //
body.translated_text: The <s>s</s> [of <s>san</s>] becomes <s>t</s> when a <s>sādi ārdhadhātuka</s> [affix] follows. [Example:] He wishes to eat — <s>jighatsati</s>. By '<s>ekāca</s>' — <s>iṭ</s> is not [inserted].
[Sūtra:] '<s>aj-jhana-gamāṃ sani</s>' (VLk 711 = P 6.4.16)
For vowel-final [roots], <s>han</s>, vowel-substitute [roots of] <s>gam</s>, etc. — lengthening [occurs] before a <s>jhal</s>-initial <s>san</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>iko jhal</s>' (VLk 712 = P 1.2.9)

body.text: igantājjhalādiḥ san kit syāt / ṝta iddhātoḥ / kartumicchati cikīrṣati //
body.translated_text: A <s>jhal</s>-initial <s>san</s> after an <s>ik</s>-final [root] is treated as <s>kit</s>. By '<s>ṝta iddhātoḥ</s>' — [Example:] He wishes to do — <s>cikīrṣati</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>sani graha-guhoś ca</s>' (VLk 713 = P 7.2.12)

body.text: graherguherugantācca sana iṇ na syāt / bubhūṣati //
body.translated_text: For <s>grah</s>, <s>guh</s>, and <s>ṛ</s>-final [roots], <s>iṭ</s> is not [inserted] before <s>san</s>. [Form:] <s>bubhūṣati</s> (he wishes to be).
Thus [ends] the <s>sannanta</s> (desiderative) derivation.
Now the <s>yaṅanta</s> (intensive/frequentative) derivation:

body.text: dhātorekāco halādeḥ kriyāsamabhihāre yaṅ // VLk_714 = P_3,1.22 //
body.translated_text: [Sūtra:] '<s>dhātor ekāco halādeḥ kriyā-samabhihāre yaṅ</s>' (VLk 714 = P 3.1.22)

body.text: paunaḥpunye bhṛśārthe ca dyotye dhātorekāco halāderyaṅ syāt //
body.translated_text: In the sense of repetition (<s>paunaḥpunya</s>) or intensity (<s>bhṛśārtha</s>), the affix <s>yaṅ</s> is added after a monosyllabic consonant-initial root.
[Sūtra:] '<s>guṇo yaṅ-lukoḥ</s>' (VLk 715 = P 7.4.82)

body.text: abhyāsasya guṇo yaṅi yaṅluki ca parataḥ / ṅidantatvādātmanepadam / punaḥ punaratiśayena vā bhavati bobhūyate / bobhūyāñcakre / abobhūyiṣṭa //
body.translated_text: The reduplicative syllable takes <s>guṇa</s> when <s>yaṅ</s> or <s>yaṅ-luk</s> follows. Because of [being] <s>ṅid</s>-final, <s>ātmanepada</s> [endings apply]. [Example:] He exists repeatedly or intensely — <s>bobhūyate</s>. [Periphrastic perfect:] <s>bobhūyāñcakre</s>. [Aorist:] <s>abobhūyiṣṭa</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>nityaṃ kauṭilye gatau</s>' (VLk 716 = P 3.1.23)

body.text: gatyarthātkauṭilya eva yaṅ syānna tu kriyāsamabhihāre //
body.translated_text: For a root meaning 'motion,' <s>yaṅ</s> is obligatory only in the sense of crookedness — not in the sense of repetition.
[Sūtra:] '<s>dīrgho 'kitaḥ</s>' (VLk 717 = P 7.4.83)

body.text: akito 'bhyāsasya dīrgho yaṅyaṅlukoḥ / kuṭilaṃ vrajati vāvrajyate //
body.translated_text: The reduplicative syllable becomes long for a non-<s>kit</s> [affix] in <s>yaṅ</s> and <s>yaṅ-luk</s>. [Example:] He walks crookedly — <s>vāvrajyate</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>yasya halaḥ</s>' (VLk 718 = P 6.4.49)

body.text: yasyeti saṃghātagrahaṇam / halaḥ parasya yaśabdasya lopa ārdhadhātuke / ādeḥ parasya / ato lopaḥ / vāvrajāñcakre / vāvrajitā //
body.translated_text: The word <s>yasya</s> [in the sūtra] refers to the cluster [as a whole]. The <s>ya</s>-sound following a consonant (<s>hal</s>) undergoes elision before an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> [suffix]. [The elision applies] to the following after the initial [sound]. The <s>a</s> undergoes elision. <s>Vāvrajāñcakre</s>. <s>Vāvrajitā</s>.
<s>Rīk</s> augment [is added] for [a root with] <s>ṛ</s> as penultimate. (VLk 719 = P 7.4.90)

body.text: ṛdupadhasya dhātorabhyāsasya rīgāgamo yaṅyaṅlukoḥ / varīvṛtyate / varīvṛtāñcakre / varīvartitā //
body.translated_text: For a <s>dhātu</s> (verbal root) with <s>ṛ</s> as penultimate, the <s>rīk</s> augment is added to the reduplicative syllable in the <s>yaṅ</s> (intensive) and <s>yaṅluk</s> (elided intensive). <s>Varīvṛtyate</s>. <s>Varīvṛtāñcakre</s>. <s>Varīvartitā</s>.
And in the <s>kṣubhnādi</s> group [retroflexion does not apply]. (VLk 720 = P 8.4.39)
Retroflexion (<s>ṇatva</s>) does not [apply]. <s>Narīnṛtyate</s>. <s>Jarīgṛhyate</s>.
Thus [ends] the procedure for <s>yaṅ</s>-final [intensive forms].
Now the procedure for <s>yaṅluk</s> (elided intensive).
The <s>yaṅ</s> [suffix undergoes] <s>luk</s> (elision) before a vowel-initial suffix, and [by the word <s>ca</s>] sometimes even without it. (VLk 721 = P 2.4.74)

body.text: yaṅo'ci pratyaye luk syāt, cakārāttaṃ vināpi kvacit / anaimittiko 'ya mantaraṅgatvādādau bhavati / tataḥ pratyayalakṣaṇena yaṅantatvāddvitvam / abhyāsakāryam / dhātutvāllaḍādayaḥ / śeṣātkartarīti parasmaipadam / carkarītaṃ cetyadādau pāṭhācchapo luk //
body.translated_text: The <s>yaṅ</s> [suffix] undergoes <s>luk</s> elision before a vowel-initial suffix, and by the word <s>ca</s>, sometimes even without [a vowel-initial suffix following]. This causeless [elision], being more internally applicable (<s>antaraṅga</s>), occurs first. Then, by the principle of suffix-characterization, reduplication [occurs] because [the stem is still characterized as] <s>yaṅ</s>-final. The operations pertaining to the reduplicative syllable [apply]. Because of being a <s>dhātu</s>, <s>laṭ</s> and the other [tense/mood markers are added]. <s>Parasmaipada</s> [applies because the agent is the remaining person]. <s>Śap</s> undergoes <s>luk</s> because of the listing [of these stems] in the <s>adādi</s> class beginning with <s>carkarītam</s>.
Optionally, for <s>yaṅ</s> [<s>iṭ</s> is inserted]. (VLk 722 = P 7.3.94)

body.text: yaṅlugantātparasya halādeḥ pitaḥ sārvadhātukasyeḍ vā syāt / bhūsuvoriti guṇaniṣedho yaṅluki bhāṣāyāṃ na, bobhotu, tetikte iti chandasi nipātanāt / bobhavīti, bobhoti / bobhūtaḥ / adabhyastāt / bobhuvati / bobhavāñcakāra, bobhavāmāsa / bobhavitā / bobhaviṣyati / bobhavītu, bobhotu, bobhūtāt / bobhūtām / bobhuvatu / bobhūhi / bobhavāni / abobhavīt, abobhot / abobhūtām / abobhavuḥ / bobhūyāt / bobhūyātām / bobhūyuḥ / bobhūyāt / bobhūyāstām / bobhūyāsuḥ / gātistheti sico luk / yaṅo vetīṭpakṣe guṇaṃ bādhitvā nityatvādvuk / abobhūvīt, abobhot / abobhūtām / abobhūvuḥ / abobhaviṣyat // .
body.translated_text: After a <s>yaṅluk</s>-final [stem], <s>iṭ</s> (the augment <s>i</s>) is optionally [inserted] before a consonant-initial <s>pit</s> (marked with <s>p</s>) <s>sārvadhātuka</s> [suffix]. The prohibition of <s>guṇa</s> by the rule '<s>bhūsuvoḥ</s>' does not [apply] to <s>yaṅluk</s> in common speech, because <s>bobhotu</s> and <s>tetikte</s> are stipulated as exceptions in the Vedic [usage]. <s>Bobhavīti</s> or <s>bobhoti</s>. <s>Bobhūtaḥ</s>. [<s>Num</s>-augment is blocked] because of being <s>abhyasta</s> (reduplicated). <s>Bobhuvati</s>. <s>Bobhavāñcakāra</s>, <s>bobhavāmāsa</s>. <s>Bobhavitā</s>. <s>Bobhaviṣyati</s>. <s>Bobhavītu</s> or <s>bobhotu</s>, <s>bobhūtāt</s>. <s>Bobhūtām</s>. <s>Bobhuvatu</s>. <s>Bobhūhi</s>. <s>Bobhavāni</s>. <s>Abobhavīt</s> or <s>abobhot</s>. <s>Abobhūtām</s>. <s>Abobhavuḥ</s>. <s>Bobhūyāt</s>. <s>Bobhūyātām</s>. <s>Bobhūyuḥ</s>. <s>Bobhūyāt</s>. <s>Bobhūyāstām</s>. <s>Bobhūyāsuḥ</s>. By the rule '<s>gātistha</s>,' the <s>sic</s> (aorist marker) undergoes <s>luk</s> elision. In the <s>iṭ</s> option [of the rule] '<s>yaṅo vā</s>,' overriding <s>guṇa</s>, <s>vuk</s> [augment applies] because of its obligatory nature. <s>Abobhūvīt</s> or <s>abobhot</s>. <s>Abobhūtām</s>. <s>Abobhūvuḥ</s>. <s>Abobhaviṣyat</s>.
Thus [ends] the procedure for <s>yaṅluk</s> (elided intensive).
Now the denominative verbs (<s>nāmadhātu</s>).
From a <s>sup</s>-ending (nominal form), relating to oneself, [the suffix] <s>kyac</s> [is added]. (VLk 723 = P 3.1.8)

body.text: iṣikarmaṇa eṣituḥ saṃbandhinaḥ subantādicchāyāmarthe kyac pratyayo vā syāt //
body.translated_text: From a <s>sup</s>-ending [word], the suffix <s>kyac</s> is optionally [added] in the sense of desiring — for one who is related [to the object] as the desirer and agent of [the desired] action.
The <s>sup</s> [ending undergoes elision] when [the stem becomes] a <s>dhātu</s> or <s>prātipadika</s>. (VLk 724 = P 2.4.71)
The <s>sup</s> (case ending), which is a component of these two [dhātu and prātipadika], undergoes <s>luk</s> elision.
And before <s>kyac</s> [the <s>a</s>-vowel becomes <s>ī</s>]. (VLk 725 = P 7.4.33)
The <s>a</s>-vowel [becomes] <s>ī</s>. [One who] desires a son for himself — <s>putrīyati</s>.
Before <s>kya</s> [suffixes], a <s>n</s>-final [form] alone is a <s>pada</s>. (VLk 726 = P 1.4.15)

body.text: kyaci kyaṅi ca nāntameva padaṃ nānyat / nalopaḥ / rājīyati / nāntameveti kim? vācyati / hali ca / gīryati / pūryati / dhātorityeva / neha - divamicchati divyati //
body.translated_text: Before <s>kyac</s> and <s>kyaṅ</s>, only an <s>n</s>-final [form] is a <s>pada</s>, not anything else. The <s>n</s> undergoes elision. <s>Rājīyati</s>. Why [the restriction to] '<s>n</s>-final only'? <s>Vācyati</s>. And before a consonant: <s>gīryati</s>. <s>Pūryati</s>. [The restriction applies] only to [forms related to] a <s>dhātu</s>. Not here: [one who] desires heaven — <s>divyati</s> [is not formed this way].
For <s>kya</s> [suffixes], optionally [elision applies]. (VLk 727 = P 6.4.50)

body.text: halaḥ parayoḥ kyackyaṅārelopo vārdhadhātuke / ādeḥ parasya / ato lopaḥ / tasya sthānivattvāllaghūpadhaguṇo na / samidhitā, samidhyitā //
body.translated_text: For <s>kyac</s> and <s>kyaṅ</s> following a consonant, elision [of the root-portion] optionally [applies] before an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> [suffix]. [The elision applies] to the following after the initial [sound]. The <s>a</s> undergoes elision. Because of the <s>sthānivat</s> (original-like) treatment of that [elision], the <s>guṇa</s> of a light penultimate does not [apply]. <s>Samidhitā</s> or <s>samidhyitā</s>.
And <s>kāmyac</s> [suffix may also be added]. (VLk 728 = P 3.1.9)

body.text: uktaviṣaye kāmyac syāt / putramātmana icchati putrakāmyati / putrakāmyitā //
body.translated_text: In the domain stated [above], <s>kāmyac</s> may [also] be [added]. [One who] desires a son for himself — <s>putrakāmyati</s>. <s>Putrakāmyitā</s>.
From a word denoting comparison, in the sense of conduct. (VLk 729 = P 3.1.10)

body.text: upamānātkarmaṇaḥ subantādācārer'the kyac / putramivācarati putrīyati chātram / viṣṇūyati dvijam //

children.translated_text: (From all <s>prātipadikas</s>, <s>kvip</s> [suffix] is optionally to be stated

children.text: ḥ) / ato guṇe / kṛṣṇa ivācarati kṛṣṇati / sva ivācarati svati / sasvau //
children.translated_text: .) <s>Guṇa</s> [applies] for [a stem ending in] <s>a</s>. He acts like <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> — <s>kṛṣṇati</s>. He acts like himself — <s>svati</s>. <s>Sasvau</s> (perfect dual).

body.translated_text: From a word denoting comparison, relating to the object, the suffix <s>kyac</s> [is added] from a <s>sup</s>-ending [word] in the sense of conduct. He treats [the student] as if [he were his own] son — <s>putrīyati chātram</s>. <s>Viṣṇūyati dvijam</s> (he treats the brahmin as <s>Viṣṇu</s>).
For [a stem] ending in a nasal, the penultimate is lengthened before <s>kvi</s> and before a <s>jhal</s>-initial <s>kṅit</s> [suffix]. (VLk 730 = P 6.4.15)

body.text: anunāsikāntasyopadhāyā dīrghaḥ syātkvau jhalādau ca kṅiti / idamivācarati idāmati / rājeva rājānati / panthā iva pathīnati //
body.translated_text: The penultimate of a nasal-final [stem] is lengthened before <s>kvi</s> [suffix] and before a <s>jhal</s>-initial <s>kṅit</s> [suffix]. He acts like 'this' — <s>idāmati</s>. Like a king — <s>rājānati</s>. Like a path — <s>pathīnati</s>.
From <s>kaṣṭa</s> (difficulty), in the sense of exertion [to reach something]. (VLk 731 = P 2.1.14)

body.text: caturthyantāt kaṣṭaśabdādutsāher'the kyaṅ syāt / kaṣṭāya kramate kaṣṭāyate / pāpaṃ kartumutsahata ityarthaḥ //
body.translated_text: From the word <s>kaṣṭa</s> in the dative, the suffix <s>kyaṅ</s> [is added] in the sense of exerting effort. He exerts himself toward difficulty — <s>kaṣṭāyate</s>. The meaning is: he dares to do evil.
From <s>śabda</s>, <s>vaira</s>, <s>kalaha</s>, <s>abhra</s>, <s>kaṇva</s>, <s>megha</s> — in the sense of producing. (VLk 732 = P 3.1.17)

body.text: ebhyaḥ karmabhyaḥ karotyarthe kyaṅ syāt / śabdaṃ karoti śabdāyate // (ga.sū)

children.translated_text: 'From a <s>prātipadika</s> (nominal stem), in the sense of a verbal action, variously, and like [the rules for] the superlative (<s>iṣṭha</s>)'

children.text: / prātipadikāddhātvarthe ṇic syāt, iṣṭhe yathā prātipadikasya puṃvadbhāva-rabhāva-ṭilopa- vinmatublopa-yaṇādilopa-prasthasphādyādeśa-bhasaṃjñāstadvaṇṇāvapi syuḥ / ityallopaḥ / ghaṭaṃ karotyācaṣṭe vā ghaṭayati //
children.translated_text: — from a <s>prātipadika</s>, in the sense of a verbal action, <s>ṇic</s> [is added], and just as for <s>iṣṭha</s>, the operations of masculine-form treatment, elision of <s>ra</s>, <s>ṭi</s>-elision, elision of <s>vinmatup</s>, elision of <s>yaṇ</s> and the like, substitution of <s>prastha-spha</s> etc., and the <s>bha</s>-designation — these too apply. The <s>a</s> undergoes elision. He makes or declares a pot — <s>ghaṭayati</s>.

body.translated_text: From these [words denoting] objects, the suffix <s>kyaṅ</s> [is added] in the sense of 'making.' He makes sound — <s>śabdāyate</s>.
Thus [end] the denominative verbs (<s>nāmadhātu</s>).
Now the <s>kaṇḍvādi</s> group.
From the <s>kaṇḍū</s>-group, <s>yak</s> [suffix is added]. (VLk 733 = P 3.1.27)

children.translated_text: [used] in the sense of scratching the body. (1) <s>Kaṇḍūyati</s>. <s>Kaṇḍūyata</s>, and so forth.

body.translated_text: From these verbal roots, <s>yak</s> is always [added] in the root's own sense.
Thus [end] the <s>kaṇḍvādi</s> group.
Now the procedure for <s>ātmanepada</s> (middle voice).
In the active voice, when there is reciprocal exchange of actions. (VLk 734 = P 1.3.14)

body.text: kriyāvinimaye dyotye kartaryātmanepadam / vyatilunīte / anyasya yogyaṃ lavanaṃ karotītyarthaḥ //
body.translated_text: When mutual exchange of actions is to be expressed, <s>ātmanepada</s> [is used] in the active [sense]. <s>Vyatilunīte</s> — the meaning is: he performs the reaping that is proper to another.
Not from [roots meaning] going and harming. (VLk 735 = P 1.3.15)
<s>Vyatigacchanti</s> (they cross each other). <s>Vyatighnanti</s> (they strike each other).
For <s>viś</s> (to enter) after <s>ni</s>. (VLk 736 = P 1.3.17)
<s>Niviśate</s> (he settles down).
For <s>krī</s> (to buy) after <s>pari</s>, <s>vi</s>, and <s>ava</s>. (VLk 737 = P 1.3.18)
<s>Parikrīṇīte</s> (he buys all around). <s>Vikrīṇīte</s> (he sells). <s>Avakrīṇīte</s> (he buys down/redeems).
For <s>ji</s> (to conquer) after <s>vi</s> and <s>parā</s>. (VLk 738 = P 1.3.19)
<s>Vijayate</s> (he conquers). <s>Parājayate</s> (he is defeated).
For <s>sthā</s> (to stand) after <s>sam</s>, <s>ava</s>, <s>pra</s>, and <s>vi</s>. (VLk 739 = P 1.3.22)
<s>Saṃtiṣṭhate</s> (he stands together). <s>Avatiṣṭhate</s> (he remains). <s>Pratiṣṭhate</s> (he is established). <s>Vitiṣṭhate</s> (he stands apart).
For <s>jñā</s> (to know) in the sense of denial. (VLk 740 = P 1.3.44)
<s>Śatamapajānīte</s> — the meaning is: he denies [having] a hundred.
And when intransitive. (VLk 741 = P 1.3.45)
<s>Sarpiṣo jānīte</s> — the meaning is: he acts by the means of ghee (i.e., he knows the way of ghee).
For <s>car</s> (to move) after <s>ud</s>, when transitive. (VLk 742 = P 1.3.53)
<s>Dharmamuccarate</s> — the meaning is: he goes transgressing <s>dharma</s>.
For <s>car</s> after <s>sam</s>, when accompanied by a third-case [word]. (VLk 743 = P 1.3.54)
<s>Rathena sañcarate</s> (he moves about by chariot).
And for <s>dāṇ</s> (to give), if the third-case [word] has the sense of the fourth case (dative). (VLk 744 = P 1.3.55)

body.text: sampūrvāddāṇastṛtīyāntena yuktāduktaṃ syāt tṛtīyā ceccaturthyarthe / dāsyā saṃyacchate kāmī //
body.translated_text: From <s>dāṇ</s> with the prefix <s>sam</s>, when accompanied by a third-case [word], the stated [<s>ātmanepada</s>] applies if the third case has the sense of the dative. <s>Dāsyā saṃyacchate kāmī</s> (the lover restrains himself for the sake of the servant-girl).
Like the preceding [root], for <s>san</s> (desiderative). (VLk 745 = P 1.2.62)

body.text: sanaḥ pūrvo yo dhātustena tulyaṃ sannantādapyātmanepadaṃ syāt / edidhiṣyate //
body.translated_text: The root that precedes <s>san</s> — like that [root], <s>ātmanepada</s> applies from the <s>san</s>-final [desiderative] as well. <s>Edidhiṣyate</s> (he desires fuel/wife).
And after a consonant-final [root]. (VLk 746 = P 1.2.10)

body.text: iksamīpāddhalaḥ paro jhalādiḥ san kit / nivivikṣate //
body.translated_text: After <s>ik</s>-sounds and near [them], a <s>san</s> [suffix] that follows a consonant and begins with <s>jhal</s> is <s>kit</s> (marked with <s>k</s>). <s>Nivivikṣate</s> (he desires to enter).

children.translated_text: In the senses of hinting, reproaching, serving, daring, striving, declaring, and employing. (VLk 747 = P 1.3.32)

children.text:
kṛñaḥ
gandhanaṃ sūcanam / utkurute / sūcayatītyarthaḥ / avakṣepaṇaṃ bhartsanam / śyeno vartikāmutkurute / bhartsayatītyarthaḥ / harimupakurute / sevata ityarthaḥ / paradārān prakurute / teṣu sahasā pravartate / edhodakasyopaskurute / guṇamādhatte / kathāḥ prakurute / prakathayatītyarthaḥ / śataṃ prakurute / dharmārthaṃ viniyuṅkte / eṣu kim ? kaṭaṃ karoti //
children.translated_text:
For [the root] <s>kṛñ</s> (to do):
Hinting means suggesting. <s>Utkurute</s> — the meaning is: he suggests. Reproaching means scolding. <s>Śyeno vartikāmutkurute</s> — the meaning is: the hawk scolds the quail. <s>Harimupakurute</s> — he serves <s>Hari</s>. <s>Paradārān prakurute</s> — he ventures boldly toward the wives of others. <s>Edhodakasyopaskurute</s> — he adds a quality [to fuel and water]. <s>Kathāḥ prakurute</s> — the meaning is: he narrates stories. <s>Śataṃ prakurute</s> — he employs a hundred for the purpose of <s>dharma</s>. Why [the restriction to] these [senses]? [Because otherwise:] <s>kaṭaṃ karoti</s> (he makes a mat) [takes <s>parasmaipada</s>].

body.translated_text: For <s>bhuj</s> (to eat/enjoy), when not in the sense of bending. (VLk 748 = P 1.3.66)

body.text: odanaṃ bhuṅkte / anavane kim ? mahīṃ bhunakti //
body.translated_text: <s>Odanaṃ bhuṅkte</s> (he eats rice). Why [the restriction] 'not in the sense of bending'? <s>Mahīṃ bhunakti</s> (he bends the earth).
Thus [ends] the procedure for <s>ātmanepada</s>.
Now the procedure for <s>parasmaipada</s> (active voice).
For <s>kṛñ</s> (to do) after <s>anu</s> and <s>parā</s>. (VLk 748a = P 1.3.79)

body.text: kartṛge ca phale gandhanādau ca parasmaipadaṃ syāt / anukaroti / parākaroti //
body.translated_text: When the fruit [of the action] accrues to the agent, and in the senses of hinting and the rest, <s>parasmaipada</s> applies. <s>Anukaroti</s> (he imitates). <s>Parākaroti</s> (he injures).
For <s>kṣip</s> (to throw) after <s>abhi</s>, <s>prati</s>, and <s>ati</s>. (VLk 749 = P 1.3.80)

children.translated_text: [used] in the sense of throwing, [marked with] <s>svarita</s> accent. <s>Abhikṣipati</s> (he reviles).

body.translated_text: For <s>vah</s> (to carry) after <s>pra</s>. (VLk 750 = P 1.3.81)
<s>Pravahati</s> (he carries forth).
For <s>mṛṣ</s> (to endure) after <s>pari</s>. (VLk 751 = P 1.3.82)
<s>Parimṛṣyati</s> (he disregards).
For <s>ram</s> (to delight) after <s>vi</s>, <s>āṅ</s>, and <s>pari</s>. (VLk 752 = P 1.3.83)

children.translated_text: [used] in the sense of play. <s>Viramati</s> (he ceases).

body.translated_text: And after <s>upa</s>. (VLk 753 = P 1.3.84)
<s>Yajñadattamuparamati</s> — the meaning is: he causes <s>Yajñadatta</s> to cease. This has the <s>ṇic</s> (causative) sense included within it.
Thus [ends] the procedure for <s>parasmaipada</s>.
Thus [ends] the section on voice-assignment (<s>padavyavasthā</s>).
Now the procedure for <s>bhāva</s> (impersonal passive) and <s>karma</s> (object-oriented passive).
In the <s>bhāva</s> (impersonal) and <s>karma</s> (object-oriented passive). (VLk 754 = P 1.3.13)
<s>Ātmanepada</s> [is used] for the <s>la</s>-suffixes (tense/mood markers).
<s>Yak</s> [suffix is added] in the <s>sārvadhātuka</s> [domain]. (VLk 755 = P 3.1.67)

body.text:
dhātoryak bhāvakarmavācini sārvadhātuke / bhāvaḥ kriyā / sā ca bhāvārthakalakāreṇānūdyate / yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvātprathamaḥ puruṣaḥ / tiṅvācyakriyāyā adravya rūpatvena dvitvādyapratīterna dvivacanādi kiṃtvekavacanamevotsargataḥ /
tvayā mayā anyaiśca bhūyate / babhūve //
body.translated_text:
After a <s>dhātu</s> (verbal root), <s>yak</s> [is added] when [the <s>la</s>-suffix] denotes <s>bhāva</s> (impersonal) or <s>karma</s> (object) in the <s>sārvadhātuka</s> [domain]. <s>Bhāva</s> means action. And that is referenced by the tense/mood marker in the <s>bhāva</s> sense. Because there is no co-referentiality with <s>yuṣmad</s> (you) or <s>asmad</s> (I), the third person [is used]. Because the action denoted by the <s>tiṅ</s>-ending is not a substance and therefore has no duality, etc., there is no dual or plural — only the singular by default.
<s>Tvayā mayā anyaiśca bhūyate</s> (by you, by me, and by others, there is existing). <s>Babhūve</s> (perfect).

body.text: syasicsīyuṭtāsiṣu bhāvakarmaṇorupadeśe 'jjhanagrahadṛśāṃ vā ciṇvadiṭ ca // VLk_756 = P_6,4.62 //
body.translated_text: Before <s>sya</s>, <s>sic</s>, <s>sīyuṭ</s>, and <s>tāsi</s>, for roots ending in a vowel in the original enunciation — and for <s>han</s>, <s>grah</s>, <s>dṛś</s> — <s>ciṇvat</s> [treatment] and <s>iṭ</s> [augment are both optional]. (VLk 756 = P 6.4.62)

body.text: upadeśe yo 'c tadantānāṃ hanādīnāṃ ca ciṇīvāṅgakāryaṃ vā syātsyādiṣu bhāvakarmaṇorgamyamānayoḥ syādīnāmiḍāgamaśca / ciṇvadbhāvapakṣe 'yamiṭ / ciṇvadbhāvād vṛddhiḥ / bhāvitā, bhavitā / bhāviṣyate, bhaviṣyate / bhūyatām / abhūyata / bhāviṣīṣṭa, bhaviṣīṣṭa //
body.translated_text: For roots ending in a vowel in the original enunciation, and for <s>han</s> and the rest, the stem-operations as if <s>ciṇ</s> [were present] are optionally [applied] before <s>sya</s> and the rest, when <s>bhāva</s> or <s>karma</s> is understood; and the <s>iṭ</s> augment for <s>sya</s> and the rest [is also optional]. In the <s>ciṇvat</s>-option, this <s>iṭ</s> [applies]. Because of the <s>ciṇvat</s> treatment, <s>vṛddhi</s> [applies]. <s>Bhāvitā</s> or <s>bhavitā</s>. <s>Bhāviṣyate</s> or <s>bhaviṣyate</s>. <s>Bhūyatām</s>. <s>Abhūyata</s>. <s>Bhāviṣīṣṭa</s> or <s>bhaviṣīṣṭa</s>.
<s>CiṆ</s> [replaces the <s>cl</s>-suffix] in the <s>bhāva</s> and <s>karma</s> [passive]. (VLk 757 = P 3.1.66)

body.text: cleściṇsyādbhāvakarmavācini taśabde pare / abhāvi / abhāviṣyata, abhaviṣyata / akarmako 'pyupasargavaśātsakarmakaḥ / anubhūyate ānandaścaitreṇa tvayā mayā ca / anubhūyete / anubhūyante / tvamanubhūyase / ahamanubhūye / anvabhāvi / anvabhāviṣātām, anvabhaviṣātām / ṇilopaḥ / bhāvyate / bhāvayāñcakre, bhāvayāmbabhūve, bhāvayāmāse / ciṇvadiṭ / ābhīyatvenā siddhatvāṇṇilopaḥ / bhāvitā, bhāvayitā / bhāviṣyate, bhāvayiṣyate / abhāvyata / bhāvyeta / bhāviṣīṣṭa, bhāvayiṣīṣṭa / abhāvi / abhāviṣātām, abhāvayiṣātām // bubhūṣyate // akṛtsārvadhātukayordīrghaḥ / stūyate viṣṇuḥ / stāvitā, stotā / stāviṣyate, stoṣyate / astāvi / astāviṣātām, astoṣātām //

children.translated_text: [used] in the sense of going. <s>Guṇa</s> of <s>ṛ</s> gives <s>ar</s> — thus <s>guṇa</s> [applies]. <s>Aryate</s>.

children.text: smaraṇe / smaryate / sasmare / upadeśagrahaṇācciṇvadiṭ / āritā, artā / smāritā, smartā / aniditāmiti nalopaḥ / trasyate / iditastu nandyate / saṃprasāraṇam / ijyate //
children.translated_text: [used] in the sense of remembering. <s>Smaryate</s>. <s>Sasmare</s> (perfect). Because of the mention of 'in the <s>upadeśa</s>,' <s>ciṇvat</s> [treatment and] <s>iṭ</s> [apply]. <s>Āritā</s> or <s>artā</s>. <s>Smāritā</s> or <s>smartā</s>. By the rule '<s>aniditām</s>,' elision of <s>n</s> [applies]. <s>Trasyate</s> (passive of <s>tras</s>, to fear). But [for a root] marked with <s>i</s>: <s>nandyate</s> (passive of <s>nand</s>, to rejoice). <s>Saṃprasāraṇa</s> [applies]: <s>ijyate</s> (passive of <s>yaj</s>, to sacrifice).

body.translated_text: In place of <s>cli</s> (aorist marker), <s>ciṇ</s> is [substituted] when [the <s>la</s>-suffix] denotes <s>bhāva</s> or <s>karma</s>, before a <s>ta</s>-ending. <s>Abhāvi</s> (aorist passive). <s>Abhāviṣyata</s> or <s>abhaviṣyata</s> (conditional passive). An intransitive [root] also [becomes] transitive through the force of a preverb (<s>upasarga</s>). <s>Anubhūyate ānandaścaitreṇa tvayā mayā ca</s> (bliss is experienced by <s>Caitra</s>, by you, and by me). <s>Anubhūyete</s> (dual). <s>Anubhūyante</s> (plural). <s>Tvamanubhūyase</s>. <s>Ahamanubhūye</s>. <s>Anvabhāvi</s>. <s>Anvabhāviṣātām</s> or <s>anvabhaviṣātām</s>. <s>Ṇi</s>-elision [applies]. <s>Bhāvyate</s> (causative passive). <s>Bhāvayāñcakre</s>, <s>bhāvayāmbabhūve</s>, <s>bhāvayāmāse</s>. <s>CiṆvat</s> [treatment and] <s>iṭ</s> [augment apply]. Because of the <s>asiddha</s> (non-effected) status of the <s>ā</s>-lengthening, <s>ṇi</s>-elision [applies]. <s>Bhāvitā</s> or <s>bhāvayitā</s>. <s>Bhāviṣyate</s> or <s>bhāvayiṣyate</s>. <s>Abhāvyata</s>. <s>Bhāvyeta</s>. <s>Bhāviṣīṣṭa</s> or <s>bhāvayiṣīṣṭa</s>. <s>Abhāvi</s>. <s>Abhāviṣātām</s> or <s>abhāvayiṣātām</s>. <s>Bubhūṣyate</s> (desiderative passive). '[Before] non-<s>kṛt</s> and non-<s>sārvadhātuka</s>' — lengthening [applies]. <s>Stūyate viṣṇuḥ</s> (<s>Viṣṇu</s> is praised). <s>Stāvitā</s> or <s>stotā</s>. <s>Stāviṣyate</s> or <s>stoṣyate</s>. <s>Astāvi</s>. <s>Astāviṣātām</s> or <s>astoṣātām</s>.
For <s>tanoti</s> (fifth-class root <s>tan</s>), before <s>yak</s>. (VLk 758 = P 6.4.44)
<s>Ā</s> is optionally the final substitute. <s>Tāyate</s> or <s>tanyate</s>.
For <s>tap</s> (to heat), <s>ciṇ</s> does not [apply] in the <s>karma-kartṛ</s> (medio-passive) and in [the sense of] remorse. (VLk 759 = P 3.1.65)

body.text: tapaścleściṇ na syāt karmakartaryanutāpe ca / anvatapta pāpena / ghumāsthetīttvam / dīyate / dhīyate / dade //
body.translated_text: For <s>tap</s>, <s>ciṇ</s> does not replace <s>cli</s> in the <s>karma-kartṛ</s> and in [the sense of] remorse. <s>Anvatapta pāpena</s> (he was tormented by sin). By '<s>ghumāsthā</s>' etc., the <s>it</s>-substitution [applies]. <s>Dīyate</s> (is given). <s>Dhīyate</s> (is placed). <s>Dade</s> (perfect passive).
After [a root ending in] <s>ā</s>, the <s>yuk</s> augment [is inserted] before <s>ciṇ</s> and a <s>ñṇit kṛt</s> suffix. (VLk 760 = P 7.3.33)

body.text: ādantānāṃ yugāgamaḥ syācciṇi ñṇiti kṛti ca / dāyitā, dātā / dāyiṣīṣṭa, dāsīṣṭa / adāyi / adāyiṣātām // bhajyate //
body.translated_text: For <s>ā</s>-final [roots], the <s>yuk</s> augment is [inserted] before <s>ciṇ</s> and before a <s>ñṇit kṛt</s> suffix. <s>Dāyitā</s> or <s>dātā</s>. <s>Dāyiṣīṣṭa</s> or <s>dāsīṣṭa</s>. <s>Adāyi</s> (aorist passive). <s>Adāyiṣātām</s>. <s>Bhajyate</s> (passive of <s>bhañj</s>, to break).
For <s>bhañj</s> (to break), before <s>ciṇ</s>. (VLk 761 = P 6.4.33)

body.text: nalopo vā syāt / abhāji, abhañji // labhyate //
body.translated_text: The elision of <s>n</s> is optional. <s>Abhāji</s> or <s>abhañji</s>. <s>Labhyate</s> (passive of <s>labh</s>, to obtain).
Optionally, for <s>ciṇ</s> and <s>ṇamul</s>. (VLk 762 = P 7.1.69)
For <s>labh</s>, the <s>num</s> augment is optional. <s>Alambhi</s> or <s>alābhi</s>.
Thus [ends] the procedure for <s>bhāva</s> (impersonal passive).
Now the procedure for <s>karma-kartṛ</s> (object-as-agent, medio-passive).

body.text: yadā karmaiva kartṛtvena vivakṣitaṃ tadā sakarmakāṇāmapyakarmakatvātkartari bhāve ca lakāraḥ //
body.translated_text: When the object itself is expressed as the agent, then even transitive [roots] take the <s>la</s>-suffixes in the active sense and the <s>bhāva</s> sense, because of being [treated as] intransitive.
One whose action is like that of an object endowed with <s>karma</s>. (VLk 763 = P 3.1.87)

body.text: karmasthayā kriyayā tulyakriyaḥ kartā karmavatsyāt / kāryātideśo 'yam / tena yagātmanepadaciṇvadiṭaḥ syuḥ / pacyate phalam / bhidyate kāṣṭham / abhedi / bhāve, bhidyate kāṣṭhena //
body.translated_text: An agent who performs an action identical to the action residing in the object should be treated like the object. / This is an extension of effect (<s>kāryātideśa</s>). / Therefore, yaṅ, ātmanepada, ciṇ, and iṭ [augment rules] would apply. / pacyate phalam ('the fruit cooks [itself]') / bhidyate kāṣṭham ('the wood splits [itself]') / abhedi / In bhāve (impersonal): bhidyate kāṣṭhena //
Thus [ends] the agent-as-object (<s>karmakartṛ</s>) section //
Now, the section on the meanings of the <s>lakāras</s>:
ḷṭ [is used] in the sense of recollection. (P 3.1.112)

children.text: nivāse // smarasi kṛṣṇa gokule vatsyāmaḥ / evaṃ budhyase, cetayase, ityādiprayoge 'pi //
children.translated_text: [is used] in the sense of 'dwelling.' / smarasi kṛṣṇa gokule vatsyāmaḥ ('Do you remember, <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, we will dwell in <s>Gokula</s>?') / Similarly [ḷṭ applies] also with budhyase, cetayase, etc. //

body.translated_text: After a root [used] in the sense of past [action] not of today, when a word meaning 'remembering' or 'knowing' is in proximity, ḷṭ [is used]. / This is an exception to laṅ //
Not with yadi ('if'). (P 3.1.113)

body.text: yadyoge uktaṃ na / abhijānāsi kṛṣṇa yadvane abhuñjmahi //
body.translated_text: In conjunction with yadi, what was stated [about ḷṭ] does not [apply]. / abhijānāsi kṛṣṇa yadvane abhuñjmahi ('Do you know, <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, that we ate in the forest?') //
laṭ [is used] with sma. (P 3.2.118)
This is an exception to liṭ. / yajati sma yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ('<s>Yudhiṣṭhira</s> used to sacrifice.') //
For what is proximate to the present, [the suffixes] may optionally be as for the present. (P 3.3.131)

body.text: vartamāne ye pratyayā uktāste vartamānasāmīpye bhūte bhaviṣyati ca vā syuḥ / kadāgato 'si / ayamāgacchāmi, ayamāgamaṃ vā / kadā gamiṣyasi / eṣa gacchāmi, gamiṣyāmi vā //
body.translated_text: The suffixes prescribed for the present tense may optionally be used for past or future [actions] proximate to the present. / kadāgato 'si ('When did you come?') / ayamāgacchāmi, or ayamāgamaṃ ('Here I come / Here I came.') / kadā gamiṣyasi ('When will you go?') / eṣa gacchāmi, or gamiṣyāmi ('Here I go / I shall go.') //
liṅ [is used when expressing] cause and effect. (P 3.3.156)

) / Not here [does liṅ apply]: / hantīti palāyate ('He runs because [the other] strikes.') // liṅ [is used] in the senses of injunction, invitation, etc.:
prompting, i.e., directing one who is subordinate such as a servant. / yajeta ('One should sacrifice.') //

children.text: niyogakaraṇam, āvaśyake śrāddhabhojanādau dauhitrādeḥ pravartanam / iha bhuñjīta //

permission granted at one's pleasure. / ihāsīta ('One may sit here.') //
— an engagement accompanied by respect. / putramadhyāpayed bhavān ('Your honor should teach the boy.') //

children.translated_text: pondering. / kiṃ bho vedamadhīyīya uta tarkam ('Well then, should I study the <s>Veda</s> or logic?') //

body.translated_text: Optionally. / kṛṣṇaṃ nameccetsukhaṃ yāyāt ('If one bows to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, one would attain happiness.') / kṛṣṇaṃ naṃsyati cetsukhaṃ yāsyati ('If one will bow to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, one will attain happiness.') / (
Thus [ends] the section on the meanings of the <s>lakāras</s> //
Thus the <s>tiṅanta</s> (verb-ending section) is completed //
Now, the <s>kṛt</s> (primary derivative) section — the <s>kṛt</s> procedure:
After a verbal root — (P 3.1.91)

body.text: ātṛtīyādhyāyasamāpterye pratyayāste dhātoḥ pare syuḥ / kṛdatiṅiti kṛtsaṃjñā //
body.translated_text: The suffixes [prescribed] up to the end of the third chapter follow after a verbal root. / [They receive] the designation kṛt by [the rule] 'kṛd-atiṅ' ('that which is not tiṅ is kṛt').
An asarūpa [non-identical] exception optionally [blocks the general rule], except in [the] strī [feminine suffix domain]. (P 3.1.94)

body.text: asmindhātvadhikāre 'sarūpo 'pavādapratyaya utsargasya bādhako vā syāt stryadhikāroktaṃ vinā //
body.translated_text: In this root-domain, a non-identical exception-suffix optionally blocks the general [suffix] — except for what is stated in the strī-adhikāra (feminine suffix section).
<s>kṛtya</s> [suffixes are so called]. (P 3.1.95)
From [the rule] 'ṇvul-tṛc' onward — [the suffixes] before [that rule] receive the designation kṛtya.
<s>kṛt</s> [suffixes are used] in the sense of the agent. (P 3.4.67)
A kṛt suffix should be [used] in the sense of the agent. / When this [rule] would apply —
Of those [kṛtya and kta/khalarthāḥ], only [bhāva and karman are expressed]. (P 3.4.70)
These [kṛtya, kta, and khalarthāḥ suffixes] apply only in bhāva (impersonal) and karman (object) [senses].
<s>tavyat</s>, <s>tavya</s>, and <s>anīyar</s> [are kṛtya suffixes]. (P 3.1.93)

body.text: dhātorete pratyayāḥ syuḥ / edhitavyam, edhanīyaṃ tvayā / bhāve autsargikamekavacanaṃ klībatvaṃ ca / cetavyaścayanīyo vā dharmastvayā (kelimara upasaṃkhyānam) pacelimā māṣāḥ / paktavyā ityarthaḥ / bhidelimāḥ saralāḥ / bhettavyā ityarthaḥ / karmaṇi pratyayaḥ //
body.translated_text: These suffixes follow after a root. / edhitavyam, edhanīyaṃ tvayā ('It is to be prospered by you,' = 'You should prosper.') / In bhāve, the default singular number and neuter gender [apply]. / cetavyaś cayanīyo vā dharmas tvayā ('Dharma is to be heaped up by you.') / (The kelimar class is to be enumerated:) pacelimā māṣāḥ / meaning: paktavyāḥ ('the beans are to be cooked') / bhidelimāḥ saralāḥ / meaning: bhettavyāḥ ('the pine [logs] are to be split') / The suffix is in the karman (object) sense. //
<s>kṛtya</s> and <s>lyuṭ</s> [are used] variously (bahulam). (P 3.3.113)

children.translated_text: Sometimes [there is] application, sometimes non-application, sometimes optionality, sometimes something else entirely.

children.text: vidhervidhānaṃ bahudhā samīkṣya caturvidhaṃ bāhulakaṃ vadanti // 1 //
children.translated_text: Observing the operation of rules to be manifold, they declare <s>bahulam</s> to be of four kinds. // 1 //

body.text: snātyaneneti snānīyaṃ cūrṇam / dīyate 'smai dānīyo vipraḥ //
body.translated_text: snātyanena iti snānīyaṃ cūrṇam ('That powder by which one bathes is snānīya bathing-powder.') / dīyate 'smai dānīyo vipraḥ ('The brahmin to whom [something] is given is dānīya, worthy of giving.') //
yat [follows] after a vowel-ending [root]. (P 3.1.97)
After a vowel-ending root, yat should [be added]. / ceyam ('to be gathered') //
ī [replaces the ā] before yat [by rule]. (P 6.4.65)

body.text: yati pare āta ītsyāt / deyam / gleyam //
body.translated_text: Before yat, ā is replaced by ī. / deyam ('to be given') / gleyam ('to be exhausted') //
[yat follows] after [a root] ending in a pavarga [labial consonant] that does not have [a consonant as] penultimate. (P 3.1.98)
After a root ending in a labial consonant and not having [a consonant as] penultimate, yat should [be added]. / This is an exception to ṇyat. / śapyam ('to be cursed') / labhyam ('to be obtained') //
After [the roots] eti, stu, śās, vṛ, dṛ, and juṣ — kyap [is added]. (P 3.1.109)
After these, kyap should [be added].

body.text: hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk // VLk_780 = P_6,1.71 //
body.translated_text: A short [vowel] takes tuk [augment] before a pit kṛt [suffix]. (P 6.1.71)
ityaḥ ('to be gone to') / stutyaḥ ('to be praised') /
Of śās, i [replaces the penultimate] before aṅ and before hal-initial [suffixes] that are k-it or ṅ-it. (P 6.4.34)

body.text: śāsa upadhāyā itsyādaṅi halādau kṅiti / śiṣyaḥ / vṛtyaḥ / ādṛtyaḥ / juṣyaḥ //
body.translated_text: The penultimate of śās is replaced by i before aṅ and before a consonant-initial [suffix] that is k-it or ṅ-it. / śiṣyaḥ ('to be instructed') / vṛtyaḥ ('to be chosen') / ādṛtyaḥ ('to be respected') / juṣyaḥ ('to be enjoyed') //
Of mṛj, optionally [kyap applies]. (P 3.1.113)
After mṛj, optionally kyap [is added]. / mṛjyaḥ ('to be cleaned') //
ṇyat [follows] after a root ending in ṛ or a hal [consonant]. (P 3.1.124)
After a root ending in ṛ-vowel or a consonant, ṇyat [is added]. / kāryam ('to be done') / hāryam ('to be taken') / dhāryam ('to be held') //
ca and ja [are replaced by] ku before ghi and ṇyat. (P 7.3.52)

body.text: cajoḥ kutvaṃ syāt ghiti ṇyati ca pare //
body.translated_text: ca and ja are replaced by their ku-class [equivalents, i.e., ka and ga] before ghi and ṇyat.
Of mṛj, vṛddhi [occurs]. (P 7.2.114)
The ik [vowel] of mṛj undergoes vṛddhi before sārvadhātuka and ārdhadhātuka [suffixes]. / mārgyaḥ ('to be wiped') //
bhojya [is used] in the sense of 'food.' (P 7.6.69)
bhogya [means something] else [i.e., 'to be enjoyed'].
Thus [ends] the <s>kṛtya</s> (gerundive) section //
Now, the earlier kṛt-anta [section] (pūrvakṛdanta):
ṇvul and tṛc [are prescribed]. (P 3.1.133)
These [two suffixes follow] after a root. / By 'kartari kṛt,' [they are used] in the agent sense.
an and āka [replace] yu and vu [respectively]. (P 7.1.1)

body.text: yu vu etayoranākau staḥ / kārakaḥ / kartā //
body.translated_text: an and āka replace yu and vu. / kārakaḥ ('doer') / kartā ('maker') //
After nandi, grahi, paca, etc. — lyuḥ, ṇiniḥ, and ac [are added respectively]. (P 3.1.134)

body.text: nandyāderlyuḥ, grahyāderṇiniḥ, pacāderac syāt / nandayatīti nandanaḥ / janamardayatīti janārdanaḥ / lavaṇaḥ / grāhī / sthāyī / mantrī / pacādirākṛtigaṇaḥ //
body.translated_text: After the nandi-class, lyuḥ; after the grahi-class, ṇiniḥ; after the paca-class, ac should [be added]. / nandayatīti nandanaḥ ('one who delights = <s>Nandana</s>') / janamardayatīti janārdanaḥ ('one who harasses people = <s>Janārdana</s>') / lavaṇaḥ ('cutter') / grāhī ('seizer') / sthāyī ('one who stays') / mantrī ('counselor') / The paca-class is an open-ended class (ākṛtigaṇa). //
After [a root with] an ik penultimate, and after jñā, prī, and kir — ka [is added]. (P 3.1.135)

priyaṃvadaḥ ('one who speaks pleasantly') / vaśaṃvadaḥ ('one who speaks obediently, i.e., one who is subservient') //

body.text: svakarmake manane varttamānānmanyateḥ supi khaś syāt cāṇṇiniḥ / paṇḍitamātmānaṃ manyate paṇḍitaṃmanyaḥ / paṇḍitamānī //

body.text: khidante pare pūrvapadasya hrasvaḥ / tato mum / kālimmanyā //

body.text: karaṇe upapade bhūtārthe yajerṇiniḥ kartari / someneṣṭavān somayājī / agniṣṭomayājī //

In a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> [compound with] a kṛt [suffix], variously — (P 6.3.14)

<s>prajā</s> ('offspring') should [be so derived] in the sense of progeny //

niṣṭhā [follows after a root]. (P 3.2.102)

body.text: bhūtārthavṛtterdhātorniṣṭhā syāt / tatra tayoreveti bhāvakarmaṇoḥ ktaḥ / kartari kṛditi kartari ktavatuḥ / ukāvitau / snātaṃ mayā / stutastvayā viṣṇuḥ / viśvaṃ kṛtavān viṣṇuḥ //
body.translated_text: After a root functioning in the sense of the past, niṣṭhā should [be added]. / Among them, by [the rule] 'tayoreva,' kta [is used] in bhāva (impersonal) and karman (object) [senses]. / By 'kartari kṛt,' ktavatu [is used] in the agent sense. / u and kā are it-markers. / snātaṃ mayā ('It was bathed by me.') / stutastvayā viṣṇuḥ ('<s>Viṣṇu</s> was praised by you.') / viśvaṃ kṛtavān viṣṇuḥ ('<s>Viṣṇu</s> created the universe.') //

[They belong to the] <s>śa</s>-class etc. [Example:] <s>pacantaṃ caitraṃ paśya</s> (Look at <s>Caitra</s> who is cooking [accusative]).

body.text: adantāṅgasya mugāgamaḥ syādāne pare / pacamānaṃ caitraṃ paśya / laḍityanuvartamāne punarlaḍgrahaṇāt prathamāsāmānādhikaraṇye 'pi kvacit / san dvijaḥ //
body.translated_text: Before <s>āna</s> [i.e. <s>śānac</s>], an <s>a</s>-ending stem takes the augment <s>muk</s>. [Example:] <s>pacamānaṃ caitraṃ paśya</s> (Look at <s>Caitra</s> who is cooking [middle voice, accusative]). Since '<s>laṭ</s>' continues [in the rule], by the repeated mention of '<s>laṭ</s>', [these participles apply] sometimes also when in co-reference with the nominative. [Example:] <s>san dvijaḥ</s> (a Brāhmaṇa who exists [i.e. is real]).
[Sūtra:] '<s>videḥ śatur vasuḥ</s>' (VLk 836 = P 7.1.36)

body.text: vyavasthitavibhāṣeyam / tenāprathamāsāmānādhikaraṇye pratyottarapadayoḥ saṃbodhane lakṣaṇahetvośca nityam / kariṣyantaṃ kariṣyamāṇaṃ paśya //
body.translated_text: This is a conditioned option (<s>vyavasthita-vibhāṣā</s>). [Future participle example:] <s>kariṣyantaṃ kariṣyamāṇaṃ paśya</s> (Look at him who will do [active/middle]).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ā-kveś tac-chīla-tad-dharma-tat-sādhukāriṣu</s>' (VLk 839 = P 3.2.134)
Including <s>kvip</s>, the affixes to be stated [hereafter] should be understood [as applying] in the sense of agents characterized by habitual action, nature, or skill.
[Example:] <s>kartā kaṭān</s> (one who habitually makes mats).

body.text: pratyayasyādiḥ ṣa itsaṃjñaḥ syāt / jalpākaḥ / bhikṣākaḥ / kuṭṭākaḥ / luṇṭākaḥ / varākaḥ / varākī //
body.translated_text: The initial <s>ṣ</s> of an affix is <s>it</s> (indicatory). [Examples:] <s>jalpākaḥ</s> (a chatterer). <s>bhikṣākaḥ</s> (a habitual beggar). <s>kuṭṭākaḥ</s> (one who habitually crushes). <s>luṇṭākaḥ</s> (a habitual robber). <s>varākaḥ</s> (a wretched one). <s>varākī</s> (feminine).

[Examples:] <s>cikīrṣuḥ</s> (one who wishes to do). <s>āśaṃsuḥ</s> (one who hopes). <s>bhikṣuḥ</s> (a mendicant).
[Sūtra:] '<s>bhrāja-bhāsa-dhur-vidyut-ūrji-pṝ-ju-grāva-stuvaḥ kvip</s>' (VLk 844 = P 3.2.177)
[Examples:] <s>vibhrāṭ</s> (the shining one). <s>bhāḥ</s> (light).

body.text: rephācchvorlopaḥ kvau jhalādau kṅiti / dhūḥ / vidyut / ūrka / pūḥ / dṛśigrahaṇasyāpakarṣājjavaterdīrghaḥ / jūḥ / grāvastut / (
body.translated_text: After a <s>repha</s> [or before] <s>ch</s> and <s>v</s>, there is deletion before <s>kvi</s> when a <s>jhal</s>-initial <s>kṅit</s> [ending follows]. [Examples:] <s>dhūḥ</s> (shaker). <s>vidyut</s> (lightning). <s>ūrk</s> (strength). <s>pūḥ</s> (purifier). Since the mention of <s>dṛś</s> is to be extended [further], the vowel of <s>jav</s> is lengthened. <s>jūḥ</s> (speedy one). <s>grāvastut</s> (praiser of pressing stones).

body.text: satukkasya chasya vasya ca krāmāt ś ūṭh ityādeśau sto 'nunāsike kvau jhalādau ca kṅiti / pṛcchatīti prāṭ / āyataṃ stautīti āyatastūḥ / kaṭaṃ pravate kaṭaprūḥ / jūruktaḥ / śrayati hariṃ śrīḥ //
body.translated_text: Before a <s>kvi</s> [suffix] that is <s>jhal</s>-initial and <s>kṅit</s>, and before a nasal — of the <s>s</s> with <s>tuk</s> (i.e. <s>cch</s>), and of <s>v</s> — [the substitutes] <s>ś</s> and <s>ūṭh</s> respectively apply [as stated by <s>krāmāt</s>]. [Examples:] <s>pṛcchati</s> (he asks) → <s>prāṭ</s> (an asker). <s>āyataṃ stauti</s> (he praises at length) → <s>āyatastūḥ</s>. <s>kaṭaṃ pravate</s> → <s>kaṭaprūḥ</s>. <s>jūr uktaḥ</s>. <s>śrayati hariṃ</s> → <s>śrīḥ</s> (beauty/prosperity).
[Sūtra:] '<s>dām-nī-śa-sa-yu-yuja-stu-da-si-sica-miha-pata-daśa-nahaḥ karaṇe</s>' (VLk 847 = P 3.2.182)
