body.text: eṣāṃ daśānāṃ kṛtpratyayānāmiṇ na/ śastram / yotram / yoktram / stotram / tottram / setram / sektram / meḍhram / patram / daṃṣṭrā / naddhrī //
body.translated_text: Before these ten <s>kṛt</s> suffixes, <s>iṭ</s> is not [inserted]. [Examples:] <s>śastram</s> (weapon). <s>yotram</s> (strap). <s>yoktram</s> (tie). <s>stotram</s> (hymn of praise). <s>tottram</s> (goad). <s>setram</s>. <s>sektram</s>. <s>meḍhram</s> (penis). <s>patram</s> (leaf/vessel). <s>daṃṣṭrā</s> (fang). <s>naddhrī</s> (strap).
[Sūtra:] '<s>arti-lū-dhū-sū-khana-saha-cara itraḥ</s>' (VLk 849 = P 6.2.184)

body.text: aritram / lavitram / dhuvitram / savitram / khanitram / sahitram / caritram //
body.translated_text: [Examples:] <s>aritram</s> (oar). <s>lavitram</s> (sickle). <s>dhuvitram</s> (fan). <s>savitram</s> (instrument of pressing). <s>khanitram</s> (spade). <s>sahitram</s>. <s>caritram</s> (conduct/biography).
Thus [ends] the <s>pūrva-kṛdanta</s> (prior nominal-derivative section).
Now [begin] the <s>uṇādi</s> [suffixes].
[Sūtra:] '<s>kṛ-vā-pā-ji-mi-svadi-sādhya-śūbhya uṇ</s>' (Uṇ 1)

body.text: karotīti kāruḥ / vātīti vāyuḥ / pāyurgudam / jāyurauṣadham / māyuḥ pittam / svāduḥ / sādhnoti parakāryamiti sādhuḥ / āśu śīghram //
body.translated_text: [Examples:] <s>karoti</s> (he does) → <s>kāruḥ</s> (artisan). <s>vāti</s> (it blows) → <s>vāyuḥ</s> (wind). <s>pāyuḥ</s> means the anus. <s>jāyuḥ</s> means medicine. <s>māyuḥ</s> means bile. <s>svāduḥ</s> (sweet). <s>sādhnoti parakāryam</s> (accomplishes others' tasks) → <s>sādhuḥ</s> (a good/virtuous person). <s>āśu</s> means quick.
[Sūtra:] '<s>uṇādayo bahulam</s>' (VLk 851 = P 3.3.1)

body.text: ete vartamāne saṃjñāyām ca bahulaṃ syuḥ / kecidavihitā apyūhyāḥ //
body.translated_text: These [<s>uṇādi</s> suffixes] apply variously (<s>bahulam</s>) in the present tense and in proper names. Some [forms], though not explicitly prescribed, are to be inferred.

children.translated_text: In proper names, the root forms and the affixes following them
are to be understood from context — without the indicatory markers (<s>anubandha</s>) — this is the teaching regarding <s>uṇādi</s> [suffixes].

body.translated_text: Thus [end] the <s>uṇādi</s> [suffixes].
Now [begins] the <s>uttara-kṛdanta</s> (latter nominal-derivative section).
[Sūtra:] '<s>tumun-ṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām</s>' (VLk 852 = P 3.3.10)

body.text: kriyārthāyāṃ kriyāyāmupapade bhaviṣyatyarthe dhātoretau staḥ / māntatvādavyayatvam / kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ yāti / kṛṣṇaṃ darśako yāti //
body.translated_text: When the purpose-denoting action is a subordinate clause, and in the sense of the future — these two [suffixes <s>tumun</s> and <s>ṇvul</s>] are added after the root. Being final in the word, [<s>tumun</s> makes the word] indeclinable (<s>avyaya</s>). [Examples:] <s>kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ yāti</s> (he goes to see <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>). <s>kṛṣṇaṃ darśako yāti</s> (the one who [habitually] sees <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> goes).
[Sūtra:] '<s>kāla-samaya-velāsu tumun</s>' (VLk 853 = P 3.3.167)

body.text: kālārtheṣūpapadeṣu tumun / kālaḥ samayo velā vā bhoktum //
body.translated_text: When words meaning 'time' are in co-construction, <s>tumun</s> [is used]. [Example:] <s>kālaḥ samayo velā vā bhoktum</s> (It is the time/occasion/hour to eat).
[Sūtra:] '<s>bhāve</s>' (VLk 854 = P 3.3.18)
When the meaning of the root refers to the accomplished state of the action — <s>ghañ</s> is added after the root. [Example:] <s>pākaḥ</s> (cooking [the act]).

body.text: akartari ca kārake saṃjñāyām // VLk_855 = P_3,3.19 //
body.translated_text: [Sūtra:] '<s>akartari ca kārake saṃjñāyām</s>' (VLk 855 = P 3.3.19)
<s>Ghañ</s> is [also] added when [denoting] a <s>kāraka</s> (semantic role) other than the agent.
[Sūtra:] '<s>ghañi ca bhāva-karaṇayoḥ</s>' (VLk 856 = P 6.4.27)

body.text: rañjernalopaḥ syāt / rāgaḥ / anayoḥ kim? rajyatyasminniti raṅgaḥ //
body.translated_text: Before <s>ghañ</s>, <s>n</s> of <s>rañj</s> (to color) is deleted [in the senses of action and instrument]. [Example:] <s>rāgaḥ</s> (color/passion). Why [only] in these two? [Because:] <s>rajyati asmin</s> (one is colored in it) → <s>raṅgaḥ</s> (dye/theater [locative sense]).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ni-vāsa-citi-śarīra-upasamādhāneṣv ādeś ca kaḥ</s>' (VLk 857 = P 3.3.41)

body.text: eṣu cinoterghañ ādeśca kakāraḥ / upasamādhānaṃ rāśīkaraṇam / nikāyaḥ / kāyaḥ/ gomayanikāyaḥ //
body.translated_text: In the senses of dwelling, heaping, body, and gathering — after <s>ci</s> (to gather), <s>ghañ</s> [is added] and <s>ā</s> replaces [the root vowel] along with <s>ka</s>. <s>Upasamādhāna</s> means piling up. [Examples:] <s>nikāyaḥ</s> (group/collection). <s>kāyaḥ</s> (body). <s>gomayanikāyaḥ</s> (a heap of cow dung).
[Sūtra:] '<s>erac</s>' (VLk 858 = P 3.3.46)
After a stem ending in <s>i</s>-vowel — <s>ac</s> [is the suffix]. [Examples:] <s>cayaḥ</s> (gathering). <s>jayaḥ</s> (victory).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṝdor ap</s>' (VLk 859 = P 3.3.57)

body.text: ṝvarṇāntāduvarṇāntāccāp / karaḥ / garaḥ / yavaḥ / lavaḥ / stavaḥ / pavaḥ / (

children.translated_text: (<s>Vārttika</s>:) 'In the sense of <s>ghañ</s>, the prescription of <s>ka</s> [applies].'

body.translated_text: After a stem ending in <s>ṝ</s>-vowel or <s>u</s>-vowel — <s>ap</s> [is the suffix]. [Examples:] <s>karaḥ</s> (hand/doing). <s>garaḥ</s> (poison). <s>yavaḥ</s> (barley). <s>lavaḥ</s> (cutting). <s>stavaḥ</s> (praise). <s>pavaḥ</s> (wind/purification).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ḍvitaḥ ktriḥ</s>' (VLk 860 = P 3.3.88)
[Sūtra:] '<s>ktrer mam nityam</s>' (VLk 861 = P 4.4.20)

body.text: ktripratyayāntātmap nirvṛtter'the / pākena nirvṛttaṃ paktrimam / ḍuvap uptrimam //
body.translated_text: After a word ending in the suffix <s>ktri</s>, <s>map</s> [suffix] is invariably [added] in the sense of 'produced by.' [Examples:] <s>pākena nirvṛttaṃ paktrimam</s> (that which is produced by cooking — artificial). <s>ḍuvap</s> → <s>uptrimam</s> (that which is produced by sowing).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṭvito 'thuc</s>' (VLk 862 = P 3.3.89)
[Sūtra:] '<s>yaja-yāca-yata-viccha-praccha-rakṣo naṅ</s>' (VLk 863 = P 3.3.90)

body.text: yajñaḥ / yācñā / yatnaḥ / viśnaḥ / praśnaḥ / rakṣṇaḥ //
body.translated_text: [Examples:] <s>yajñaḥ</s> (sacrifice). <s>yācñā</s> (begging). <s>yatnaḥ</s> (effort). <s>viśnaḥ</s> (food). <s>praśnaḥ</s> (question). <s>rakṣṇaḥ</s> (protection).
[Sūtra:] '<s>svapo nan</s>' (VLk 864 = P 3.3.91)
[Example:] <s>svapnaḥ</s> (sleep/dream).
[Sūtra:] '<s>upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ</s>' (VLk 865 = P 3.3.92)
[Examples:] <s>pradhiḥ</s> (rim of a wheel). <s>upadhiḥ</s> (fraud/trick).
[Sūtra:] '<s>striyāṃ ktin</s>' (VLk 866 = P 3.3.94)

body.text: strīliṅge bhāve ktin syāt / ghaño 'pavādaḥ / kṛtiḥ / stutiḥ / (

children.translated_text: (<s>Vārttika</s>:) 'After <s>ṝ</s>, <s>lū</s>, etc., <s>ktin</s> should be stated as being like the past participle (<s>niṣṭhāvat</s>).'

children.text: ḥ) / tena natvam / kīrṇiḥ / lūniḥ / dhūniḥ / pūniḥ / (

body.translated_text: In the feminine gender, in the sense of the action, <s>ktin</s> is [added]. This is an exception to <s>ghañ</s>. [Examples:] <s>kṛtiḥ</s> (making/creation). <s>stutiḥ</s> (praise).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ūti-yūti-jūti-sāti-heti-kīrtayaś ca</s>' (VLk 867 = P 3.3.97)
These are listed as irregular formations (<s>nipātana</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>jvara-tvara-srivu-avi-mava-mu upadhāyāś ca</s>' (VLk 868 = P 6.4.20)

body.text: eṣāmupadhāvakārayorūṭh anunāsike kvau jhalādau kṅiti // ataḥ kvip / jūḥ / tūḥ / srūḥ / ūḥ / mūḥ //
body.translated_text: For these [roots], the penultimate vowel and <s>a</s>-vowel are [replaced by] <s>ūṭh</s> before a nasal, before <s>kvi</s>, before <s>jhal</s>-initial [affixes], and before <s>kṅit</s> [suffixes]. Hence — <s>kvip</s> [suffix produces:] <s>jūḥ</s> (speed). <s>tūḥ</s> (haste). <s>srūḥ</s> (flow). <s>ūḥ</s> (weaving). <s>mūḥ</s> (binding).
[Sūtra:] '<s>icchā</s>' (VLk 869 = P 3.3.101)
This is an irregular formation (<s>nipāta</s>) of [the root] <s>iṣ</s> (to wish). [Result:] <s>icchā</s> (desire).
[Sūtra:] '<s>a pratyayāt</s>' (VLk 870 = P 3.3.102)

body.text: pratyayāntebhyo dhātubhyaḥ striyāmakāraḥ pratyayaḥ syāt / cikīrṣā / putrakāmyā //
body.translated_text: After derivative roots [ending in affixes], in the feminine — the suffix <s>a</s> is added. [Examples:] <s>cikīrṣā</s> (desire to do). <s>putrakāmyā</s> (desire for a son).
[Sūtra:] '<s>guroś ca halaḥ</s>' (VLk 871 = P 3.3.103)
After a heavy consonant-ending [root], in the feminine — the suffix <s>a</s> is added. [Example:] <s>īhā</s> (effort/desire).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṇy-āsa-śrantho yuc</s>' (VLk 872 = P 3.3.107)
This is an exception to [the suffix] <s>a</s>. [Examples:] <s>kāraṇā</s> (a causing). <s>hāraṇā</s> (a taking away).
[Sūtra:] '<s>napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ</s>' (VLk 873 = P 3.3.11)
[Sūtra:] '<s>lyuṭ ca</s>' (VLk 874 = P 3.3.115)
[Examples:] <s>hasitam</s> (laughter [neuter <s>kta</s>]), <s>hasanam</s> (laughter [<s>lyuṭ</s>]).

body.text: puṃsi saṃjñāyāṃ ghaḥ prāyeṇa // VLk_875 = P_3,3.188 //
body.translated_text: [Sūtra:] '<s>puṃsi saṃjñāyāṃ ghaḥ prāyeṇa</s>' (VLk 875 = P 3.3.188)
[Sūtra:] '<s>chāder ghe 'dvy-upasargasya</s>' (VLk 876 = P 6.4.96)

body.text: dviprabhṛtyupasargahīnasya chāderhrasvo ghe pare / dantāśchādyante 'neneti dantacchadaḥ / ākurvantyasminnityākaraḥ //
body.translated_text: A [root] <s>chad</s> etc. that lacks two prefixes — its [vowel] becomes short before <s>gha</s>. [Examples:] <s>dantāś chādyante anena</s> (the teeth are covered by it) → <s>dantacchadaḥ</s> (lip [lit. tooth-covering]). <s>ākurvanty asmin</s> (they bring together in it) → <s>ākaraḥ</s> (mine).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ave tṝstror ghañ</s>' (VLk 877 = P 3.3.120)
[Examples:] <s>avatāraḥ</s> (descent) from a well etc. <s>avastāraḥ</s> means a curtain.
[Sūtra:] '<s>halaś ca</s>' (VLk 878 = P 3.3.121)

body.text: halantādghañ / ghāpavādaḥ / ramante yogino 'sminniti rāmaḥ / apamṛjyate 'nena vyādhyādirityapāmārgaḥ //
body.translated_text: After a consonant-ending [root], <s>ghañ</s> [is added]. This is an exception to <s>gha</s>. [Examples:] <s>ramante yogino 'smin</s> (yogins delight in him) → <s>rāmaḥ</s> (<s>Rāma</s>). <s>apamṛjyate anena vyādhyādiḥ</s> (disease etc. is wiped away by it) → <s>apāmārgaḥ</s> (the plant <s>Apāmārga</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>īṣad-dus-suṣu kṛcchrākṛcchrārtheṣu khal</s>' (VLk 879 = P 3.3.126)

body.text: karaṇādhikaraṇayoriti nivṛttam / eṣu duḥkhasukhārtheṣūpapadeṣu khal tayoreveti bhāve karmaṇi ca / kṛcchre - duṣkaraḥ kaṭo bhavatā / akṛcchre - īṣatkaraḥ / sukaraḥ //
body.translated_text: [The sūtra] '<s>karaṇādhikaraṇayoḥ</s>' has ceased [to be in force]. In these senses of difficulty and ease, when the upapadas <s>īṣat</s>, <s>dus</s>, or <s>su</s> are present — <s>khal</s> [is added], with [the restriction] '<s>tayoḥ eva</s>' [meaning it applies] in the senses of action and object. [Examples of difficulty:] <s>duṣkaraḥ kaṭo bhavatā</s> (a mat is difficult to make by you). [Of ease:] <s>īṣatkaraḥ</s> (easy to do). <s>sukaraḥ</s> (easy to do).
[Sūtra:] '<s>āto yuc</s>' (VLk 880 = P 3.3.128)

body.text: khalo 'pavādaḥ / īṣatpānaḥ somo bhavatā / duṣpānaḥ / supānaḥ //
body.translated_text: This is an exception to <s>khal</s>. [Examples:] <s>īṣatpānaḥ somo bhavatā</s> (Soma is slightly drunk by you). <s>duṣpānaḥ</s> (difficult to drink). <s>supānaḥ</s> (easy to drink).

body.text: alaṃkhalvoḥ pratiṣedhayoḥ prācāṃ ktvā // VLk_881 = P_3,4.18 //
body.translated_text: [Sūtra:] '<s>alaṃ-khalvoḥ pratiṣedhayoḥ prācāṃ ktvā</s>' (VLk 881 = P 3.4.18)

body.text: pratiṣedhārtheyoralaṃkhalvorupapadayoḥ ktvā syāt / prācāṃ grahaṇaṃ pūjārtham / amaivāvyayeneti niyamānnopapadasamāsaḥ / do dadghoḥ / alaṃ dattvā / ghumāsthetīttvam / pītvā khalu / alaṃkhalvoḥ kim? mā kārṣīt / pratiṣedhayoḥ kim? alaṃkāraḥ //
body.translated_text: When the [upapadas] <s>alam</s> and <s>khalu</s> are used in the sense of prohibition — <s>ktvā</s> [suffix is added]. The mention of '<s>prācām</s>' (of the eastern [grammarians]) is for the purpose of honoring [their view]. The restriction '<s>amaivāvyayena</s>' does not [produce] an upapada-compound [here]. [By the rule] '<s>do dadghoḥ</s>' — [Example:] <s>alaṃ dattvā</s> (enough of giving). By '<s>ghumāstheti</s>' — <s>ttva</s> [i.e. doubling applies]. <s>pītvā khalu</s> (indeed, having drunk [= stop drinking]). Why '<s>alaṃ-khalvoḥ</s>'? [Counter-example:] <s>mā kārṣīt</s> (don't do [here <s>luṅ</s> is used, not <s>ktvā</s>]). Why 'in the sense of prohibition'? [Counter-example:] <s>alaṃkāraḥ</s> (ornament [here <s>alam</s> means 'completely,' not prohibition]).
[Sūtra:] '<s>samāna-kartṛkayoḥ pūrvakāle</s>' (VLk 882 = P 3.4.21)

body.text: samānakartṛkayordhātvarthayoḥ pūrvakāle vidyamānāddhātoḥ ktvā syāt / bhuktvā vrajati / dvitvamatantram / bhuktvā pītvā vrajati //
body.translated_text: When two actions share the same agent and [one occurs] at a prior time — <s>ktvā</s> is added after the root [denoting the prior action]. [Example:] <s>bhuktvā vrajati</s> (having eaten, he goes). Doubling [of <s>ktvā</s>-forms] is not limited. <s>bhuktvā pītvā vrajati</s> (having eaten and drunk, he goes).
[Sūtra:] '<s>na ktvā seṭ</s>' (VLk 883 = P 1.2.18)

body.text: seṭ ktvā kinna syāt / śayitvā / seṭ kim ? kṛtvā //
body.translated_text: <s>Ktvā</s> with <s>iṭ</s> (augment vowel) is not [treated as] <s>kit</s>. [Example:] <s>śayitvā</s> (having lain down). Why '<s>seṭ</s>'? [Counter-example:] <s>kṛtvā</s> (having done [no <s>iṭ</s>, so it is <s>kit</s>]).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ralo vy-upadhād dhalādeḥ saṃś ca</s>' (VLk 884 = P 2.2.26)

body.text: ivarṇovarṇopadhāddhalādeḥ ralantātparau ktvāsanau seṭau vā kitau staḥ / dyutitvā, dyotitvā / likhitvā, lekhitvā / vyupadhātkim ? vartitvā / ralaḥ kim ? eṣitvā / seṭ kim ? bhuktvā //
body.translated_text: After a <s>ral</s>-ending [root] with <s>i</s>-vowel or <s>u</s>-vowel as penultimate, and beginning with a consonant — the <s>ktvā</s> and <s>san</s> [suffixes] with <s>iṭ</s> are optionally <s>kit</s>. [Examples:] <s>dyutitvā</s>, <s>dyotitvā</s> (having shone). <s>likhitvā</s>, <s>lekhitvā</s> (having written). Why 'with <s>i/u</s>-penultimate'? [Counter-example:] <s>vartitvā</s>. Why '<s>ral</s>'? [Counter-example:] <s>eṣitvā</s>. Why '<s>seṭ</s>'? [Counter-example:] <s>bhuktvā</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>udito vā</s>' (VLk 885 = P 7.2.56)

body.text: uditaḥ parasya ktava iḍvā / śamitvā, śāntvā / devitvā, dyūtvā / dadhāterhiḥ / hitvā //
body.translated_text: After a root marked with <s>u</s>, the <s>iṭ</s> of <s>ktavat</s> is optional. [Examples:] <s>śamitvā</s>, <s>śāntvā</s> (having become calm). <s>devitvā</s>, <s>dyūtvā</s> (having played). [For the root] <s>dhā</s> — <s>hi</s> [suffix applies]. <s>hitvā</s> (having abandoned).
[Sūtra:] '<s>jahāteś ca ktvi</s>' (VLk 886 = P 7.4.43)
[Form:] <s>hitvā</s> (having abandoned). But for <s>hāṅ</s> [the root <s>hā</s> with <s>ā</s>-marker] — <s>hātvā</s> (having abandoned [alternative form]).
[Sūtra:] '<s>samāse 'nañ-pūrve ktvo lyap</s>' (VLk 887 = P 7.1.37)

body.text: avyayapūrvapade 'nañsamāse ktvo lyabādeśaḥ syāt / tuk / prakṛtya / anañ kim ? akṛtvā //
body.translated_text: In a compound with an indeclinable as prior member (except <s>nañ</s> = negation), <s>ktvā</s> is replaced by <s>lyap</s>. [With] <s>tuk</s> [augment —] [Example:] <s>prakṛtya</s> (having done beforehand). Why 'not <s>nañ</s>'? [Counter-example:] <s>akṛtvā</s> (without having done).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul ca</s>' (VLk 888 = P 3.4.22)

body.text: ābhīkṣṇye dyotye pūrvaviṣaye ṇamul syāt ktvā ca //
body.translated_text: In the sense of repetition (<s>ābhīkṣṇya</s>) — when this [sense] is being expressed — both <s>ṇamul</s> and <s>ktvā</s> apply, as per the previous domain.
[Sūtra:] '<s>nitya-vīpsayoḥ</s>' (VLk 889 = P 8.1.4)

body.text: ābhīkṣṇye vīpsāyāṃ ca dyotye padasya dvitvaṃ syāt / ābhīkṣṇyaṃ tiṅanteṣvavyayasaṃjñakeṣu ca kṛdanteṣu ca / smāraṃsmāraṃ namati śivam / smṛtvāsmṛtvā / pāyampāyam / bhojambhojam / śrāvaṃśrāvam //
body.translated_text: In the sense of repetition and distribution (<s>vīpsā</s>) — when these are being expressed — doubling of the word (<s>pada</s>) occurs. <s>Ābhīkṣṇya</s> [applies] in finite verbs, in indeclinables, and in <s>kṛt</s>-derivatives. [Examples:] <s>smāraṃ smāraṃ namati śivam</s> (remembering again and again, he bows to <s>Śiva</s>). <s>smṛtvā smṛtvā</s> (having remembered again and again). <s>pāyam pāyam</s> (drinking again and again). <s>bhojam bhojam</s> (eating again and again). <s>śrāvaṃ śrāvam</s> (hearing again and again).
[Sūtra:] '<s>anyathā-evaṃ-katham-itthaṃsu siddhā-prayogaś cet</s>' (VLk 890 = P 3.4.27)

body.text: eṣu kṛño ṇamul syāt / siddho 'prayogo 'sya evambhūtaścet kṛñ / vyarthatvātprayogānarha ityarthaḥ / anyathākāram / evaṅkāram / kathaṅkāram / itthaṅkāraṃ bhuṅkte / siddheti kim ? śiro 'nyathā kṛtvā bhuṅkte //
body.translated_text: In the presence of these [words] — <s>ṇamul</s> is added after <s>kṛ</s> (to do). [The condition is:] the accomplished thing is non-functional (<s>aprayoga</s>) — i.e. worthless, useless — that is the meaning. [Examples:] <s>anyathākāram</s> (acting otherwise). <s>evaṅkāram</s> (acting thus). <s>kathaṅkāram</s> (acting how?). <s>itthaṅkāraṃ bhuṅkte</s> (he eats having acted in this way). Why '<s>siddha</s>'? [Counter-example:] <s>śiro 'nyathā kṛtvā bhuṅkte</s> (he eats having turned his head differently [here <s>ktvā</s> is used because the action is purposeful]).
Thus [ends] the <s>uttara-kṛdanta</s> (latter nominal-derivative section).
Thus [ends] the <s>kṛdanta</s> (verbal-derivative section).
Now [begin] the meanings of case-endings (<s>vibhaktyartha</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>prātipadikārtha-liṅga-parimāṇa-vacana-mātre prathamā</s>' (VLk 891 = P 2.3.46)

body.text: niyatopasthitikaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ / mātraśabdasya pratyekaṃ yogaḥ / prātipadikārthamātre liṅgamātrādyādhikye parimāṇamātre saṃkhyāmātre ca prathamā syāt / prātipadikārthamātre - uccaiḥ / nīcaiḥ / kṛṣṇaḥ / śrīḥ / jñānam / liṅgamātre - taṭaḥ, taṭī, taṭam / parimāṇamātre - droṇo vrīhiḥ / vacanaṃ saṃkhyā / ekaḥ, dvau, bahavaḥ //
body.translated_text: The meaning of a <s>prātipadika</s> (nominal stem) has a fixed denotation. The word <s>mātra</s> (mere/only) is connected with each [item] separately. The <s>prathamā</s> (nominative) case is used in the mere meaning of the <s>prātipadika</s>, in mere gender (indicating additional gender forms), in mere measure, and in mere number. In mere <s>prātipadika</s>-meaning — <s>uccaiḥ</s> (loudly). <s>nīcaiḥ</s> (lowly). <s>kṛṣṇaḥ</s> (dark/Kṛṣṇa). <s>śrīḥ</s> (prosperity). <s>jñānam</s> (knowledge). In mere gender — <s>taṭaḥ</s> (masc.), <s>taṭī</s> (fem.), <s>taṭam</s> (neut.) [all meaning 'bank']. In mere measure — <s>droṇo vrīhiḥ</s> (a <s>droṇa</s>-measure of rice). Number is <s>saṃkhyā</s> — <s>ekaḥ</s> (one), <s>dvau</s> (two), <s>bahavaḥ</s> (many).
[Sūtra:] '<s>sambodhane ca</s>' (VLk 892 = P 2.3.47)

body.text:
prathamā syāt / he rāma /
  iti prathamā /
body.translated_text: The <s>prathamā</s> (nominative) is used [in address]. [Example:] <s>he rāma</s> (O <s>Rāma</s>!). Thus [ends] the <s>prathamā</s> (nominative).
[Sūtra:] '<s>kartur īpsitatamam karma</s>' (VLk 893 = P 1.4.49)

body.text: kartuḥ kriyayā āptumiṣṭatamaṃ kārakaṃ karmasaṃjñaṃ syāt //
body.translated_text: That <s>kāraka</s> (participant) which the agent most desires to attain through the action receives the designation <s>karma</s> (object).
[Sūtra:] '<s>karmaṇi dvitīyā</s>' (VLk 894 = P 2.3.2)

body.text: anukte karmaṇi dvitīyā syāt / hariṃ bhajati / abhihite tu karmādau prathamā - hariḥ sevyate / lakṣmyā sevitaḥ //
body.translated_text: The <s>dvitīyā</s> (accusative) is used with the object when it is not expressed [by another means]. [Example:] <s>hariṃ bhajati</s> (he worships <s>Hari</s>). But when the object etc. is expressed [by a passive construction], the <s>prathamā</s> (nominative) [is used] — <s>hariḥ sevyate</s> (<s>Hari</s> is served). <s>lakṣmyā sevitaḥ</s> (served by <s>Lakṣmī</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>akathitaṃ ca</s>' (VLk 895 = P 1.4.51)

children.translated_text: A <s>kāraka</s> (participant) not denoted by the specific relations of <s>apādāna</s> (source) etc. receives the designation <s>karma</s> (object).

[Verse:] For [the roots] <s>duh</s> (to milk), <s>yāc</s> (to beg), <s>pac</s> (to cook), <s>daṇḍ</s> (to punish), <s>rudh</s> (to obstruct), <s>pracch</s> (to ask), <s>ci</s> (to gather), <s>brū</s> (to speak), <s>śās</s> (to teach), <s>ji</s> (to conquer), <s>math</s> (to churn), <s>muṣ</s> (to steal) —

a <s>karma</s> (object) is conjoined [as an additional accusative] that is 'unmentioned' (<s>akathita</s>); likewise for [the roots] <s>nī</s> (to lead), <s>hṛ</s> (to carry), <s>kṛṣ</s> (to drag), and <s>vah</s> (to convey). (verse 1)

body.text: gāṃ dogdhi payaḥ / baliṃ yācate vasudhām / taṇḍulānodanaṃ pacati / gargān śataṃ daṇḍayati / vrajamavaruṇaddhi gām / māṇavakaṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchati / vṛkṣamavacinoti phalāni / māṇavakaṃ dharmaṃ brūte śāsti vā / śataṃ jayati devadattam / sudhāṃ kṣīranidhiṃ mathnāti / devadattaṃ śataṃ muṣṇāti / grāmamajāṃ nayati harati karṣati vahati vā / arthanibandhaneyaṃ saṃjñā / baliṃ bhikṣate vasudhām / māṇavakaṃ dharmaṃ bhāṣate abhivatte vaktītyādi //
body.translated_text: [Examples:] <s>gāṃ dogdhi payaḥ</s> (he milks milk from the cow). <s>baliṃ yācate vasudhām</s> (he begs tribute from the earth). <s>taṇḍulān odanaṃ pacati</s> (he cooks rice-gruel from rice-grains). <s>gargān śataṃ daṇḍayati</s> (he fines the <s>Gargas</s> a hundred). <s>vrajam avaruṇaddhi gām</s> (he shuts the cow from the pen). <s>māṇavakaṃ panthānaṃ pṛcchati</s> (he asks the boy the way). <s>vṛkṣam avacinoti phalāni</s> (he gathers fruits from the tree). <s>māṇavakaṃ dharmaṃ brūte śāsti vā</s> (he teaches the boy <s>dharma</s>). <s>śataṃ jayati devadattam</s> (he wins a hundred from <s>Devadatta</s>). <s>sudhāṃ kṣīranidhiṃ mathnāti</s> (he churns nectar from the milk-ocean). <s>devadattaṃ śataṃ muṣṇāti</s> (he steals a hundred from <s>Devadatta</s>). <s>grāmam ajāṃ nayati harati karṣati vahati vā</s> (he leads/carries/drags/conveys the goat to the village). This designation is based on meaning. [Further:] <s>baliṃ bhikṣate vasudhām</s> (he begs tribute from the earth). <s>māṇavakaṃ dharmaṃ bhāṣate abhivatte vakti</s> (he speaks/announces/tells <s>dharma</s> to the boy), etc.
Thus [ends] the <s>dvitīyā</s> (accusative).
[Sūtra:] '<s>svatantraḥ kartā</s>' (VLk 896 = P 1.4.54)
The entity that is expressed as independent in an action is the agent (<s>kartā</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>sādhakatamaṃ karaṇam</s>' (VLk 897 = P 1.4.42)
That which is most effective in the accomplishment of the action receives the designation <s>karaṇa</s> (instrument).
[Sūtra:] '<s>kartṛ-karaṇayos tṛtīyā</s>' (VLk 898 = P 2.3.28)

body.text: anabhihite kartari karaṇe ca tṛtīyā syāt / rāmeṇa bāṇena hato vālī//
body.translated_text: The <s>tṛtīyā</s> (instrumental) is used with the agent and the instrument when they are not [otherwise] expressed. [Example:] <s>rāmeṇa bāṇena hato vālī</s> (<s>Vālī</s> was killed by <s>Rāma</s> with an arrow).
Thus [ends] the <s>tṛtīyā</s> (instrumental).

body.text: karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa sampradānam // VLk_899 = P_1,4.32 //
body.translated_text: [Sūtra:] '<s>karmaṇā yam abhipraiti sa sampradānam</s>' (VLk 899 = P 1.4.32)

body.text: dānasya karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa sampradānasaṃjñaḥ syāt //
body.translated_text: That [person] whom [the agent] intends to reach through the object of giving receives the designation <s>sampradāna</s> (recipient).
[Sūtra:] '<s>caturthī sampradāne</s>' (VLk 900 = P 2.3.13)
[Example:] <s>viprāya gāṃ dadāti</s> (he gives a cow to the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>namas-svasti-svāhā-svadhā-alaṃ-vaṣaḍ-yogāc ca</s>' (VLk 901 = P 2.3.16)

body.text: ebhiryoge caturthī / haraye namaḥ / prajābhyaḥ svasti / agnaye svāhā / pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā / alamiti paryāptyarthagrahaṇam / tena daityebhyo hariralaṃ prabhuḥ samarthaḥ śakta ityādi //
body.translated_text: The <s>caturthī</s> (dative) is also used in conjunction with these [words]. [Examples:] <s>haraye namaḥ</s> (salutation to <s>Hari</s>). <s>prajābhyaḥ svasti</s> (well-being to the people). <s>agnaye svāhā</s> (<s>svāhā</s> to <s>Agni</s>). <s>pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā</s> (<s>svadhā</s> to the ancestors). The word <s>alam</s> is taken in the sense of sufficiency — thus, <s>daityebhyo harir alaṃ prabhuḥ samarthaḥ śaktaḥ</s> (<s>Hari</s> is sufficient/powerful/capable against the demons), etc.
Thus [ends] the <s>caturthī</s> (dative).
[Sūtra:] '<s>dhruvam apāye 'pādānam</s>' (VLk 902 = P 1.4.24)

body.text: apāyo viśleṣastasminsādhye yad dhruvamavadhibhūtaṃ kārakaṃ tadapādānaṃ syāt //
body.translated_text: <s>Apāya</s> means separation; when that is to be expressed, the fixed point that serves as the boundary is the <s>kāraka</s> (participant) called <s>apādāna</s> (source/ablative).
[Sūtra:] '<s>apādāne pañcamī</s>' (VLk 903 = P 2.3.28)
[Examples:] <s>grāmād āyāti</s> (he comes from the village). <s>dhāvato 'śvāt patatī</s> (he falls from the running horse), etc.
Thus [ends] the <s>pañcamī</s> (ablative).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe</s>' (VLk 904 = P 2.3.50)

body.text: kārakaprātipadikārthavyatiriktaḥ svasvāmibhāvādiḥ saṃbandhaḥ śeṣastatra ṣaṣṭhī / rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ / karmādīnāpi saṃbandhamātravivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyeva / satāṃ gatam / sarpiṣo jānīte / mātuḥ smarati / edhodakasyopaskurute / bhaje śambhoścaraṇayoḥ //
body.translated_text: The relation that is other than <s>kāraka</s> (participant) meanings and <s>prātipadika</s>-meanings — such as the relation of owner and owned, etc. — is called <s>śeṣa</s> (remainder); in that, the <s>ṣaṣṭhī</s> (genitive) [is used]. [Example:] <s>rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ</s> (the king's man). Even for <s>karma</s> etc., when only the relation itself is intended, the <s>ṣaṣṭhī</s> alone [is used]. [Examples:] <s>satāṃ gatam</s> (the way of the good). <s>sarpiṣo jānīte</s> (he knows of ghee). <s>mātuḥ smarati</s> (he remembers his mother). <s>edhodakasyopaskurute</s> (he prepares of firewood and water). <s>bhaje śambhoś caraṇayoḥ</s> (I worship at the feet of <s>Śambhu</s>).
Thus [ends] the <s>ṣaṣṭhī</s> (genitive).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ādhāro 'dhikaraṇam</s>' (VLk 905 = P 1.4.45)
The locus — the <s>kāraka</s> that supports the action residing in the agent or object — is [called] <s>adhikaraṇa</s> (locative base).
[Sūtra:] '<s>saptamy adhikaraṇe ca</s>' (VLk 906 = P 2.3.36)

body.text: adhikaraṇe saptamī syāt, cakārāddūrāntikārthebhyaḥ / aupaśleṣiko vaiṣayiko '; bhivyāpakaścetyādhārastridhā / kaṭe āste / sthālyāṃ pacati / mokṣe icchāsti / sarvasminnātmāsti / vanasya dūre antike vā //
body.translated_text: The <s>saptamī</s> (locative) is used with <s>adhikaraṇa</s>, and by [the word] <s>ca</s>, [also] after words meaning 'far' and 'near.' The locus (<s>ādhāra</s>) is threefold: contact-based (<s>aupaśleṣika</s>), domain-based (<s>vaiṣayika</s>), and pervading (<s>abhivyāpaka</s>). [Examples:] <s>kaṭe āste</s> (he sits on the mat) [contact]. <s>sthālyāṃ pacati</s> (he cooks in the pot) [domain]. <s>mokṣe icchāsti</s> (there is desire for liberation) [domain]. <s>sarvasminn ātmāsti</s> (the Self exists in everything) [pervading]. <s>vanasya dūre antike vā</s> (far from or near the forest).

children.translated_text: Thus [end] the meanings of the case-endings (<s>vibhaktyarthāḥ</s>).

body.translated_text: Now compounds (<s>samāsāḥ</s>):

body.text: tatrādau kevalasamāsaḥ / samāsaḥ pañcadhā / tatra samasanaṃ samāsaḥ / sa ca viśeṣasaṃjñā vinirmuktaḥ kevalasamāsaḥ prathamaḥ // 1 // prāyeṇa pūrvapadārthapradhāno 'vyayībhāvo dvitīyaḥ // 2 // prāyeṇottarapadārthapradhānastatpuruṣastṛtīyaḥ // tatpuruṣabhedaḥ karmadhārayaḥ / karmadhārayabhedo dviguḥ // 3 // prāyeṇānyapadārthapradhāno bahuvrīhiścaturthaḥ // 4 // prāyeṇobhayapadārthapradhāno dvandvaḥ pañcamaḥ // 5 //
body.translated_text: Among them, first is the simple compound (<s>kevalasamāsa</s>). Compounds are fivefold. Therein, the act of combining is a <s>samāsa</s>. The first [type], free from specific designations, is the <s>kevalasamāsa</s> (simple compound). (1) The second, generally having the first member's meaning predominant, is <s>avyayībhāva</s> (indeclinable compound). (2) The third, generally having the last member's meaning predominant, is <s>tatpuruṣa</s> (determinative compound). A subdivision of <s>tatpuruṣa</s> is <s>karmadhāraya</s>. A subdivision of <s>karmadhāraya</s> is <s>dvigu</s>. (3) The fourth, generally having the meaning of another word predominant, is <s>bahuvrīhi</s> (possessive compound). (4) The fifth, generally having both members' meanings predominant, is <s>dvandva</s> (copulative compound). (5)
[Sūtra:] '<s>samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ</s>' (VLk 907 = P 2.1.1)

body.text: padasaṃbandhī yo vidhiḥ sa samarthāśrito bodhyaḥ //
body.translated_text: An operation relating to words (<s>pada</s>) should be understood as dependent on semantic connection (<s>sāmarthya</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>prāk kaḍārāt samāsaḥ</s>' (VLk 908 = P 2.1.3)

body.text: kaḍārāḥ karmadhāraya ityataḥ prāk samāsa ityadhikriyate //
body.translated_text: From [sūtra] '<s>kaḍārāḥ karmadhārayaḥ</s>' [up to here], the governing rule '<s>samāsa</s>' (compound) is in force.
[Sūtra:] '<s>saha supā</s>' (VLk 909 = P 2.1.4)

body.text: sup supā saha vā samasyate // samāsatvātprātipadikatvena supo luk / parārthābhidhānaṃ vṛttiḥ / kṛttaddhitasamāsaikaśeṣasanādyantadhāturūpāḥ pañca vṛttayaḥ / vṛttyarthāvabodhakaṃ vākyaṃ vigrahaḥ / saca laukiko 'laukikaśceti dvidhā / tatra pūrvaṃ bhūta iti laukikaḥ "pūrva am bhūta su'; ityalaukikaḥ / bhūtapūrvaḥ / bhūtapūrve caraḍiti nirdeśātpūrvanipātaḥ /

children.translated_text: (By a <s>vārttika</s>:) Compounding with <s>iva</s> (like) [entails] deletion of the case-ending

body.translated_text: A <s>sup</s>-ending [word] is optionally compounded with [another] <s>sup</s>-ending [word]. Because of compound-status, by <s>prātipadika</s>-status, <s>sup</s> endings are deleted (<s>luk</s>). An expression denoting the meaning of another is a <s>vṛtti</s> (derivative formation). The five <s>vṛttis</s> are: <s>kṛt</s>, <s>taddhita</s>, <s>samāsa</s>, <s>ekaśeṣa</s>, and <s>sanādyanta-dhātu</s>-forms. A sentence that conveys the meaning of a <s>vṛtti</s> is a <s>vigraha</s> (analytical paraphrase). It is twofold: conventional (<s>laukika</s>) and technical (<s>alaukika</s>). Thus, <s>pūrvaṃ bhūtaḥ</s> — this is the conventional [paraphrase]; '<s>pūrva am bhūta su</s>' — this is the technical [one]. [Compound:] <s>bhūtapūrvaḥ</s> (formerly existing). By the indication in '<s>bhūtapūrve caraḍ</s>' — the first member is placed first (<s>pūrvanipāta</s>).
Thus [ends] the <s>kevalasamāsa</s> (simple compound). (1)
Now the <s>avyayībhāva</s> (indeclinable compound):
[Sūtra:] '<s>avyayībhāvaḥ</s>' (VLk 910 = P 2.1.5)
This is a governing rule (<s>adhikāra</s>) [extending] up to <s>tatpuruṣa</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>avyayaṃ vibhakti-samīpa-samṛddhi-vyṛddhy-arthābhāvātyayāsaṃprati-śabda-prādurbhāva-paścād-yathānupūrvya-yaugapadya-sādṛśya-sampatti-sākalyānta-vacaneṣu</s>' (VLk 911 = P 2.1.6)

body.text: vibhaktyarthādiṣu vartamānamavyayaṃ subantena saha nityaṃ samasyate so 'vyayībhāvaḥ / prāyeṇāvigraho nityasamāsaḥ, prāyeṇāsvapadavigraho vā / vibhaktau, hari ṅi adhi iti sthite //
body.translated_text: An indeclinable (<s>avyaya</s>) occurring in the senses of case-meaning, proximity, prosperity, adversity, absence of meaning, passing beyond, 'no longer applicable,' manifestation, 'after,' 'according to,' simultaneity, similarity, attainment, totality, and inclusion — is obligatorily compounded with a <s>sup</s>-ending [word], and that is an <s>avyayībhāva</s>. Generally, an obligatory compound (<s>nityasamāsa</s>) has no analytical paraphrase, or alternatively has a paraphrase not using its own words. In [the sense of] case-meaning: <s>hari ṅi adhi</s> — when this [situation obtains] —
[Sūtra:] '<s>prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ samāsa upasarjanam</s>' (VLk 912 = P 1.2.43)
That which is denoted in the nominative case in the rules of compounds receives the designation <s>upasarjana</s> (subordinate member).
[Sūtra:] '<s>upasarjanaṃ pūrvam</s>' (VLk 913 = P 2.2.30)

body.text: samāse upasarjanaṃ prākprayojyam / ityadheḥ prāk prayogaḥ / supo luk / ekadeśavikṛtasyānanyatvātprātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ svādyutpattiḥ / avyayībhāvaścetya vyayatvātsupo luk / adhihari //
body.translated_text: In a compound, the <s>upasarjana</s> (subordinate member) is placed first. Thus <s>adhi</s> is placed first. <s>sup</s> endings are deleted (<s>luk</s>). Because a partially modified entity is not different [from the original], the <s>prātipadika</s> designation [applies] and <s>sup</s> endings arise [anew]. Being an <s>avyayībhāva</s>, by virtue of indeclinability, <s>sup</s> is deleted (<s>luk</s>). [Result:] <s>adhihari</s> (concerning <s>Hari</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>avyayībhāvaś ca</s>' (VLk 914 = P 2.4.18)
This [compound] is neuter.
[Sūtra:] '<s>nāvyayībhāvād ato 'mtvapañcamyāḥ</s>' (VLk 915 = P 2.4.83)

body.text: adantādavyayībhāvātsupo na luk, tasya pañcamī vinā amādeśaśca syāt // gāḥ pātīti gopāstasminnityadhigopam //
body.translated_text: After an <s>a</s>-ending <s>avyayībhāva</s>, <s>sup</s> is not deleted (<s>luk</s>); for that [<s>sup</s>], except for the fifth case (<s>pañcamī</s>), the <s>am</s>-replacement occurs. [Example:] <s>gāḥ pāti</s> means 'protects cows' — that is <s>gopa</s>; in that [word], 'always concerning the cowherd' — <s>adhigopam</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>tṛtīyā-saptamyor bahulam</s>' (VLk 916 = P 2.4.54)

body.text: adantādavyayībhāvāttṛtīyāsaptamyorbahulamambhāvaḥ syāt / adhigopam, adhigopena, adhigope vā / kṛṣṇasya samīpam upakṛṣṇam / madrāṇāṃ samṛddhiḥ sumadram / yavanānāṃ vyṛddhirduryavanam / makṣikāṇāmabhāvo nirmakṣikam / himasyātyayo 'tihimam / nidrā saṃprati na yujyata ityatinidram / hariśabdasya prakāśa itihari / viṣṇoḥ paścādanuviṣṇu / yogyatāvīpsāpadārthānativṛttisādṛśyāni yathārthāḥ / rūpasya yogyamanurūpam / arthamarthaṃ prati prartṣatham / śaktimanatikramya yathāśakti //
body.translated_text: After an <s>a</s>-ending <s>avyayībhāva</s>, the replacement by <s>am</s> in the third and seventh cases is irregular (<s>bahulam</s>). [Forms:] <s>adhigopam</s>, <s>adhigopena</s>, <s>adhigope</s> — optionally. [Examples:] Proximity of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s> — <s>upakṛṣṇam</s>. Prosperity of the <s>Madras</s> — <s>sumadram</s>. Adversity of the <s>Yavanas</s> — <s>duryavanam</s>. Absence of flies — <s>nirmakṣikam</s>. Passing beyond winter — <s>atihimam</s>. Sleep is no longer applicable — <s>atinidram</s>. Manifestation of the word <s>hari</s> — <s>itihari</s>. After <s>Viṣṇu</s> — <s>anuviṣṇu</s>. Fitness, repetition, non-transgression of meaning, and similarity are the meanings of <s>yathā</s>. According to form — <s>anurūpam</s>. For each purpose — <s>pratyartham</s>. Not exceeding one's capacity — <s>yathāśakti</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>avyayībhāve cākāle</s>' (VLk 917 = P 6.3.81)

body.text: sahasya saḥ syādavyayībhāve na tu kāle / hareḥ sādṛśyaṃ sahari / jyeṣṭhasyānu pūrvyeṇetyanujyeṣṭham / cakreṇa yugapat sacakram / sadṛśaḥ sakhyā sasakhi / kṣatrāṇāṃ saṃpattiḥ sakṣatram / tṛṇamapyaparityajya satṛṇamatti / agnigranthaparyantamadhīte sāgni //
body.translated_text: [The prefix] <s>saha</s> becomes <s>sa</s> in an <s>avyayībhāva</s>, but not in [compounds expressing] time. [Examples:] Similarity with <s>Hari</s> — <s>sahari</s>. Seniority by order — <s>anujyeṣṭham</s>. Together with the discus — <s>sacakram</s>. Equal to a friend — <s>sasakhi</s>. Attainment of the <s>Kṣatriyas</s> — <s>sakṣatram</s>. Not abandoning even a blade of grass, he eats completely — <s>satṛṇam</s>. He studies up to the <s>Agni</s> section — <s>sāgni</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>nadībhiś ca</s>' (VLk 918 = P 2.1.20)

children.translated_text: This [compound] is accepted as a collective (<s>samāhāra</s>)

body.translated_text: A numeral is compounded with river-names. (
[Sūtra:] '<s>taddhitāḥ</s>' (VLk 919 = P 4.1.76)
This is a governing rule (<s>adhikāra</s>) [extending] up to the end of the fifth [book].
[Sūtra:] '<s>avyayībhāve śarat-prabhṛtibhyaḥ</s>' (VLk 920 = P 5.4.107)

children.translated_text: By a <s>vārttika</s>:) For <s>jarā</s> (old age), [there is also the form] <s>jaras</s>

body.translated_text: After [stems] beginning with <s>śarad</s>, the affix <s>ṭac</s> is added as a compound-final element in an <s>avyayībhāva</s>. [Example:] The proximity of autumn — <s>upaśaradam</s>. [Another:] <s>prativipāśam</s> (toward [the river] <s>Vipāś</s>). (
[Sūtra:] '<s>anaś ca</s>' (VLk 921 = P 5.4.108)
After an <s>an</s>-ending [stem], <s>ṭac</s> is added to the <s>avyayībhāva</s> [compound].
[Sūtra:] '<s>nas taddhite</s>' (VLk 922 = P 6.4.144)
The <s>ṭi</s>-portion of an <s>n</s>-ending <s>bha</s>-stem is deleted before a <s>taddhita</s> [affix]. [Examples:] <s>uparājam</s> (near the king). <s>adhyātmam</s> (concerning the self).
[Sūtra:] '<s>napuṃsakād anyatarasyām</s>' (VLk 923 = P 5.4.109)

body.text: annantaṃ yat klībaṃ tadantādavyayībhāvāṭṭajvā syāt / upacarmam / upacarma //
body.translated_text: After a neuter <s>an</s>-ending [stem], <s>ṭac</s> is optionally added to the <s>avyayībhāva</s>. [Examples:] <s>upacarmam</s> or <s>upacarma</s> (near the hide).
[Sūtra:] '<s>jhayaḥ</s>' (VLk 924 = P 5.4.111)
After a <s>jhay</s>-ending [stem], <s>ṭac</s> is optionally added to the <s>avyayībhāva</s>. [Examples:] <s>upasamidham</s> or <s>upasamit</s> (near the firewood).
Thus [ends] the <s>avyayībhāva</s> [compound]. (2)
Now the <s>tatpuruṣa</s> (determinative compound):
[Sūtra:] '<s>tatpuruṣaḥ</s>' (VLk 925 = P 2.1.22)
This is a governing rule (<s>adhikāra</s>) [extending] up to <s>bahuvrīhi</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>dviguś ca</s>' (VLk 926 = P 2.1.23)
<s>Dvigu</s> also receives the designation <s>tatpuruṣa</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>dvitīyā-śritātītapatita-gatātyasta-prāptāpannaiḥ</s>' (VLk 927 = P 2.1.24)

body.text: dvitīyāntaṃ śritādiprakṛtikaiḥ subantaiḥ saha vā samasyate sa ca tatpuruṣaḥ / kṛṣṇaṃ śritaḥ kṛṣṇaśrita ityādi //
body.translated_text: An accusative-ending [word] is optionally compounded with <s>sup</s>-ending [words] having <s>śrita</s> (resorted to) etc. as their base, and that is a <s>tatpuruṣa</s>. [Example:] <s>kṛṣṇaṃ śritaḥ</s> [becomes] <s>kṛṣṇaśritaḥ</s> (one who has resorted to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>), etc.
[Sūtra:] '<s>tṛtīyā tat-kṛtārthena guṇavacanena</s>' (VLk 928 = P 2.1.30)

body.text: tṛtīyāntaṃ tṛtīyāntārthakṛtaguṇavacanenārthena ca saha vā prāgvat / śaṅkulayā khaṇḍaḥ / dhānyenārtho dhānyārthaḥ / tatkṛteti kim ? akṣṇā kāṇaḥ //
body.translated_text: An instrumental-ending [word] is optionally compounded with [a word whose] meaning is accomplished by that [instrumental] or a word denoting a quality — as before. [Examples:] <s>śaṅkulayā khaṇḍaḥ</s> [becomes] (broken by a peg). <s>dhānyenārthaḥ</s> [becomes] <s>dhānyārthaḥ</s> (one whose purpose is grain). [Objection:] Why '<s>tatkṛta</s>'? [Answer:] <s>akṣṇā kāṇaḥ</s> (blind in one eye) [does not compound, since the blindness is not produced by the eye].
[Sūtra:] '<s>kartṛ-karaṇe kṛtā bahulam</s>' (VLk 929 = P 2.1.32)

body.text: kartari karaṇe ca tṛtīyā kṛdantena bahulaṃ prāgvat / hariṇā trāto haritrātaḥ / nakhairbhinnaḥ nakhabhinnaḥ / (pa.)

children.translated_text: When <s>kṛt</s> is mentioned [in a rule], it includes [forms] preceded by <s>gati</s> (preverb) and <s>kāraka</s> (participant)

body.translated_text: An instrumental [denoting] agent or instrument is irregularly (<s>bahulam</s>) compounded with a <s>kṛt</s>-ending [word] — as before. [Examples:] <s>hariṇā trātaḥ</s> [becomes] <s>haritrātaḥ</s> (protected by <s>Hari</s>). <s>nakhair bhinnaḥ</s> [becomes] <s>nakhabhinnaḥ</s> (split by nails). (By a <s>paribhāṣā</s>:)
[Sūtra:] '<s>caturthī tad-arthārtha-bali-hita-sukha-rakṣitaiḥ</s>' (VLk 930 = P 2.1.36)

body.translated_text: A dative-ending [word] is optionally compounded with [a word] meaning 'for the purpose of that' — with [words like] <s>artha</s> etc. and a word denoting 'for which [it is intended]' — as before. [Example:] <s>yūpāya dāru</s> [becomes] <s>yūpadāru</s> (wood for a sacrificial post). (

[Example:] <s>corād bhayam</s> [becomes] <s>corabhayam</s> (fear of a thief).

[Sūtra:] '<s>pañcamyāḥ stokādibhyaḥ</s>' (VLk 933 = P 6.3.2)

body.translated_text: When <s>aluk</s> (non-deletion) [applies] in the latter member [of the compound]. [Examples:] <s>stokān muktaḥ</s> — <s>stokānmuktaḥ</s> (released from a small [distance]). <s>antikād āgataḥ</s> — <s>antikādāgataḥ</s> (come from nearby). <s>abhyāśād āgataḥ</s> — <s>abhyāśādāgataḥ</s> (come from close by). <s>dūrād āgataḥ</s> — <s>dūrādāgataḥ</s> (come from far). <s>kṛcchrād āgataḥ</s> — <s>kṛcchrādāgataḥ</s> (come from difficulty).

[Sūtra:] '<s>pūrvāparādharottara-mekadeśinaikādhikaraṇe</s>' (VLk 935 = P 2.2.1)

body.text: avayavinā saha pūrvādayaḥ samasyante ekatvasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭaścedavayavī / ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāpavādaḥ / pūrvaṃ kāyasya pūrvakāyaḥ / aparakāyaḥ / ekādhikaraṇe kim ? pūrvaśchātrāṇām //
body.translated_text: <s>Pūrva</s> (front) and the others compound with a word denoting a whole, provided the whole is qualified by the number one [i.e., is a single entity]. This is an exception to the <s>ṣaṣṭhī-samāsa</s> (genitive compound). [Examples:] <s>pūrvaṃ kāyasya</s> — <s>pūrvakāyaḥ</s> (front of the body). <s>aparakāyaḥ</s> (rear of the body). Why [the condition] 'being in the same locus'? [Counter-example:] <s>pūrvaś chātrāṇām</s> (the foremost among the students) [does not compound because the students are many].
[Sūtra:] '<s>ardhaṃ napuṃsakam</s>' (VLk 936 = P 2.2.2)

body.text: samāṃśavācyardhaśabdo nityaṃ klībe, sa prāgvat / ardhaṃ pippalyāḥ ardhapippalī /
body.translated_text: The word <s>ardha</s> (half), when denoting an equal share, is invariably neuter; it [compounds] as before. [Example:] <s>ardhaṃ pippalyāḥ</s> — <s>ardhapippalī</s> (half a long pepper).
[Sūtra:] '<s>saptamī śauṇḍaiḥ</s>' (VLk 937 = P 2.1.40)

body.text: saptamyantaṃ śauṇḍādibhiḥ prāgvat / akṣeṣu śauṇḍaḥ akṣaśoṇḍa ityādi / dvitīyātṛtīyetyādiyogavibhāgādanyatrāpi tṛtīyādivibhaktīnāṃ prayogavaśātsamāso jñeyaḥ //
body.translated_text: A word ending in the seventh case (<s>saptamī</s>, locative) [compounds] with <s>śauṇḍa</s> and the others, as before. [Example:] <s>akṣeṣu śauṇḍaḥ</s> — <s>akṣaśauṇḍaḥ</s> (addicted to dice), and so forth. Because the [rules for] second case, third case, etc. are separated by <s>yogavibhāga</s> (division of rules), it should be understood that compounding with third and other case-endings also [occurs] elsewhere based on usage.
[Sūtra:] '<s>dik-saṃkhye saṃjñāyām</s>' (VLk 938 = P 2.1.50)

body.text: saṃjñāyāmeveti niyamārthaṃ sūtram / pūrveṣukāmaśamī / saptarṣayaḥ / teneha na - uttarā vṛkṣāḥ / pañca brāhmaṇāḥ //
body.translated_text: The sūtra is for the purpose of restriction — 'only in a proper name.' [Examples:] <s>pūrveṣukāmaśamī</s> (name of a place). <s>saptarṣayaḥ</s> (the Seven Sages). Therefore not here: <s>uttarā vṛkṣāḥ</s> (the northern trees). <s>pañca brāhmaṇāḥ</s> (five Brāhmaṇas).
[Sūtra:] '<s>taddhitārthottarapada-samāhāre ca</s>' (VLk 939 = P 2.1.51)

body.text: taddhitārthe viṣaye uttarapade ca parataḥ samāhāre ca vācye diksaṃkhye prāgvat / pūrvasyāṃ śālāyāṃ bhavaḥ - pūrvā śālā iti samāse jāte

body.translated_text: When the meaning of a <s>taddhita</s> affix is intended, when a latter member follows, and when a collective meaning (<s>samāhāra</s>) is expressed — directional and numerical words [compound] as before. [Example:] <s>pūrvasyāṃ śālāyāṃ bhavaḥ</s> (belonging to the eastern hall) — when the compound <s>pūrvā śālā</s> is formed,
[Sūtra:] '<s>dik-pūrvapadād asaṃjñāyāṃ ñaḥ</s>' (VLk 940 = P 4.2.107)
From [a compound with] a directional word as prior member, the affix <s>ña</s> is added in the sense of 'born in,' 'dwelling in,' etc. — when it is not a proper name.
[Sūtra:] '<s>taddhiteṣv acām ādeḥ</s>' (VLk 941 = P 7.2.117)

body.text: ñiti ṇiti ca taddhiteṣvacāmāderaco vṛddhiḥ syāt / yasyeti ca / paurvaśālaḥ / pañca gāvo dhanaṃ yasyeti tripade bahuvrīhau / (

children.translated_text: (<s>Vārttika</s>:) 'In <s>dvandva</s> and <s>tatpuruṣa</s> [compounds], compounding with the latter member should be stated as obligatory.'

body.translated_text: Before <s>ñit</s> and <s>ṇit taddhita</s> affixes, the initial vowel among vowels undergoes <s>vṛddhi</s>. And by [the rule] '<s>yasya</s>' [the <s>a</s> of <s>ña</s> is deleted]. [Example:] <s>paurvaśālaḥ</s> (relating to the eastern hall). [In the compound] <s>pañca gāvo dhanaṃ yasya</s> (one whose wealth is five cows) — a three-word <s>bahuvrīhi</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>gor a-taddhita-luki</s>' (VLk 942 = P 5.4.92)

body.text: go 'ntāttatpuruṣāṭṭac syāt samāsānto na tu taddhitaluki / pañcagavadhanaḥ //
body.translated_text: After a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> ending in <s>go</s> (cow), the <s>ṭac</s> [suffix] is added as a final element of the compound — but not when a <s>taddhita</s> has undergone <s>luk</s> (deletion). [Example:] <s>pañcagavadhanaḥ</s> (one whose wealth is five cows).

The meaning of a <s>dvigu</s> [compound] denoting a collective (<s>samāhāra</s>) takes singular number.
[Sūtra:] '<s>sa napuṃsakam</s>' (VLk 946 = P 2.4.17)

body.text: samāhāre dvigurdvandvaśca napuṃsakaṃ syāt / pañcānāṃ gavāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcagavam /
body.translated_text: A <s>dvigu</s> and a <s>dvandva</s> [compound] denoting a collective become neuter. [Example:] <s>pañcānāṃ gavāṃ samāhāraḥ</s> — <s>pañcagavam</s> (a group of five cows).
[Sūtra:] '<s>viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa bahulam</s>' (VLk 947 = P 2.1.57)

body.text: bhedakaṃ bhedyena samānādhikaraṇena bahulaṃ prāgvat / nīlamutpalaṃ nīlotpalam / bahulagrahaṇātkvacinnityam - kṛṣṇasarpaḥ / kvacinna - rāmo jāmadagnyaḥ //
body.translated_text: A qualifier [compounds] with the qualified [word] that is in the same case relation, in many cases as before. [Example:] <s>nīlam utpalaṃ</s> — <s>nīlotpalam</s> (blue lotus). Because of the word <s>bahula</s> (variously), sometimes [compounding is] obligatory: <s>kṛṣṇasarpaḥ</s> (black snake). Sometimes not: <s>Rāmo Jāmadagnyaḥ</s> (<s>Rāma</s> son of <s>Jamadagni</s>).

body.translated_text: After the <s>nañ</s> whose <s>n</s> has been deleted, the <s>nuṭ</s> augment is inserted before a vowel-initial latter member. [Example:] <s>anaśvaḥ</s> (without a horse).
