[Sūtra:] '<s>pṛthvādibhya imanij vā</s>' (VLk 1158 = P 5.1.122)
The word <s>vā</s> (optionally) is for the purpose of co-application with <s>aṇ</s> etc.
[Sūtra:] '<s>ra ṛto halāder laghoḥ</s>' (VLk 1159 = P 6.4.161)

body.text: halāderlaghorṛkārasya raḥ syādiṣṭheyassu parataḥ / pṛthumṛdubhṛśakṛśadṛḍhaparivṛḍhā nāmeva ratvam //
body.translated_text: The <s>ṛ</s>-vowel of a light, consonant-initial [stem] becomes <s>ra</s> before <s>iṣṭha</s>, <s>iyasun</s> [and <s>iman</s>]. [This applies to] <s>pṛthu</s>, <s>mṛdu</s>, <s>bhṛśa</s>, <s>kṛśa</s>, <s>dṛḍha</s>, <s>parivṛḍha</s> — the <s>ra</s>-replacement is for these alone.
The <s>ṭi</s>-portion of a <s>bha</s>-stem is deleted before <s>iṣṭha</s>, <s>iman</s>, and <s>iyasun</s>. [Example:] The abstract state of <s>pṛthu</s> (broad) — <s>prathimā</s> (breadth) —
[Sūtra:] '<s>igantāc ca laghu-pūrvāt</s>' (VLk 1161 = P 5.1.131)

body.text: igantāllaghupūrvāt prātipadikādbhāve 'ṇ pratyayaḥ / pārthavam / mradimā, mārdavam //
body.translated_text: After an <s>ik</s>-ending <s>prātipadika</s> with a light preceding [syllable], the <s>aṇ</s> suffix is used in the sense of abstract state (<s>bhāva</s>). [Example:] <s>pārthavam</s> (breadth/expansion). <s>mradimā</s> (softness, with <s>iman</s>), <s>mārdavam</s> (softness, with <s>aṇ</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>varṇa-dṛḍhādibhyaḥ ṣyañ ca</s>' (VLk 1162 = P 5.1.123)

[The word] <s>ca</s> [brings in] <s>iman</s> also. [Examples:] <s>śauklyam</s> (whiteness, with <s>ṣyañ</s>). <s>śuklimā</s> (whiteness, with <s>iman</s>). <s>dārḍhyam</s> (hardness). <s>draḍhimā</s> (hardness).
[Sūtra:] '<s>guṇavacana-brāhmaṇādibhyaḥ karmaṇi ca</s>' (VLk 1163 = P 5.1.124)

body.text: cādbhāve / jaḍasya bhāvaḥ karma vā jāḍyam / mūḍhasya bhāvaḥ karma vā mauḍhyam / brāhmaṇyam / ākṛtigaṇo 'yam //
body.translated_text: [The word] <s>ca</s> [includes] abstract state (<s>bhāva</s>) also. [Examples:] The state or action of a fool — <s>jāḍyam</s> (stupidity). The state or action of a confused person — <s>mauḍhyam</s> (delusion). <s>brāhmaṇyam</s> (the state of being a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>). This is an open-ended class (<s>ākṛtigaṇa</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>sakhyur yaḥ</s>' (VLk 1164 = P 5.1.126)
The state or action of a friend — <s>sakhyam</s> (friendship).
[Sūtra:] '<s>kapi-jñātyor ḍhak</s>' (VLk 1165 = P 5.1.127)
[Examples:] <s>kāpeyam</s> (the state of a monkey). <s>jñāteyam</s> (the state of a kinsman).
[Sūtra:] '<s>paty-anta-purohitādibhyo yak</s>' (VLk 1166 = P 5.1.128)
[Examples:] <s>saināpatyam</s> (generalship). <s>paurohityam</s> (the office of a family priest).
Thus [ends] the <s>tva</s>-and-<s>tal</s> governing section. (Section 11)
Now the suffixes denoting existence-meaning and the like (<s>bhavanādyarthaka</s>):

body.text: dhānyānāṃ bhavane kṣetre khañ // VLk_1167 = P_5,2.1 //
body.translated_text: [Sūtra:] '<s>dhānyānāṃ bhavane kṣetre khañ</s>' (VLk 1167 = P 5.2.1)

body.text: bhavatyasminniti bhavanam / mudgānāṃ bhavanaṃ kṣetraṃ maudgīnam //
body.translated_text: <s>Bhavana</s> means 'that in which [something] exists.' A field where <s>mudgas</s> (green gram) grow — <s>maudgīnam</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>vrīhi-śālyor ḍhak</s>' (VLk 1168 = P 5.2.2)
[Examples:] <s>vraiheyam</s> (a rice-field). <s>śāleyam</s> (a <s>śāli</s>-rice field).
[Sūtra:] '<s>haiyaṅgavīnaṃ saṃjñāyām</s>' (VLk 1169 = P 5.2.23)

body.text: hyogodohaśabdasya hiyaṅgurādeśaḥ vikārārthe khañca nipātyate / duhyata iti dohaḥ kṣīram / hyogodohasya vikāraḥ - haiyaṅgavīnaṃ navanītam //
body.translated_text: The word <s>hyogodoha</s> (yesterday's milking) undergoes replacement by <s>hiyaṅgu</s>, and <s>khañ</s> is specially listed (<s>nipātana</s>) in the modification-sense. <s>Doha</s> means 'milking,' i.e. milk. A product of yesterday's milking — <s>haiyaṅgavīnam</s> (fresh butter).

body.text: tadasya saṃjātaṃ tārakādibhya itac // VLk_1170 = P_5,2.36 //
body.translated_text: [Sūtra:] '<s>tad asya saṃjātaṃ tārakādibhya itac</s>' (VLk 1170 = P 5.2.36)

body.text: tārakāḥ saṃjātā asya tārakitaṃ nabhaḥ / paṇḍitaḥ / ākṛtigaṇo 'yam //
body.translated_text: Stars have arisen in it — <s>tārakitaṃ nabhaḥ</s> (a star-filled sky). <s>paṇḍitaḥ</s> (a learned person). This is an open-ended class (<s>ākṛtigaṇa</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>pramāṇe dvayasaj-daghnañ-mātra-caḥ</s>' (VLk 1171 = P 5.2.37)

body.text: tadasyetyanuvartate / ūrū pramāṇamasya - ūrudvayasam / ūrudaghnam / ūrumātram //
body.translated_text: 'That is his' continues [from prior]. The thighs are his measure — <s>ūrudvayasam</s> (reaching up to the thighs). <s>ūrudaghnam</s> (thigh-deep). <s>ūrumātram</s> (of thigh-measure).
[Sūtra:] '<s>yat-tad-etebhyaḥ parimāṇe vatup</s>' (VLk 1172 = P 5.2.39)
[Meaning:] 'that which is his measure' — <s>yāvān</s> (of which extent). <s>tāvān</s> (of that extent). <s>etāvān</s> (of this extent).
[Sūtra:] '<s>kim-idaṃbhyāṃ vo ghaḥ</s>' (VLk 1173 = P 5.2.40)
After these two [<s>kim</s> and <s>idam</s>], <s>vatup</s> is used and the <s>va</s> is replaced by <s>gha</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>idaṃ-kimor īś-kī</s>' (VLk 1174 = P 6.3.90)

body.text: dṛgdṛśavatuṣu idama īś kimaḥ kiḥ / kiyān / iyān //
body.translated_text: Before <s>dṛk</s>, <s>dṛśa</s>, and <s>vatu</s> — <s>idam</s> becomes <s>īś</s> and <s>kim</s> becomes <s>ki</s>. [Forms:] <s>kiyān</s> (of what extent). <s>iyān</s> (of this extent).
[Sūtra:] '<s>saṃkhyāyā avayave tayap</s>' (VLk 1175 = P 5.2.39)
Five are its parts — <s>pañcatayam</s> (fivefold).
[Sūtra:] '<s>dvi-tribhyāṃ tayasyāyaj vā</s>' (VLk 1176 = P 5.2.43)
[Examples:] <s>dvayam</s> (twofold/pair). <s>dvitayam</s> (twofold). <s>trayam</s> (threefold/triad). <s>tritayam</s> (threefold).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ubhād udātto nityam</s>' (VLk 1177 = P 5.2.44)
After the word <s>ubha</s> (both), <s>tayap</s> is replaced by <s>ayac</s> and it has initial <s>udātta</s> accent. [Form:] <s>ubhayam</s> (both).
[Sūtra:] '<s>tasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ</s>' (VLk 1178 = P 5.2.48)
The one that completes eleven — <s>ekādaśaḥ</s> (eleventh).
[Sūtra:] '<s>nāntād asaṃkhyāder maṭ</s>' (VLk 1179 = P 5.2.49)

body.text: ḍaṭo maḍāgamaḥ / pañcānāṃ pūraṇaḥ pañcamaḥ / nāntātkim ? .
body.translated_text: The <s>maṭ</s> augment is added to <s>ḍaṭ</s>. [Example:] The one that completes five — <s>pañcamaḥ</s> (fifth). [Question:] Why 'after an <s>n</s>-ending [numeral]'?
[Sūtra:] '<s>ti viṃśater ḍiti</s>' (VLk 1180 = P 6.4.142)

body.text: viṃśaterbhasya tiśabdasya lopo ḍiti pare / viṃśaḥ / asaṃkhyādeḥ kim ? ekādaśaḥ //
body.translated_text: The <s>ti</s>-portion of the <s>bha</s>-stem of <s>viṃśati</s> (twenty) is deleted when a <s>ḍit</s> [suffix] follows. [Form:] <s>viṃśaḥ</s> (twentieth). [Question:] Why 'not beginning with a numeral (<s>asaṃkhyādi</s>)'? [Answer:] <s>ekādaśaḥ</s> (eleventh) [does not take <s>maṭ</s>].
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṣaṭ-kati-katipaya-caturāṃ thuk</s>' (VLk 1181 = P 5.2.51)

body.text: eṣāṃ thugāgamaḥ syāḍḍaṭi/ ṣaṇṇāṃ ṣaṣṭhaḥ/ katithaḥ/ katipayaśabdasyāsaṃkhyātve 'pyata eva jñāpakāḍḍaṭ/ katipayathaḥ/ caturthaḥ //
body.translated_text: For these, the <s>thuk</s> augment is added before <s>ḍaṭ</s>. [Example:] The one completing six — <s>ṣaṣṭhaḥ</s> (sixth). <s>katithaḥ</s> (which-numbered?). Although the word <s>katipaya</s> is not a numeral, <s>ḍaṭ</s> [is added] by this very <s>jñāpaka</s> (indicatory device). <s>katipayathaḥ</s> (a certain-numbered one). <s>caturthaḥ</s> (fourth).
[Sūtra:] '<s>dves tīyaḥ</s>' (VLk 1182 = P 5.2.54)
[This is] an exception to <s>ḍaṭ</s>. [Example:] The one completing two — <s>dvitīyaḥ</s> (second).
[Sūtra:] '<s>treḥ saṃprasāraṇaṃ ca</s>' (VLk 1183 = P 5.2.55)
[Form:] <s>tṛtīyaḥ</s> (third).
[Sūtra:] '<s>śrotriyaṃś chando 'dhīte</s>' (VLk 1184 = P 5.2.84)
<s>Śrotriyaḥ</s> (one who has studied the Vedas). By the continued force of [the word] <s>vetti</s> (he knows) — <s>chāndasaḥ</s> (one versed in Vedic meters).
[Sūtra:] '<s>pūrvādiniḥ</s>' (VLk 1185 = P 5.2.86)
[Example:] He has done it before — <s>pūrvī</s> (one who has done [something] before).
[Sūtra:] '<s>sa-pūrvāc ca</s>' (VLk 1186 = P 5.2.87)
[Example:] <s>kṛtapūrvā</s> (one who has done [something] before, feminine).
[Sūtra:] '<s>iṣṭādibhyaś ca</s>' (VLk 1187 = P 5.2.88)
[Examples:] He has sacrificed by this — <s>iṣṭī</s> (one who has sacrificed). <s>adhītī</s> (one who has studied).
Thus [end] the existence-meaning suffixes. (Section 12)
Now the possessive-meaning suffixes (<s>matvarthīya</s>):
[Sūtra:] '<s>tad asyāsty asminn iti matup</s>' (VLk 1188 = P 5.2.94)
He who has cows or in whom cows exist — <s>gomān</s> (possessing cows).
[Sūtra:] '<s>tāsau matvarthe</s>' (VLk 1189 = P 1.4.19)

body.text: tāntasāntau bhasaṃjñau sto matvarthe pratyaye pare / garutmān / vasoḥ saṃprasāraṇaṃ / viduṣmān / (

children.translated_text: By a <s>vārttika</s>:) Deletion (<s>luk</s>) of <s>matup</s> after words denoting a quality is preferred

children.text: ḥ) / śuklo guṇo 'syāstīti śuklaḥ paṭaḥ / kṛṣṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: ) [Example:] White is a quality that it possesses — [simply] <s>śuklaḥ paṭaḥ</s> (a white cloth). <s>kṛṣṇaḥ</s> (black) [without <s>matup</s>].

body.translated_text: The <s>t</s>-ending and <s>s</s>-ending [stems] receive the <s>bha</s> designation when a <s>matvartha</s> (possessive-meaning) suffix follows. [Examples:] <s>garutmān</s> (winged / <s>Garuḍa</s>). By '<s>vasoḥ saṃprasāraṇam</s>' — <s>viduṣmān</s> (one who is learned). (
[Sūtra:] '<s>prāṇi-sthād āto laj anyatarasyām</s>' (VLk 1190 = P 5.2.96)

body.text: cūḍālaḥ / cūḍāvān / prāṇisthātkim ? śikhāvāndīpaḥ / prāṇyaṅgādeva / medhāvān //
body.translated_text: [Examples:] <s>cūḍālaḥ</s> (crested, with <s>la</s>). <s>cūḍāvān</s> (crested, with <s>matup</s>). [Question:] Why 'when situated on a living being (<s>prāṇistha</s>)'? [Answer:] <s>śikhāvān dīpaḥ</s> (a lamp with a flame) [takes <s>matup</s>, not <s>la</s>, since a lamp is not a living being]. [It applies] only to a body part of a living being. <s>medhāvān</s> (intelligent).
[Sūtra:] '<s>lomādi-pāmādi-picchādibhyaḥ śa-n-elacaḥ</s>' (VLk 1191 = P 5.2.100)

body.text: lomādibhyaḥ śaḥ / lomaśaḥ / lomavān / romaśaḥ / romavān / pāmādibhyo naḥ / pāmanaḥ / (ga. sū.)

children.translated_text: 'After a word denoting a body-part, in the sense of auspiciousness' —
[Example:] <s>lakṣmaṇaḥ</s> (one possessed of auspicious marks). After the <s>picchādi</s> group — <s>ilac</s> [suffix]. [Example:] <s>picchilaḥ</s> (slimy). <s>picchavān</s> (having a tail-feather).

body.translated_text: After the <s>lomādi</s> group — <s>śa</s> [suffix applies]. [Examples:] <s>lomaśaḥ</s> (hairy). <s>lomavān</s> (having hair). <s>romaśaḥ</s> (hairy). <s>romavān</s>. After the <s>pāmādi</s> group — <s>na</s> [suffix]. [Example:] <s>pāmanaḥ</s> (having scabs). (<s>Gaṇasūtra</s>:)
[Sūtra:] '<s>danta unnata urac</s>' (VLk 1192 = P 5.2.106)
He whose teeth are prominent — <s>danturaḥ</s> (buck-toothed).
[Sūtra:] '<s>keśādvo 'nyatarasyām</s>' (VLk 1193 = P 5.2.109)

children.translated_text: (<s>Vārttika</s>:) '[These suffixes] are also seen from other [stems].'

body.translated_text: [Examples:] <s>keśavaḥ</s> (one with beautiful hair). <s>keśī</s>. <s>keśikaḥ</s>. <s>keśavān</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>ata inī-ṭhanau</s>' (VLk 1194 = P 5.2.115)
[Examples:] <s>daṇḍī</s> (one with a staff). <s>daṇḍikaḥ</s> (having a staff).
[Sūtra:] '<s>vrīhyādibhyaś ca</s>' (VLk 1195 = P 5.2.116)
[Examples:] <s>vrīhī</s> (one having rice). <s>vrīhikaḥ</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>asmāyām-edhā-srajaḥ viniḥ</s>' (VLk 1196 = P 5.2.121)
[Examples:] <s>yaśasvī</s> (glorious). <s>yaśasvān</s>. <s>māyāvī</s> (deceitful). <s>medhāvī</s> (intelligent). <s>sragvī</s> (garlanded).
[Sūtra:] '<s>vaco gminiḥ</s>' (VLk 1197 = P 5.2.124)
[Example:] <s>vāggmī</s> (eloquent).
[Sūtra:] '<s>arśaādibhyo 'c</s>' (VLk 1198 = P 5.2.127)
'He has hemorrhoids' — <s>arśasaḥ</s> (one afflicted with hemorrhoids). This is an <s>ākṛtigaṇa</s> (open-ended class).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ahaṃ-śubhamayor yuḥ</s>' (VLk 1199 = P 5.2.140)
<s>ahaṃyuḥ</s> means one possessing egotism (<s>ahaṅkāravān</s>). <s>śubhaṃyuḥ</s> means one endowed with auspiciousness (<s>śubhānvitaḥ</s>).
Thus [end] the <s>matvartha</s> (possessive) suffixes. (Section 13)
Now [begin] the <s>prāgdiśīya</s> [suffixes].
[Sūtra:] '<s>prāg diśo vibhaktiḥ</s>' (VLk 1200 = P 5.3.1)

body.text: dikchabdebhya ityataḥ prāgvakṣyamāṇāḥ pratyayā vibhaktisaṃjñāḥ syuḥ //
body.translated_text: From [the sūtra about] directional words up to what will be stated [next] — the suffixes receive the designation <s>vibhakti</s> (case-like affix).
[Sūtra:] '<s>kiṃ-sarvanāma-bahubhyo 'dvy-ādibhyaḥ</s>' (VLk 1201 = P 5.3.2)
After <s>kim</s>, a <s>sarvanāman</s> (pronoun), and the word <s>bahu</s> (many) — this is the governing rule (<s>adhikāra</s>) extending up to [the section on] directional words.
[Sūtra:] '<s>pañcamyās tasil</s>' (VLk 1202 = P 5.3.7)
After words in the ablative case from the <s>kim</s>-group onward, <s>tasil</s> optionally applies.
[Sūtra:] '<s>ku tihoḥ</s>' (VLk 1203 = P 7.2.104)

body.text: kimaḥ kuḥ syāttādau hādau ca vibhaktau parataḥ / kutaḥ, kasmāt //
body.translated_text: For <s>kim</s>, the replacement <s>ku</s> occurs before [affixes beginning with] <s>t</s> and <s>h</s>. [Examples:] <s>kutaḥ</s> (whence?), <s>kasmāt</s> (from what?).
[Sūtra:] '<s>idama iś</s>' (VLk 1204 = P 5.3.2)
Before a <s>prāgdiśīya</s> [suffix]. [Example:] <s>itaḥ</s> (from here).

body.text: etadaḥ prāgdiśīye / anekāltvātsarvādeśaḥ / ataḥ / amutaḥ / yataḥ / tataḥ / bahutaḥ / dvyādestu dvābhyām //
body.translated_text: Of <s>etad</s>, before a <s>prāgdiśīya</s> [suffix]. Being multi-syllabic, [it is] a complete replacement (<s>sarvādeśa</s>). [Examples:] <s>ataḥ</s> (from that). <s>amutaḥ</s> (from there). <s>yataḥ</s> (from where). <s>tataḥ</s> (from there/therefore). <s>bahutaḥ</s> (from many). But for <s>dvi</s> etc. — <s>dvābhyām</s> (from two) [regular ablative is used].
[Sūtra:] '<s>pary-abhibhyāṃ ca</s>' (VLk 1206 = P 5.3.9)

body.text: ābhyāṃ tasil syāt / paritaḥ / sarvata ityarthaḥ / abhitaḥ / ubhayata ityarthaḥ //
body.translated_text: After these two [prefixes], <s>tasil</s> applies. [Examples:] <s>paritaḥ</s> (all around) — meaning 'from all sides.' <s>abhitaḥ</s> (on both sides) — meaning 'from both sides.'
[Sūtra:] '<s>saptamyās tral</s>' (VLk 1207 = P 5.3.10)
[Examples:] <s>kutra</s> (where?). <s>yatra</s> (where). <s>tatra</s> (there). <s>bahutra</s> (in many places).
[Sūtra:] '<s>idamo haḥ</s>' (VLk 1208 = P 5.3.11)
This is an exception to <s>tral</s>. [Example:] <s>iha</s> (here).
[Sūtra:] '<s>kimo 't</s>' (VLk 1209 = P 5.3.12)
The word '<s>vā</s>' (optionally) is carried forward [from a prior rule]. After <s>kim</s> in the locative, <s>at</s> optionally occurs; alternatively, <s>tral</s> [applies].
[Sūtra:] '<s>kvāti</s>' (VLk 1210 = P 7.2.105)
For <s>kim</s>, the replacement <s>kva</s> occurs before <s>at</s>. [Examples:] <s>kva</s> (where?). <s>kutra</s> (where?).
[Sūtra:] '<s>itarābhyo 'pi dṛśyante</s>' (VLk 1211 = P 5.3.14)

body.text: pañcamīsaptamītaravibhaktyantādapi tasilādayo dṛśyante / dṛśigrahaṇādbhavadādiyoga eva / sa bhavān / tato bhavān / tatra bhavān / tambhavantam / tato bhavantam / tatra bhavantam / evaṃ dīrghāyuḥ, devānāmpriyaḥ, āyuṣmān //
body.translated_text: After words in other cases (beyond ablative and locative), <s>tasil</s> and the others are also seen. By the word '<s>dṛśi</s>' (are seen), [this applies] only in conjunction with <s>bhavat</s> and the like. [Examples:] <s>sa bhavān</s> (that honored one). <s>tato bhavān</s> (the honored one from there). <s>tatra bhavān</s> (the honored one there). <s>tambhavantam</s> (accusative). <s>tato bhavantam</s>. <s>tatra bhavantam</s>. Similarly <s>dīrghāyuḥ</s> (long-lived), <s>devānāmpriyaḥ</s> (dear to the gods), <s>āyuṣmān</s> (long-lived).
[Sūtra:] '<s>sarva-eka-anya-kiṃ-yat-tadaḥ kāle dā</s>' (VLk 1212 = P 5.3.15)
After these words in the locative, when meaning time — the suffix <s>dā</s> applies in their own sense.
[Sūtra:] '<s>sarvasya so 'nyatarasyāṃ di</s>' (VLk 1213 = P 5.3.6)

body.text: dādau prāgdiśīye sarvasya so vā syāt / sarvasmin kāle sadā sarvadā / anyadā / kadā / yadā / tadā / kāle kim ? sarvatra deśe //
body.translated_text: Before a <s>prāgdiśīya</s> suffix beginning with <s>d</s>, <s>sarva</s> optionally takes [the substitute] <s>sa</s>. [Examples:] <s>sarvasmin kāle</s> (at all times) — <s>sadā</s>, <s>sarvadā</s> (always). <s>anyadā</s> (at another time). <s>kadā</s> (when?). <s>yadā</s> (when). <s>tadā</s> (then). Why 'time'? [Counter-example:] <s>sarvatra deśe</s> (in every place [<s>dā</s> does not apply]).
[Sūtra:] '<s>idamo rhil</s>' (VLk 1214 = P 5.3.16)
After <s>idam</s> in the locative — only in [the sense of] time.
[Sūtra:] '<s>etetau rathoḥ</s>' (VLk 1215 = P 5.3.4)

body.text: idamśabdasya eta it ityādeśau stau rephādau thakārādau ca prāgdiśīye pare/ asmin kāle etarhi/ kāle kim? iha deśe //
body.translated_text: For the word <s>idam</s>, the replacements <s>eta</s> and <s>it</s> occur before a <s>prāgdiśīya</s> suffix beginning with <s>r</s> or <s>th</s>. [Example:] <s>asmin kāle etarhi</s> (at this time / now). Why 'time'? [Counter-example:] <s>iha deśe</s> (in this place [<s>rhil</s> does not apply]).
[Sūtra:] '<s>anadyatane rhil anyatarasyām</s>' (VLk 1216 = P 5.3.21)

body.text: karhi, kadā / yarhi, yadā / tarhi, tadā //
body.translated_text: [Examples:] <s>karhi</s>, <s>kadā</s> (when?). <s>yarhi</s>, <s>yadā</s> (when). <s>tarhi</s>, <s>tadā</s> (then).
[Sūtra:] '<s>etadaḥ</s>' (VLk 1217 = P 5.3.5)

body.text: eta it etau stau rephādau thādau ca prāgdiśīye / etasmin kāle etarhi //
body.translated_text: For <s>etad</s>, [the replacements] <s>eta</s> and <s>it</s> occur before a <s>prāgdiśīya</s> suffix beginning with <s>r</s> or <s>th</s>. [Example:] <s>etasmin kāle etarhi</s> (at that time / then).
[Sūtra:] '<s>prakāra-vacane thāl</s>' (VLk 1218 = P 5.3.23)

body.text: prakāravṛttibhyaḥ kimādibhyasthāl syāt svārthe / tena prakāreṇa tathā / yathā //
body.translated_text: After words from the <s>kim</s>-group denoting manner — <s>thāl</s> applies in their own sense. [Examples:] <s>tena prakāreṇa</s> → <s>tathā</s> (thus/in that way). <s>yathā</s> (in which way / as).
[Sūtra:] '<s>idamas thamuḥ</s>' (VLk 1219 = P 5.3.24)

children.text: ḥ) / anena etena vā prakāreṇa ittham //

body.translated_text: This is an exception to <s>thāl</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>kimaś ca</s>' (VLk 1220 = P 5.3.25)
[Example:] <s>kena prakāreṇa</s> → <s>katham</s> (how?).
Thus [end] the <s>prāgdiśīya</s> [suffixes]. (Section 14)
Now [begin] the <s>prāgivīya</s> [suffixes].
[Sūtra:] '<s>atiśāyane tamab-iṣṭhanau</s>' (VLk 1221 = P 5.3.55)

body.text: atiśayaviśiṣṭārthavṛtteḥ svārtha etau staḥ / ayameṣāmatiśayenāḍhyaḥ āḍhyatamaḥ / laghutamaḥ, laghiṣṭhaḥ //
body.translated_text: These two [<s>tamap</s> and <s>iṣṭhan</s>] apply in the sense of superlative degree, denoting the meaning of 'exceedingly characterized.' [Examples:] <s>ayam eṣām atiśayena āḍhyaḥ</s> (this one is the richest among them) → <s>āḍhyatamaḥ</s> (richest). <s>laghutamaḥ</s> (lightest), <s>laghiṣṭhaḥ</s> (lightest).
[Sūtra:] '<s>tiṅaś ca</s>' (VLk 1222 = P 5.3.56)
After a finite verb (<s>tiṅanta</s>), when the superlative [sense] is being expressed, <s>tamap</s> applies.
[Sūtra:] '<s>tarap-tamapau ghaḥ</s>' (VLk 1223 = P 1.1.22)
These two [<s>tarap</s> and <s>tamap</s>] receive the designation <s>gha</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>kim-et-tiṅ-avyaya-ghād āmuḥ vā dravya-prakarṣe</s>' (VLk 1224 = P 5.4.11)

body.text: kima edantāttiṅo'vyayācca yo ghastadantādāmuḥ syānna tu dravyaprakarṣe / kintamām / prāhṇetamām / pacatimām / uccaistamām / dravyaprakarṣe tu uccaistamastaruḥ //
body.translated_text: After <s>kim</s>, after an <s>e</s>-ending word, after a finite verb, after an indeclinable, and after a word ending in <s>gha</s> — <s>āmu</s> suffix [is optionally added], but not in the sense of excellence of a substance. [Examples:] <s>kintamām</s> (the most 'what-like'). <s>prāhṇetamām</s> (the most forenoon-like). <s>pacatitamām</s> (the most cooking). <s>uccaistamām</s> (the most loudly). But in substance-excellence: <s>uccaistamastaruḥ</s> (the tallest tree).
[Sūtra:] '<s>dvi-vacana-vibhajyopapade tarab-īyasunau</s>' (VLk 1225 = P 5.3.57)

body.text: dvayorekasyātiśaye vibhaktavye copapade suptiṅantādetau staḥ / pūrvayorapavādaḥ / ayamanayoratiśayena laghuḥ laghutaro laghīyān / udīcyāḥ prācyebhyaḥ paṭutarāḥ paṭīyāṃsaḥ //
body.translated_text: When the superlative is [applied] to one out of two, and when a distributive upapada is present — after a <s>sup</s>-ending or <s>tiṅ</s>-ending [word], these two [<s>tarap</s> and <s>īyasun</s>] apply. This is an exception to the previous [superlative suffixes]. [Examples:] <s>ayam anayoḥ atiśayena laghuḥ</s> (this one is lighter of the two) → <s>laghutaraḥ</s>, <s>laghīyān</s> (lighter). <s>udīcyāḥ prācyebhyaḥ paṭutarāḥ paṭīyāṃsaḥ</s> (the northerners are sharper than the easterners).
[Sūtra:] '<s>praśasyasya śraḥ</s>' (VLk 1226 = P 5.3.60)
[The word] <s>praśasya</s> (praiseworthy) is replaced by <s>śra</s> before [suffixes beginning with] a vowel or <s>y</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>prakṛty aikāc</s>' (VLk 1227 = P 6.4.163)
Before <s>iṣṭha</s> and other [suffixes], the monosyllabic [substitute] remains in its original form. [Examples:] <s>śreṣṭhaḥ</s> (best). <s>śreyān</s> (better).
[Sūtra:] '<s>jya ca</s>' (VLk 1228 = P 5.3.61)
[The word] <s>praśasya</s> is [also] replaced by <s>jya</s> before <s>iṣṭha</s> and <s>iyasu</s>. [Example:] <s>jyeṣṭhaḥ</s> (eldest/best).
[Sūtra:] '<s>jyād ādīyasaḥ</s>' (VLk 1229 = P 6.4.160)
[Lengthening] of the initial [vowel] of the following [suffix <s>iyasun</s>]. [Example:] <s>jyāyān</s> (elder/superior).

body.text: bahorlopo bhū ca bahoḥ // VLk_1230 = P_6,4.158 //
body.translated_text: [Sūtra:] '<s>bahor lopo bhū ca bahoḥ</s>' (VLk 1230 = P 6.4.158)

body.text: bahoḥ parayorimeyasorlopaḥ syādbahośca bhūrādeśaḥ / bhūmā / bhūyān //
body.translated_text: Before <s>ima</s> and <s>iyasu</s> following <s>bahu</s> (many), there is deletion [of <s>bahu</s>], and <s>bahu</s> is replaced by <s>bhū</s>. [Examples:] <s>bhūmā</s> (abundance). <s>bhūyān</s> (more numerous).
[Sūtra:] '<s>iṣṭhasya yiṭ ca</s>' (VLk 1231 = P 6.4.159)

body.text: bahoḥ parasya iṣṭhasya lopaḥ syād yiḍāgamaśca / bhūyiṣṭhaḥ //
body.translated_text: Before <s>iṣṭha</s> following <s>bahu</s>, there is deletion [of <s>bahu</s>] and the augment <s>yiṭ</s> is [added]. [Example:] <s>bhūyiṣṭhaḥ</s> (most abundant).
[Sūtra:] '<s>vin-mator luk</s>' (VLk 1232 = P 5.3.65)

body.text: vino matupaśca luk syādiṣṭheyasoḥ / atiśayena sragvī srajiṣṭhaḥ / srajīyān / atiśayena tvagvān tvaciṣṭhaḥ / tvacīyān //
body.translated_text: The suffixes <s>vin</s> and <s>matup</s> undergo <s>luk</s> (deletion) before <s>iṣṭha</s> and <s>iyasun</s>. [Examples:] <s>atiśayena sragvī</s> (one who is most garlanded) → <s>srajiṣṭhaḥ</s> (most garlanded). <s>srajīyān</s> (more garlanded). <s>atiśayena tvagvān</s> (one with the most bark) → <s>tvaciṣṭhaḥ</s>. <s>tvacīyān</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>īṣad-asamāptau kalpa-b-deśya-deśīya-raḥ</s>' (VLk 1233 = P 5.3.67)

body.text: īṣadūno vidvān vidvatkalpaḥ / vidvaddeśyaḥ / vidvaddeśīyaḥ / pacatikalpam //
body.translated_text: [In the sense of] 'slightly less' or 'almost' — [Examples:] <s>īṣadūno vidvān</s> (slightly less than a learned person) → <s>vidvatkalpaḥ</s> (almost learned). <s>vidvaddeśyaḥ</s>. <s>vidvaddeśīyaḥ</s>. <s>pacatikalpam</s> (almost cooking).

body.text: vibhāṣā supo bahuc purastāttu // VLk_1234 = P_5,3.68 //
body.translated_text: [Sūtra:] '<s>vibhāṣā supo bahuc purastāt tu</s>' (VLk 1234 = P 5.3.68)

body.text: īṣadasamāptiviśiṣṭer'the subantādbahujvā syātsa ca prāgeva na tu parataḥ / īṣadūnaḥ paṭurbahupaṭuḥ / paṭukalpaḥ / supaḥ kim ? jayati kalpam //
body.translated_text: In the sense of 'slightly less,' characterized by incompleteness — after a <s>sup</s>-ending (nominal) word, <s>bahu</s>-[suffix] optionally [applies], and it [goes] before [the main word], not after. [Examples:] <s>īṣadūnaḥ paṭuḥ</s> (slightly less than sharp) → <s>bahupaṭuḥ</s> (almost sharp). <s>paṭukalpaḥ</s>. Why 'from a <s>sup</s>'? [Counter-example:] <s>jayati kalpam</s> (he almost wins [<s>bahu</s> doesn't apply to verbs]).
[Sūtra:] '<s>prag ivāt kaḥ</s>' (VLk 1235 = P 5.3.70)
From [the sūtra] '<s>ive pratikṛtau</s>' (in the sense of imitation) up to this point — <s>ka</s> is the governing rule (<s>adhikāra</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>avyaya-sarvanāmnām akac prāk ṭeḥ</s>' (VLk 1236 = P 5.3.71)
This is an exception to <s>ka</s>. [The rule] '<s>tiṅaś ca</s>' continues [to apply here].
[Sūtra:] '<s>ajñāte</s>' (VLk 1237 = P 5.3.73)

children.text: okārasakārabhakārādau supi sarvanāmnaṣṭeḥ prāgakac, anyatra subantasya
children.translated_text: (<s>Vārttika</s>:) 'Before a <s>sup</s> ending beginning with <s>o</s>, <s>s</s>, or <s>bh</s> — before the <s>ṭi</s> portion of the <s>sarvanāman</s>, <s>akac</s> [applies]; elsewhere [it applies] to the full <s>sup</s>-ending word.'
[Examples:] <s>yuṣmakābhiḥ</s> (by you all [uncertain form]). <s>yuvakayoḥ</s> (of you two). <s>tvayakā</s> (by you).

body.translated_text: [In the sense of 'unknown' —] [Examples:] <s>kasyāyam aśvaḥ</s> (whose is this horse?) → <s>aśvakaḥ</s>. <s>uccakaiḥ</s> (somewhat high). <s>nīcakaiḥ</s> (somewhat low). <s>sarvake</s> (all-ish).
[Sūtra:] '<s>kutsite</s>' (VLk 1238 = P 5.3.74)
[In the sense of contempt —] [Example:] <s>kutsito 'śvaḥ</s> (a contemptible horse) → <s>aśvakaḥ</s>.

body.text: kiṃyattado nirdhāraṇe dvayorekasya ḍatarac // VLk_1239 = P_5,3.92 //
body.translated_text: [Sūtra:] '<s>kiṃ-yat-tadaḥ nirdhāraṇe dvayoḥ ekasya ḍatarac</s>' (VLk 1239 = P 5.3.92)

[In the sense of determining one out of two —] [Examples:] <s>anayoḥ kataro vaiṣṇavaḥ</s> (which of these two is the <s>Vaiṣṇava</s>?). <s>yataraḥ</s> (whichever of two). <s>tataraḥ</s> (that one of two).

body.text: vā bahūnāṃ jātiparipraśne ḍatamac // VLk_1240 = P_5,3.93 //
body.translated_text: [Sūtra:] '<s>vā bahūnāṃ jāti-paripraśne ḍatamac</s>' (VLk 1240 = P 5.3.93)

body.text: jātiparipraśna iti pratyākhyātamākare / bahūnāṃ madhye ekasya nirdhāraṇe ḍatamajvā syāt / katamo bhavatāṃ kaṭhaḥ / yatamaḥ / tatamaḥ / vāgrahaṇamakajartham / yakaḥ / sakaḥ //
body.translated_text: '<s>Jāti-paripraśna</s>' is rejected in the <s>Ākara</s> [i.e. it doesn't have a separate application]. In the sense of determining one among many, <s>ḍatamac</s> optionally applies. [Examples:] <s>katamo bhavatāṃ kaṭhaḥ</s> (which of you gentlemen is the <s>Kaṭha</s> adherent?). <s>yatamaḥ</s> (whichever among many). <s>tatamaḥ</s> (that one among many). The word '<s>vā</s>' is for the purpose of <s>akac</s> [as alternative]. [Examples:] <s>yakaḥ</s>. <s>sakaḥ</s>.
Thus [end] the <s>prāgivīya</s> [suffixes]. (Section 15)
Now [begin] the <s>svārthika</s> (self-meaning) [suffixes].
[Sūtra:] '<s>ive pratikṛtau</s>' (VLk 1241 = P 5.3.96)

children.translated_text: (<s>Vārttika</s>:) 'After all stems, <s>kan</s> [applies] in one's own sense.'
[Example:] <s>aśvakaḥ</s> (= <s>aśva</s>, a horse [with no change in meaning]).

body.translated_text: <s>Kan</s> [suffix] applies [in the sense of imitation]. [Example:] <s>aśva iva pratikṛtiḥ</s> (an imitation of a horse) → <s>aśvakaḥ</s> (a toy horse).
[Sūtra:] '<s>tat-prakṛta-vacane mayaṭ</s>' (VLk 1242 = P 5.4.21)

body.text: prācuryeṇa prastutaṃ prakṛtam, tasya vacanaṃ pratipādanam / bhāve adhikaraṇe vā lyuṭ / ādye prakṛtamannamannamayam / apūpamayam / dvitīye tu annamayo yajñaḥ / apūpamayaṃ parva //
body.translated_text: That which is predominantly prepared/constituted is <s>prakṛta</s>; its expression/description is <s>vacana</s>. [The suffix <s>lyuṭ</s> is in the sense of] action or location. In the first [sense]: 'food is constituted of food' — <s>annamayam</s> (made of food). <s>apūpamayam</s> (made of cakes). In the second: <s>annamayo yajñaḥ</s> (a sacrifice consisting of food [i.e. where food predominates]). <s>apūpamayaṃ parva</s> (a festival full of cakes).
[Sūtra:] '<s>prajñādibhyaś ca</s>' (VLk 1243 = P 5.4.38)

body.text: aṇ syāt / prajña eva prājñaḥ / prājñī strī / daivataḥ / bāndhavaḥ //
body.translated_text: <s>Aṇ</s> [suffix] applies. [Examples:] <s>prajña eva</s> → <s>prājñaḥ</s> (wise). <s>prājñī</s> (wise woman). <s>daivataḥ</s> (divine). <s>bāndhavaḥ</s> (kinsman).
[Sūtra:] '<s>bahv-alpārthāc chaḥ-kārakād anyatarasyām</s>' (VLk 1244 = P 5.4.42)

children.translated_text: (<s>Vārttika</s>:) 'After <s>ādi</s> and the others, <s>tasi</s> [suffix] should be additionally enumerated.'

children.text: ) / ādau āditaḥ / madhyataḥ / antataḥ / pṛṣṭhataḥ / pārśvataḥ / ākṛtigaṇo 'yam / svareṇa, svarataḥ / varṇataḥ //
children.translated_text: [Examples:] <s>ādau</s> → <s>āditaḥ</s> (from the beginning). <s>madhyataḥ</s> (from the middle). <s>antataḥ</s> (from the end). <s>pṛṣṭhataḥ</s> (from behind). <s>pārśvataḥ</s> (from the side). This is an <s>ākṛtigaṇa</s> (open-ended class). [Also:] <s>svareṇa</s> → <s>svarataḥ</s> (by tone). <s>varṇataḥ</s> (by syllable).

body.translated_text: [Example:] <s>bahūni dadāti</s> (he gives many) → <s>bahuśaḥ</s> (in many ways / manifoldly). <s>alpaśaḥ</s> (in small amounts).
[Sūtra:] '<s>kṛ-bhv-asti-yoge saṃpadya-kartari cviḥ</s>' (VLk 1245 = P 5.4.50)

children.translated_text: (<s>Vārttika</s>:) 'The sense should be stated as: becoming what it was not before (<s>abhūta-tadbhāva</s>).'

children.text: )/ vikārātmatāṃ prāpnuvatyāṃ prakṛtau vartamānādvikāraśabdāt svārthe cvirvā syātkarotyādibhiryoge//
children.translated_text: When [an entity] attains the nature of a modification — from the word denoting the modification that applies to the original substance — <s>cvi</s> [suffix] optionally applies in its own sense, in conjunction with <s>karoti</s> (does), etc.

body.translated_text: [Sūtra:] '<s>asya cvau</s>' (VLk 1246 = P 7.3.32)

body.text: avarṇasya ītsyāt cvau / verlope cvyantatvādavyayatvam / akṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ saṃpadyate taṃ karoti kṛṣṇīkaroti / brahmībhavati / gaṅgīsyāt /

children.translated_text: (<s>Vārttika</s>:) 'The <s>ī</s>-replacement of an indeclinable before <s>cvi</s> should be stated as not [applying].'
[Examples:] <s>doṣābhūtam ahaḥ</s> (the day has become like night [= flawed]). <s>divābhūtā rātriḥ</s> (the night has become like day [= bright]).

body.translated_text: The <s>a</s>-vowel [of the stem] becomes <s>ī</s> before <s>cvi</s>. By deletion of <s>v</s>; because [the result] ends in <s>cvi</s>, [it is] indeclinable. [Examples:] <s>akṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ saṃpadyate taṃ karoti</s> (what was not black becomes/is made black) → <s>kṛṣṇīkaroti</s> (he makes [it] black). <s>brahmībhavati</s> (he becomes <s>Brahman</s>). <s>gaṅgīsyāt</s> (may it become [like] the <s>Gaṅgā</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>vibhāṣā sāti kārtsñye</s>' (VLk 1247 = P 5.4.52)
In the domain of <s>cvi</s>, <s>sāt</s> [suffix] optionally applies in the sense of totality/completeness.
[Sūtra:] '<s>sāt-padādyoḥ</s>' (VLk 1248 = P 8.3.111)

body.text: sasya ṣatvaṃ na syāt / kṛtsnaṃ śastramagniḥ saṃpadyate 'gnisādbhavati / dadhi siñcati //
body.translated_text: Retroflexion (<s>ṣatva</s>) of [the initial] <s>s</s> does not apply [here]. [Example:] <s>kṛtsnaṃ śastram agniḥ saṃpadyate</s> (the entire weapon becomes fire) → <s>agnisād bhavati</s> (it becomes completely fire). [Example of non-application:] <s>dadhi siñcati</s> (he sprinkles curd [<s>ṣatva</s> doesn't apply]).
[Sūtra:] '<s>cvau ca</s>' (VLk 1249 = P 7.4.26)

body.text: cvau pare pūrvasya dīrghaḥ syāt / agnībhavati //
body.translated_text: Before <s>cvi</s>, the preceding [vowel] is lengthened. [Example:] <s>agnībhavati</s> (it becomes fire).
[Sūtra:] '<s>avyaktānukaraṇād dvy-aj-avarārdhād anitau ḍāc</s>' (VLk 1250 = P 5.4.57)

body.text: dvyajevāvaraṃ nyūnaṃ na tu tato nyūnamanekājiti yāvat / tādṛśamardhaṃ yasya tasmāḍḍāc syāt kṛbhvastibhiryoge

children.translated_text: (<s>Vārttika</s>:) 'It should be stated that in a reduplicated [form] followed by <s>ḍāc</s>, obligatorily [the rule applies].'

children.text: ) / ḍācparaṃ yadāmreḍitaṃ tasminpare pūrvaparayorvarṇayoḥ pararūpaṃ syāt / iti takārapakārayoḥ pakāraḥ / paṭapaṭākaroti / avyaktānukaraṇātkim ? īṣatkaroti / dvyajavarārdhātkim ? śratkaroti / avareti kim ? kharaṭakharaṭākaroti / anitau kim ? paṭiti karoti //
children.translated_text: When a <s>ḍāc</s>-final reduplicated [form] follows — of the prior and latter phonemes, the latter form (<s>pararūpa</s>) prevails. Thus, of <s>t</s> and <s>p</s> — <s>p</s> [prevails]. [Example:] <s>paṭapaṭākaroti</s> (he makes a pattering sound). Why 'from an onomatopoeia'? [Counter-example:] <s>īṣat karoti</s> (he does slightly [no <s>ḍāc</s>]). Why 'having two vowels or more'? [Counter-example:] <s>śrat karoti</s> (he has faith [no <s>ḍāc</s>]). Why 'less' [= minimum]? [Counter-example:] <s>kharaṭakharaṭākaroti</s> (he makes a scraping sound [more than two vowels per half, so <s>ḍāc</s> doesn't apply]). Why 'not ending in <s>it</s>'? [Counter-example:] <s>paṭiti karoti</s> (he makes a 'paṭ' sound [with <s>iti</s>, so no <s>ḍāc</s>]).

body.translated_text: Having at least two vowels (<s>dvyac</s>) — 'less' means not fewer [i.e. two or more vowels]; half of that [word] — from such an onomatopoeic expression [whose half contains two vowels], <s>ḍāc</s> [suffix] applies in conjunction with <s>kṛ</s>, <s>bhū</s>, and <s>as</s>.
Thus [end] the <s>svārthika</s> (self-meaning) [suffixes]. (Section 16)
Thus [end] the <s>taddhita</s> [suffixes].
Now [begin] the feminine suffixes (<s>strīpratyaya</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>striyām</s>' (VLk 1251 = P 4.1.3)
This is a governing rule (<s>adhikāra</s>). [It means:] 'of those [stems] that are capable [of denoting feminine gender].'
[Sūtra:] '<s>ajādy-ataṣ ṭāp</s>' (VLk 1252 = P 4.1.4)

body.text: ajādīnāmakārāntasya ca vācyaṃ yat strītvaṃ tatra dyotye ṭāp syāt / ajā / eḍakā / aśvā / caṭakā / mūṣikā / bālā / vatsā / hoḍā / mandā / vilātā / ityādi // medhā / gaṅgā / sarvā //
body.translated_text: For an <s>a</s>-ending [stem] among the <s>ajādi</s> (vowel-initial) class, when femininity is to be indicated, <s>ṭāp</s> is added. [Examples:] <s>ajā</s> (she-goat). <s>eḍakā</s> (ewe). <s>aśvā</s> (mare). <s>caṭakā</s> (female sparrow). <s>mūṣikā</s> (female mouse). <s>bālā</s> (girl). <s>vatsā</s> (female calf). <s>hoḍā</s>. <s>mandā</s>. <s>vilātā</s>, and so forth. <s>medhā</s> (intelligence). <s>Gaṅgā</s>. <s>sarvā</s> (all, feminine).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ugitaś ca</s>' (VLk 1253 = P 4.1.6)

body.text: ugidantātprātipadikātstriyāṃ ṅīpsyāt / bhavatī / bhavantī / pacantī / dīvyantī //
body.translated_text: After a <s>prātipadika</s> (nominal stem) marked with <s>u</s> as <s>it</s> (indicatory), <s>ṅīp</s> is added in the feminine. [Examples:] <s>bhavatī</s> (your honor, feminine). <s>bhavantī</s> (the present, feminine). <s>pacantī</s> (she who cooks). <s>dīvyantī</s> (she who plays).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṭiḍḍhāṇañ-dvayasaj-daghnañ-mātra-ctayap-ṭhak-ṭhañ-kañ-kvarap-aḥ</s>' (VLk 1254 = P 4.1.15)

body.text: anupasardanaṃ yaṭṭidādi tadantaṃ yadadantaṃ prātipadikaṃ tataḥ striyāṃ ṅīpsyāt / kurucarī / nadaṭ nadī / devaṭ devī / sauparṇeyī / aindrī / autsī / ūrudvayasī / ūrudaghnī / ūrumātrī / pañcatayī / ākṣikī / lāvaṇikī / yādṛśī / itvarī / (

children.translated_text: (<s>Vārttika</s>:) 'The additional listing of <s>nañ</s>, <s>snañ</s>, <s>īkak</s>, <s>khyuṃs</s>, <s>taruṇa</s>, and <s>taluna</s> should be stated.'

children.text: ) / straiṇī / paiṃsnī / śāktīkī / yāṣṭīkī / āḍhyaṅkaraṇī / taruṇī / talunī //
children.translated_text: [Examples:] <s>straiṇī</s> (relating to women). <s>paiṃsnī</s> (relating to men). <s>śāktīkī</s> (relating to a spear). <s>yāṣṭīkī</s> (relating to a staff). <s>āḍhyaṅkaraṇī</s>. <s>taruṇī</s> (young woman). <s>talunī</s>.

body.translated_text: After a <s>prātipadika</s> that is not a subordinate member (<s>upasarjana</s>) and that ends in <s>a</s>, having [any of the affixes] <s>ṭiṭ</s> and the others [listed] as its final element — <s>ṅīp</s> is added in the feminine. [Examples:] <s>kurucarī</s> (she who moves among the <s>Kurus</s>). <s>nadaṭ</s> — <s>nadī</s> (river). <s>devaṭ</s> — <s>devī</s> (goddess). <s>sauparṇeyī</s> (descendant of <s>Suparṇā</s>). <s>aindrī</s> (relating to <s>Indra</s>). <s>autsī</s>. <s>ūrudvayasī</s> (having thighs of [a certain] length). <s>ūrudaghnī</s> (reaching up to the thighs). <s>ūrumātrī</s> (of thigh-measure). <s>pañcatayī</s> (fivefold). <s>ākṣikī</s> (relating to the eyes). <s>lāvaṇikī</s> (relating to salt). <s>yādṛśī</s> (of which kind). <s>itvarī</s> (transient).
[Sūtra:] '<s>yañaś ca</s>' (VLk 1255 = P 4.1.16)
After [a stem ending in] <s>yañ</s>, <s>ṅīp</s> is added in the feminine. When deletion of <s>a</s> has been performed —
[Sūtra:] '<s>halas taddhitasya</s>' (VLk 1256 = P 6.1.150)

body.text: halaḥ parasya taddhitayakārasyopadhābhūtasya sopa īti pare / gārgī //
body.translated_text: The <s>y</s> of a <s>taddhita</s> affix following a consonant, being in the penultimate position, takes <s>lopa</s> (deletion) when <s>ī</s> follows. [Example:] <s>Gārgī</s> (feminine of <s>Gārgya</s>).
[Sūtra:] '<s>prācāṃ ṣpha taddhitaḥ</s>' (VLk 1257 = P 4.1.17)

body.text: yañantāt ṣpho vā syātsa ca taddhitaḥ //
body.translated_text: After [a stem ending in] <s>yañ</s>, <s>ṣpha</s> is optionally added, and it too is a <s>taddhita</s> [affix].
[Sūtra:] '<s>ṣid gaurādibhyaś ca</s>' (VLk 1258 = P 4.1.41)

body.text: ṣidbhyo gaurādibhyaśca striyāṃ ṅīṣ syāt / gārgyāyaṇī / nartakī / gaurī / anuḍuhī / anaḍvāhī / ākṛtigaṇo 'yam //
body.translated_text: After <s>ṣit</s> [affixes] and after the <s>gaurādi</s> class, <s>ṅīṣ</s> is added in the feminine. [Examples:] <s>Gārgyāyaṇī</s> (female descendant of <s>Gārgya</s>). <s>nartakī</s> (female dancer). <s>gaurī</s> (fair-complexioned woman / <s>Gaurī</s>). <s>anuḍuhī</s> (feminine of a bull). <s>anaḍvāhī</s> (feminine of a bull). This is an <s>ākṛtigaṇa</s> (open-ended class).
[Sūtra:] '<s>vayasi prathame</s>' (VLk 1259 = P 4.1.20)
After an <s>a</s>-ending [stem] denoting one in the first age (youth), <s>ṅīp</s> is added in the feminine. [Example:] <s>kumārī</s> (maiden).
[Sūtra:] '<s>dvigoḥ</s>' (VLk 1260 = P 4.1.41)

body.text: adantād dvigorṅīpsyāt / trilokī / ajāditvāttriphalā / tryanīkā senā //
body.translated_text: After an <s>a</s>-ending <s>dvigu</s> [compound], <s>ṅīp</s> is added. [Example:] <s>trilokī</s> (the three worlds). Because of being <s>ajādi</s> — <s>triphalā</s> (the three fruits / <s>triphalā</s>). <s>tryanīkā senā</s> (a three-division army).
[Sūtra:] '<s>varṇād anudāttāt topadhāt to naḥ</s>' (VLk 1261 = P 4.1.39)

body.text: varṇavācī yo 'nudāttāntastopadhastadantādanupasarjanātprātipadikādvā ṅīp takārasya nakārādeśaśca / enī, etā / rohiṇī, rohitā //
body.translated_text: After an <s>anudātta</s>-final [stem] denoting a color, having <s>t</s> as penultimate — from the <s>prātipadika</s> that is not a subordinate member, <s>ṅīp</s> is optionally added, and the <s>t</s> is replaced by <s>n</s>. [Examples:] <s>enī</s> or <s>etā</s> (a black doe). <s>rohiṇī</s> or <s>rohitā</s> (a red one).
[Sūtra:] '<s>voto guṇavacanāt</s>' (VLk 1262 = P 4.1.44)

body.text: udantād guṇavācino vā ṅīṣ syāt / mṛdvī, mṛduḥ //
body.translated_text: After a <s>u</s>-ending [stem] denoting a quality, <s>ṅīṣ</s> is optionally added. [Examples:] <s>mṛdvī</s> or <s>mṛduḥ</s> (soft, feminine).
[Sūtra:] '<s>bahvādibhyaś ca</s>' (VLk 1263 = P 4.1.45)

body.text: ebhyo vā ṅīṣ syāt / bahvī, bahuḥ / (

children.translated_text: (<s>Vārttika</s>:) 'According to some, [<s>ṅīṣ</s> is added] from all [stems] except those meaning <s>aktin</s> [and <s>nartha</s>].'

body.translated_text: From these [<s>bahu</s> etc.], <s>ṅīṣ</s> is optionally added. [Examples:] <s>bahvī</s> or <s>bahuḥ</s> (much, feminine).
[Sūtra:] '<s>puṃyogād ākhyāyām</s>' (VLk 1264 = P 4.1.48)

body.text: yā pumākhyā puṃyogāt striyāṃ vartate tato ṅīṣ / gopasya strī gopī / (
body.translated_text: A name (<s>ākhyā</s>) that is applied to a woman because of association with a man (<s>puṃyoga</s>) takes <s>ṅīṣ</s>. [Example:] <s>gopasya strī</s> — <s>gopī</s> (wife of a cowherd / female cowherd).
[Sūtra:] '<s>pratyayasthāt kāt pūrvasyāta idāpy asupaḥ</s>' (VLk 1265 = P 7.3.44)

body.text: pratyayasthātkātpūrvasyākārasyekāraḥ syādāpi sa āpsupaḥ paro na cet / gopālikā / aśvapālikā / sarvikā / kārikā / ataḥ kim ? naukā / pratyayasthātkim ? śaknotīti śakā / asupaḥ kim ? bahuparivrājakā nagarī / (

children.translated_text: (<s>Vārttika</s>:) 'From <s>sūrya</s>, [<s>ṅīṣ</s> is not added] when a deity [is meant], and that should be stated.'

children.text: ḥ) / sūryasya strī devatā sūryā / devatāyāṃ kim ? (
children.translated_text: [Example:] <s>sūryasya strī devatā</s> — <s>sūryā</s> (the female aspect of the Sun deity). Why 'when a deity'?
<s>Ya</s>-deletion [applies]. [Example:] <s>sūrī</s> (wife of the Sun). <s>Kuntī</s>. This is a human female (<s>mānuṣīyam</s>).

body.translated_text: When <s>k</s> is in a suffix, the <s>a</s> preceding it is replaced by <s>i</s> before <s>āp</s>, provided [that which follows] is not a case-ending. [Examples:] <s>gopālikā</s> (female protectress). <s>aśvapālikā</s> (female horse-keeper). <s>sarvikā</s>. <s>kārikā</s>. Why 'from <s>a</s>'? [Counter-example:] <s>naukā</s> (boat). Why 'in a suffix'? [Counter-example:] <s>śaknoti iti śakā</s>. Why 'not before a case-ending'? [Counter-example:] <s>bahuparivrājakā nagarī</s> (a city with many wandering ascetics).
[Sūtra:] '<s>indra-varuṇa-bhava-śarva-rudra-mṛḍa-himāraṇya-yava-yavana-mātula-cāryāṇām ānuk</s>' (VLk 1266 = P 4.1.49)

body.text: eṣāmānugāgamaḥ syāt ṅīṣ ca / indrasya strī - indrāṇī / varuṇānī / bhavānī / śarvāṇī / rudrāṇī / mṛḍānī / (

children.translated_text: [Examples:] <s>mahad dhimaṃ</s> — <s>himānī</s> (a great mass of snow/ice). <s>mahad araṇyam</s> — <s>araṇyānī</s> (a great forest).
(<s>Vārttika</s>:) 'From <s>arya</s> and <s>kṣatriya</s>, optionally, in the same sense.'
[Examples:] <s>aryāṇī</s> or <s>aryā</s> (noble woman). <s>kṣatriyāṇī</s> or <s>kṣatriyā</s> (woman of the warrior class).

body.translated_text: For these [words], the <s>ānuk</s> augment is inserted and <s>ṅīṣ</s> [is added]. [Examples:] <s>indrasya strī</s> — <s>Indrāṇī</s> (wife of <s>Indra</s>). <s>Varuṇānī</s> (wife of <s>Varuṇa</s>). <s>Bhavānī</s> (wife of <s>Bhava</s>/<s>Śiva</s>). <s>Śarvāṇī</s>. <s>Rudrāṇī</s>. <s>Mṛḍānī</s>.
[Sūtra:] '<s>krītāt karaṇa-pūrvāt</s>' (VLk 1267 = P 4.1.50)

body.text: krītāntādadantāt karaṇādeḥ striyāṃ ṅīṣsyāt / vastrakrītī / kvacinna / dhanakrītā //
body.translated_text: After an <s>a</s>-ending [stem] ending in <s>krīta</s> (bought) with a word denoting the means [of purchase] as its prior member, <s>ṅīṣ</s> is added in the feminine. [Example:] <s>vastrakrītī</s> (a woman bought with cloth). Sometimes not — <s>dhanakrītā</s> (a woman bought with wealth).
[Sūtra:] '<s>svāṅgāc copasar-janād asaṃyogopadhāt</s>' (VLk 1268 = P 4.1.54)

body.text: asaṃyogopadhamupasarjanaṃ yat svāṅgaṃ tadantādadantān ṅīṣvā syāt / keśānatikrāntā - atikeśī, atikeśā / candramukhī candramukhā / asaṃyogopadhātkim ? sugulphā / upasarjanātkim ? śikhā //
body.translated_text: After an <s>a</s>-ending [stem] whose subordinate member is a body-part word without a conjunct as penultimate, <s>ṅīṣ</s> is optionally added in the feminine. [Examples:] <s>keśān atikrāntā</s> — <s>atikeśī</s> or <s>atikeśā</s> (one whose hair surpasses). <s>candramukhī</s> or <s>candramukhā</s> (moon-faced). Why 'without a conjunct as penultimate'? [Counter-example:] <s>sugulphā</s> (with beautiful ankles). Why 'subordinate member'? [Counter-example:] <s>śikhā</s> (crest).
[Sūtra:] '<s>na kroḍādi-bahvacaḥ</s>' (VLk 1269 = P 4.1.56)

body.text: kroḍāderbahvacaśca svāṅgānna ṅīṣ / kalyāṇakroḍā / ākṛtigaṇo 'yam / sujaghanā //
body.translated_text: From the <s>kroḍādi</s> class and from polysyllabic body-part words, <s>ṅīṣ</s> is not [added]. [Example:] <s>kalyāṇakroḍā</s> (one with a beautiful bosom). This is an <s>ākṛtigaṇa</s> (open-ended class). [Example:] <s>sujaghanā</s> (one with beautiful hips).
[Sūtra:] '<s>nakha-mukhāt saṃjñāyām</s>' (VLk 1270 = P 4.1.58)
<s>Ṅīṣ</s> is not [added] [in a proper name ending in <s>nakha</s> or <s>mukha</s>].
[Sūtra:] '<s>pūrvapadāt saṃjñāyām agaḥ</s>' (VLk 1271 = P 8.4.3)

body.text: pūrvapadasthānnimittātparasya nasya ṇaḥ syāt saṃjñāyāṃ na tu gakāravyavadhāne / śūrpaṇakhā / gauramukhā / saṃjñāyāṃ kim ? tāmramukhī kanyā //
body.translated_text: The <s>n</s> following a trigger in the prior member becomes <s>ṇ</s> in a proper name, but not when <s>g</s> intervenes. [Examples:] <s>Śūrpaṇakhā</s> (proper name). <s>Gauramukhā</s> (proper name). Why 'in a proper name'? [Counter-example:] <s>tāmramukhī kanyā</s> (a copper-faced girl).
[Sūtra:] '<s>jāter a-strī-viṣayād ayopadhāt</s>' (VLk 1272 = P 4.1.63)

body.text: jātivāci yanna ca striyāṃ niyatamayopadhaṃ tataḥ striyāṃ ṅīṣ syāt / taṭī / vṛṣalī / kaṭhī / bahvṛcī / jāteḥ kim ? muṇḍā / astrīviṣayātkim ? balākā / ayopadhātkim ? kṣatriyā / (

children.translated_text: (<s>Vārttika</s>:) 'In the prohibition of [stems with] <s>y</s> as penultimate, the non-prohibition of <s>haya</s>, <s>gavaya</s>, <s>mukaya</s>, <s>manuṣya</s>, and <s>matsya</s> [should be stated].'

children.text: ḥ) / hayī / gavayī / mukayī / halastaddhitasyeti yalopaḥ / manuṣī / (

body.translated_text: From a word denoting a class (<s>jāti</s>) that is not exclusively feminine and does not have <s>y</s> as its penultimate, <s>ṅīṣ</s> is added in the feminine. [Examples:] <s>taṭī</s> (female of a certain class). <s>vṛṣalī</s> (<s>Śūdra</s> woman). <s>kaṭhī</s> (female of the <s>Kaṭha</s> school). <s>bahvṛcī</s> (female of the <s>Bahvṛca</s> school). Why 'from a class-word'? [Counter-example:] <s>muṇḍā</s> (bald woman). Why 'not exclusively feminine'? [Counter-example:] <s>balākā</s> (crane, always feminine). Why 'without <s>y</s> as penultimate'? [Counter-example:] <s>kṣatriyā</s> (warrior-class woman).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ito manuṣya-jāteḥ</s>' (VLk 1273 = P 4.1.65)
<s>Ṅīṣ</s> [is added from an <s>i</s>-ending stem denoting a human class]. [Example:] <s>dākṣī</s> (woman of the <s>Dākṣa</s> lineage).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ūṅ utaḥ</s>' (VLk 1274 = P 4.1.66)

body.text: udantādayopadhānmanuṣyajātivācinaḥ striyāmūṅ syāt / kurūḥ / ayopadhātkim ? adhvaryurbrāhmaṇī //
body.translated_text: After a <s>u</s>-ending [stem] without <s>y</s> as penultimate, denoting a human class, <s>ūṅ</s> is added in the feminine. [Example:] <s>kurūḥ</s> (a <s>Kuru</s> woman). Why 'without <s>y</s> as penultimate'? [Counter-example:] <s>adhvaryur brāhmaṇī</s> (a female <s>adhvaryu</s> priest — takes <s>ṅīṣ</s> instead).
[Sūtra:] '<s>paṅgoś ca</s>' (VLk 1275 = P 4.1.68)
[Example:] <s>paṅgūḥ</s> (a lame woman).
[Sūtra:] '<s>ūrūttarapadād aupamye</s>' (VLk 1276 = P 4.1.69)

body.text: upamānavācī pūrvapadamūrūttarapadaṃ yatprātipadikaṃ tasmādūṅ syāt / karabhorūḥ //
body.translated_text: From a <s>prātipadika</s> (nominal stem) having <s>ūru</s> (thigh) as its latter member, when an analogy (<s>aupamya</s>) is the prior member, <s>ūṅ</s> is added. [Example:] <s>karabhorūḥ</s> (one with thighs like an elephant's trunk).
[Sūtra:] '<s>saṃhitā-śaphalakṣaṇa-vāmādeś ca</s>' (VLk 1277 = P 4.1.70)

body.text: anaupamyārthaṃ sūtram / saṃhitorūḥ / śaphorūḥ / lakṣaṇorūḥ / vāmorūḥ //
body.translated_text: This sūtra is not for the purpose of analogy [but for other meanings]. [Examples:] <s>saṃhitorūḥ</s> (one with compact thighs). <s>śaphorūḥ</s> (one with swollen thighs). <s>lakṣaṇorūḥ</s> (one with well-marked thighs). <s>vāmorūḥ</s> (one with beautiful thighs).
[Sūtra:] '<s>Śārṅgaravādy-año ṅīn</s>' (VLk 1278 = P 4.1.73)

body.text: śārṅgaravāderaño yo 'kārastadantācca jātivācino ṅīn syāt/ śārṅgaravī/ baidī / brāhmaṇī / (
body.translated_text: After the <s>Śārṅgarava</s> class, and after [a stem] whose <s>a</s> belongs to the affix <s>aṇ</s>, and from a class-denoting word ending in such — <s>ṅīn</s> is added. [Examples:] <s>Śārṅgaravī</s> (female of <s>Śārṅgarava</s> lineage). <s>Baidī</s>. <s>brāhmaṇī</s> (Brāhmaṇa woman).
[Sūtra:] '<s>yūnas tiḥ</s>' (VLk 1279 = P 4.1.77)

body.text: yuvañchabdāt striyāṃ tiḥ pratyayaḥ syāt / yuvatiḥ //
body.translated_text: After the word <s>yuvan</s> (young), the affix <s>ti</s> is added in the feminine. [Example:] <s>yuvatiḥ</s> (young woman).
